jobs.title: Python Finance Developer (100% Remote)
jobs.excerpt: About UBQ. io UBQ. io is a global technology service provider dedicated to building a more sustainable, independent, and equitable future.
jobs.description:
About UBQ.io
UBQ.io is a global technology service provider dedicated to building a more sustainable, independent, and equitable future. We partner with global companies across industries, including AI, blockchain, software, biotech, and education, to transform bold ideas into real, meaningful solutions.

Our expertise spans technology consulting, AI and Machine Learning development, Blockchain integration, and global team collaboration. With a worldwide network of specialists, we help organizations stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

At UBQ.io, we don’t just advise, we collaborate. Our commitment to innovation, sustainability, and social responsibility guides everything we do as we help clients build technologies that empower people, communities, and industries to thrive.

About the role

We are looking for a Finance Developer to join our team and help build an internal web platform that supports portfolio management for our finance and operations teams. Working at the intersection of

finance and technology, you will turn financial data and business requirements into accurate, reliable tools. You will own features from end to end, from data queries and calculation logic through to the user interface.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain platform features, including summary metrics, interactive tables and data visualisations.

  • Translate financial methodologies such as valuation, P&L attribution, exposure and cost basis into clean, well-tested backend logic.

  • Make sure every figure reconciles accurately against source systems and existing reporting.

  • Write and optimise SQL queries against our cloud data warehouse.

  • Keep the platform fast and reliable through caching, performance tuning and robust error handling.

  • Work closely with finance and operations stakeholders to gather requirements, validate results and deliver improvements.

Our stack

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, Google BigQuery, Redis

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, Recharts, Tailwind CSS

  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud (Cloud Run), Google sign-in

Requirements

  • Solid professional experience with Python, including building backend services or data applications.

  • A good understanding of financial concepts: positions, P&L (daily, MTD, YTD, ITD), NAV, exposure and cost basis.

  • Comfort writing non-trivial SQL, ideally on BigQuery or another cloud warehouse.

  • A strong eye for detail and a habit of testing and reconciling numbers until they're right.

  • Clear communication, and the confidence to challenge and clarify requirements with finance teams.

  • A MSc in Finance, or progress towards a professional qualification such as CFA or CAIA (Level I or above), or equivalent.

Advantageous

  • Front-end experience with React and TypeScript, especially data-heavy UIs.

  • Experience with BI and reporting tools, or building analytics dashboards.

  • A background in asset management, fund administration, treasury or fintech.

  • Familiarity with multi-asset portfolios, e.g. equities, fixed income, digital assets and commodities.

  • Experience with Google Cloud and caching strategies.

jobs.description:
Disclaimer: Stay safe from recruitment scams
We only hire through , using TestGorilla assessments, video interviews and reference checks. We may contact you first on LinkedIn, but after that we only email from Teamtailor (@ / ) or @ addresses.
We will never ask you for money, interview you on Telegram or WhatsApp, or ask you to install software, connect a wallet or run code.
Not sure if a message is really from us? Ask us through our LinkedIn page before you reply.

You know Bitrefill, and you’ve probably watched a search result or an app listing turn into revenue. You get that search no longer means just Google: people ask Claude and ChatGPT, and agents shop on their behalf. You want to own how 1M+ customers across 180+ countries find us. If that’s you, hit the apply button and let’s talk.

If you need more info to decide, keep reading. We kept the corporate fluff out, so it won't take long.

About the roleOrganic discovery is changing fast. Programmatic SEO still matters, and so do the app stores. Now there’s a third channel: AI answer engines and AI agents that research, compare, and buy without ever opening a browser tab. We want Bitrefill to be the default answer in all three.

You’ll have real freedom here. You choose where to build pages at scale, which experiments to run, and how to make us readable for machines. You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering to get it shipped.

What you'll do

  • Own Bitrefill’s organic growth strategy across search, app stores and AI

  • Build and scale programmatic SEO: find the page types worth generating, then ship, measure and iterate

  • Optimize our iOS and Android app listings with product and design: keywords, screenshots, store tests

  • Make Bitrefill show up in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and whatever comes next)

  • Make Bitrefill easy for AI agents to find and buy from: structured product data, machine-readable pages, and our agentic commerce work

  • Write and shape content, and get your hands dirty in the front end when it’s faster than waiting on a ticket

  • Track what’s working, kill what isn’t, and share findings with the team

What we're looking for

  • Be based in a timezone that aligns with Europe or the Americas

  • 5+ years in growth, SEO, or performance marketing, with a track record of moving organic numbers

  • Deep, hands-on programmatic and technical SEO experience. You’ve built pages at scale, not just audited them

  • You’ve done hands-on GEO / AI visibility work and can show what it changed;

  • AI is part of how you work (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar). This is non-negotiable for us

  • Comfortable with front-end basics. Some React is great, and vibecoding the rest is fine

  • Strong writer with a good eye for design

  • Data-driven. You read Search Console and analytics like a P&L

  • Self-driven. You spot the opportunity and push it forward instead of waiting for a roadmap

Bonus points

  • Real ASO experience on iOS and Android

  • Experience with structured data, llms.txt, or agent-facing APIs and MCP

  • Crypto-native. You use it, and nobody needs to explain Bitcoin to you

  • Experience in e-commerce or marketplace SEO with large catalogs

  • Design chops in Figma for store assets and landing pages

Why Bitrefill

We've been quietly right about something since 2014: internet money should just work. Fully remote since day one. Team across 30+ countries. Get paid in crypto if you want. No bullshit meetings. Twice a year, we meet up to build together in person. The rest of the time: work hard, get shit done.

Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. The Opportunity:

Ensemble Health Partners is seeking a strategic and operationally focused Senior Director, Provisioning Operations to lead and advance provisioning operations supporting new client integrations and ongoing client needs. This role will provide experienced leadership across healthcare revenue cycle operations, access provisioning, client integrations, operational readiness, risk management, and process improvement.


The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in revenue cycle management, cross-functional operations, provisioning, client integrations, and people leadership. This leader will partner closely with Human Resources, Operations, Technology, client-facing teams, and other stakeholders to build scalable processes, strengthen operational controls, improve the employee and client experience, and ensure individuals receive appropriate access when needed.

The successful candidate will be a seasoned, hands-on leader who can operate strategically while remaining willing to support detailed operational work. This individual must demonstrate sound judgment, executive presence, adaptability, and the ability to build trusted relationships across all levels of an organization.

Key Responsibilities

Provisioning Operations

  • Provide strategic leadership and operational oversight for provisioning activities supporting new hires, existing employees, organizational changes, new client integrations, and ongoing client operations.
  • Develop scalable provisioning processes, standards, controls, and best practices that support business growth and operational consistency.
  • Oversee access provisioning workflows to help ensure individuals receive appropriate and timely access based on their roles and business responsibilities.
  • Assess current provisioning processes, workflows, and operational structures to identify risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead efforts to centralize and standardize provisioning activities across applicable business functions and client environments.
  • Establish operating procedures, performance expectations, escalation processes, and accountability measures for provisioning operations.
  • Support the development of a growing provisioning function, including establishing team structures, responsibilities, and leadership practices.

Client Integrations

  • Lead provisioning-related activities for new client implementations, conversions, acquisitions, and operational transitions.
  • Serve as a strategic operational partner throughout client onboarding and integration efforts.
  • Collaborate with client stakeholders and internal teams to understand access requirements, operational workflows, timelines, and potential risks.
  • Develop and oversee provisioning plans that support client readiness and successful operational transitions.
  • Identify and resolve provisioning concerns that may affect implementation timelines, employee readiness, security, or the client experience.
  • Provide ongoing leadership for provisioning activities supporting established client operations.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Human Resources, Revenue Cycle Operations, Technology, Implementation, Client Services, and operational leadership teams.
  • Connect cross-functional activities to create a coordinated, end-to-end provisioning experience.
  • Lead stakeholders through complex operational decisions involving access, workflow dependencies, risk, and business requirements.
  • Build trusted partnerships across internal teams and client organizations.
  • Facilitate clear communication, accountability, and alignment among stakeholders with different operational responsibilities.
  • Present provisioning updates, risks, recommendations, and performance insights to senior leadership and other key stakeholders.

Operational Excellence & Risk Management

  • Evaluate operational workflows to identify access-related risks, process breakdowns, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
  • Apply healthcare revenue cycle knowledge to understand access requirements and their impact on operational performance.
  • Develop and implement solutions that improve provisioning speed, accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
  • Establish metrics and reporting that provide visibility into service levels, risks, backlogs, quality, and operational performance.
  • Support automation and technology initiatives that reduce manual work and improve the provisioning experience.
  • Monitor process performance and lead corrective action plans when operational expectations are not met.
  • Balance business needs, client expectations, security considerations, and risk-management requirements when making decisions.

People Leadership

  • Build, develop, and lead a high-performing provisioning operations team.
  • Establish a collaborative culture focused on accountability, continuous improvement, service, and operational excellence.
  • Coach and develop team members while creating future leaders and scalable team capabilities.
  • Lead effectively across all organizational levels, including individual contributors, operational leaders, executives, clients, and cross-functional partners.
  • Remain willing to support both strategic initiatives and detailed operational work as the function grows.
  • Promote a humble, confident, and solutions-oriented leadership approach that strengthens partnerships and minimizes organizational friction.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in healthcare operations, revenue cycle management, provisioning, access management, client integrations, implementation, technology operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive people-leadership experience, including responsibility for developing teams and other leaders.
  • Previous experience operating at the Director level or in a comparable senior leadership role with responsibility for complex, cross-functional operations.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations and the systems, workflows, and access requirements that support revenue cycle functions.
  • Experience leading provisioning, access-management, client-integration, implementation, operational-transformation, or centralized-operations initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and scale operational processes, controls, standards, and teams.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing stakeholders across Human Resources, Operations, Technology, and client-facing functions.
  • Strong understanding of operational risk and the ability to evaluate access needs, workflow dependencies, and business impact.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex initiatives with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and organization-wide impact.
  • Strong executive presence, communication skills, judgment, and relationship-management capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a growing environment where responsibilities and processes continue to evolve.
  • Willingness to remain hands-on and support detailed operational work when necessary.
  • Ability to travel based on business and client needs.

Manager to Director AI Knowledge

Demonstrated advanced usage of AI and experience managing teams that use AI to support process and technology improvements. This includes encouraging the responsible exploration, experimentation, and application of AI to reduce friction, improve operational efficiency, and enhance employee, patient, and client experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading provisioning or access-management operations within a healthcare revenue cycle organization.
  • Experience supporting large-scale healthcare client integrations, acquisitions, implementations, or operational transitions.
  • Experience building or expanding a centralized operational function.
  • Experience with identity and access management, role-based access, user lifecycle management, or access-governance processes.
  • Experience supporting enterprise healthcare platforms, revenue cycle technologies, or client-specific systems.
  • Knowledge of healthcare privacy, security, compliance, and minimum-necessary access principles.
  • Experience leading teams in multi-state, national, or complex client-based healthcare environments.
  • Experience with workflow automation, reporting, Power BI, Copilot, or other AI-enabled productivity and process-improvement tools.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university.
  • 3+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device sales experience or other relevant life science or clinical experience strongly preferred.

Preferred:

jobs.description:
The SOC Lead is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of the organization's global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center, ensuring that security events are monitored, investigated, and responded to effectively around the clock. Based in Europe, the SOC Lead manages a distributed team of SOC Analysts across multiple regions and time zones. The role goes beyond supervising a queue: the focus is on setting operational standards, owning the incident response process, driving the quality of investigations and handovers, and continuously improving detection and response capabilities. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on SOC experience with proven leadership, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a distributed team of SOC Analysts working across multiple regions in a follow-the-sun model.

  • Own the SOC schedule and shift rotations, including weekend coverage, ensuring continuous coverage across all time zones.

  • Define and enforce the shift handover process, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Act as the primary escalation point for the team and as incident lead for major security incidents, coordinating triage, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reviews with relevant teams.

  • Perform hands-on triage, investigation, and threat hunting alongside the team across the security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Review the quality of investigations and incident documentation, providing structured feedback and ensuring consistent standards across shifts and regions.

  • Define, track, and report SOC metrics and KPIs, such as alert volumes, mean time to detect, mean time to respond, and false positive rates.

  • Drive the improvement of detection content together with security engineering, prioritizing the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules, and mapping coverage to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, incident response playbooks, and escalation matrices.

  • Contribute to the hiring, onboarding, and training of new SOC Analysts.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams, as well as management, to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience in Security Operations, including at least 1 year as a SOC Lead or in an equivalent team lead role.

  • Proven experience triaging alerts, investigating security incidents, and leading the response to major incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience leading or working in a 24/7 or follow-the-sun SOC, including managing shift schedules and remote teams across time zones.

  • Strong experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, GSOM, CISSP, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong leadership, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to report to management and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders during incidents.

About You

You are an experienced SOC practitioner who has moved into leadership without losing your hands-on edge. You know what good triage and investigation look like, and you know how to build a team that delivers them consistently across shifts and time zones. You stay calm during major incidents, communicate clearly with both engineers and management, and make sound decisions under pressure. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools your team relies on, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable leading a fully remote team, and you enjoy coaching analysts, improving processes, and raising the security bar across the environment.

jobs.excerpt: About the jobThe SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center.
jobs.description:
About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

Coordination & Reporting

  • Report on software task progress, system performance metrics, and project risks to the Lead Scientist and Federal oversight managers.

Qualifications

The Scientist Software Engineer selected for this role should meet the following qualifications:

  • Advanced skills and knowledge of Fortran and C programming languages specifically tailored for data parsing and processing.
  • Deep understanding of BUFR (Binary Universal Form for the Representation of meteorological data), including table-driven descriptors and binary extraction logic.
  • Experience working in a UNIX/Linux environment with advanced shell scripting languages.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of meteorological data servers and distribution networks (LDM, DBNet, GTS, WIS2).
  • Skills and knowledge of High-Performance Computing (HPC) file systems and job schedulers (e.g., WCOSS environment, MPI, Slurm, LSF).
  • Knowledge of modern software development practices and version control software, particularly Git/GitHub/Gitflow.
  • Ability to perform complex, mission-critical debugging in a fast-paced, operational environment.

Additional desirable experiences and skills include:

  • Knowledge of global Data Assimilation (DA) systems and observation networks.
  • Experience transitioning legacy meteorological codebases into Cloud environments.
  • Background in atmospheric physics or earth system modeling.

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. jobs.description:

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar com Code Review e Segurança de Aplicações (Application Security), apoiando as atividades de segurança de sistemas desenvolvidos em uma organização global.

A posição terá como foco a análise de vulnerabilidades identificadas por ferramentas de SAST (Static Application Security Testing) e SCA (Software Composition Analysis), avaliação de propostas de mitigação, identificação de falsos positivos e orientação técnica às equipes de desenvolvimento para a correção de vulnerabilidades.

Procuramos um perfil com sólida compreensão de desenvolvimento de software, arquitetura de aplicações e segurança, capaz de atuar com autonomia, avaliar riscos técnicos e propor soluções práticas em um ambiente global e colaborativo.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Monitorar e gerenciar filas de chamados, selecionando demandas de forma proativa, definindo prioridades e acompanhando os casos desde a abertura até a resolução.
  • Analisar vulnerabilidades e apontamentos identificados por ferramentas de SAST e SCA, avaliando sua relevância, criticidade e impacto na segurança das aplicações.
  • Avaliar propostas de mitigação de vulnerabilidades, verificando se os controles implementados são suficientes para reduzir os riscos de segurança.
  • Investigar possíveis falsos positivos, analisando código-fonte, comportamento das aplicações, arquitetura e fluxos de dados.
  • Orientar equipes de desenvolvimento sobre boas práticas de segurança e estratégias de correção de vulnerabilidades identificadas no código.
  • Interagir diretamente com equipes técnicas por meio de Microsoft Teams, reuniões e comunicações escritas, esclarecendo dúvidas e apoiando decisões relacionadas à segurança.
  • Colaborar com profissionais de Desenvolvimento, QA, Infraestrutura, Operações e Segurança para garantir a resolução adequada dos problemas identificados.
  • Contribuir com sugestões de melhorias nos processos, serviços e utilização de tecnologias emergentes, buscando maior eficiência e qualidade nas atividades de segurança.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento sólido em Segurança de Aplicações (Application Security), incluindo arquitetura de software, funcionamento de aplicações e fluxos de dados.
  • Domínio dos conceitos do OWASP Top 10, com capacidade de identificar vulnerabilidades comuns e relacioná-las às respectivas estratégias de correção no código.
  • Experiênciaem Desenvolvimento de Software, Arquitetura de Software, Quality Assurance (QA) ou Engenharia de Segurança de Aplicações.
  • Conhecimento prático em pelo menos uma linguagem ou tecnologia de desenvolvimento, como C#, C++, Java, .NET, ou Python.
  • Capacidade de analisar resultados de ferramentas SAST e SCA, avaliar possíveis falsos positivos e validar propostas de mitigação de riscos.
  • Capacidade de interpretar código-fonte e compreender o comportamento das aplicações para investigar vulnerabilidades e orientar correções.
  • Autonomia para gerenciar demandas, estabelecer prioridades, acompanhar chamados e conduzir atividades até sua conclusão.
  • Inglês avançado, com boa comunicação verbal e escrita para explicar riscos técnicos, apresentar recomendações de correção e interagir com equipes internacionais e stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças, atuação em cenários com informações incompletas e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.

Requisitos desejáveis (diferenciais)

  • Experiência prática anterior como Desenvolvedor(a) de Software, especialmente em atividades relacionadas à análise de código e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Familiaridade com padrões de arquitetura de aplicações, como MVC, microsserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, como Agile, XP, Scrum e Kanban.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de Test Driven Development (TDD) e integração e entrega contínuas (CI/CD).
  • Conhecimentos em arquitetura e serviços de Cloud Computing, especialmente AWS.

  • Perfil participativo, com facilidade para compartilhar opiniões, propor melhorias e contribuir para um ambiente de trabalho aberto e colaborativo.

We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and bilingual Property Management Secretary to support our team. This is a vital role where you will manage the administrative and financial heartbeat of our properties. You will handle everything from bookkeeping and rent tracking to serving as the primary point of contact for our complaint center. If you are fluent in English and French, proficient in QuickBooks, and ready to manage administrative workflows for a property portfolio based in Quebec, we want to hear from you.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Bookkeeping & Financials: Maintain accurate financial records using QuickBooks. Track rental payments, manage data entry for invoices, and ensure financial reports are up to date.
  • Property Administration: Support property management operations by managing files, updating tenant databases, and utilizing our Quebec-based rental property software.
  • Client Relations & Complaint Center: Serve as the primary administrative voice for our tenants. Handle incoming inquiries, resolve complaints, and maintain professional communication in both English and French.
  • Data Management: Execute precise data entry tasks to ensure property information, lease details, and maintenance logs are always current in Excel and our internal management systems.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Language Fluency (Must-Have): Native or professional proficiency in both English and French (Written and Spoken). This is non-negotiable as you will be communicating with tenants in both languages.
  • Software Expertise:
    • QuickBooks: Proven experience in bookkeeping and accounts receivable.
    • Excel: Advanced data entry and organizational capabilities.
    • Rental Property Software: Prior experience with Quebec-specific property management software is highly preferred.
  • Experience: A background in Property Management or a high-volume administrative support role.
  • Availability: Must be available to work Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST.

The Offer:

  • Compensation: $9 - $10.00 USD per hour.
  • Environment: 100% Remote.
  • Culture: We value results and skill. We are looking for a team player who can hit the ground running.

jobs.title: Principal Architect - Cybersecurity
jobs.excerpt: SummaryServes as a principal technical and architectural leader for Logicalis’ Cybersecurity Practice, helping clients translate business objectives, cyber risk, compliance requirements, and emerging threats into practical cybersecurity strategies and architectures.
jobs.description:
Summary

Serves as a principal technical and architectural leader for Logicalis’ Cybersecurity Practice, helping clients translate business objectives, cyber risk, compliance requirements, and emerging threats into practical cybersecurity strategies and architectures. Provides pre-sales cybersecurity solution support to Account Executives and clients as an integral part of the full sales process, with a focus on mid-size and enterprise accounts across key Logicalis vertical markets, including manufacturing, healthcare, and Government and Education (GovEd).

Works closely with clients, Logicalis sales, architecture, Professional Services, Managed Services, and strategic technology partners to develop cybersecurity solutions that deliver measurable business and security outcomes. This position also plays a leadership role in identifying, developing, operationalizing, and enabling new cybersecurity offerings, architectures, methodologies, and messaging for the Logicalis sales and delivery communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Leads the development of cybersecurity strategies, reference architectures, roadmaps, designs, and proposals that align Logicalis capabilities with client business objectives, cyber risk, regulatory requirements, and technology strategy.

  • Provides architectural leadership across key cybersecurity domains, including network and cloud security, identity, endpoint, data protection, security operations, exposure management, attack path analysis, governance and compliance, AI security, and cyber resilience.
  • Conducts assessments, studies, workshops, and surveys to obtain and analyze data; advises clients on current-state risks, target-state architectures, investment priorities, and practical remediation roadmaps.
  • Helps clients evolve from traditional vulnerability and control-focused approaches toward risk-based exposure management, attack-path analysis, and prioritized remediation based on business impact.
  • Helps clients understand and address emerging cybersecurity risks, including AI-enabled threats, secure AI adoption, expanded attack surfaces, identity-based attacks, and rapidly evolving adversary techniques.
  • Qualifies, from a technical and architectural perspective, new business opportunities and requirements within existing and prospective clients to ensure alignment with target markets, the Logicalis portfolio, and delivery and lifecycle services capabilities.
  • Develops and reviews cybersecurity Statements of Work (SOWs), Work Breakdown Structures (WBSs), assumptions, deliverables, and reusable SOW templates in partnership with Professional Services to ensure solutions are technically sound, outcome-oriented, repeatable, and deliverable.
  • Develops repeatable cybersecurity architectures, methodologies, assessment models, service blueprints, workshops, and supporting intellectual property that can be consistently positioned and delivered across Logicalis clients.
  • Contributes to the continued development and evolution of Logicalis cybersecurity architectures, frameworks, methodologies, and intellectual property.
  • Designs cybersecurity solutions with consideration for the full client lifecycle, including advisory, implementation, adoption, Managed Services, optimization, recurring assessment, and continuous improvement.
  • Serves as a trusted cybersecurity advisor for strategic client engagements, facilitating executive and technical discussions around cyber risk, security architecture, modernization priorities, regulatory requirements, resilience, and investment roadmaps.
  • Partners with Account Executives and Solutions Architects to identify cybersecurity opportunities within strategic accounts and develop multi-phase security roadmaps rather than isolated technology transactions.
  • Provides input to account planning for key accounts; participates in customer meetings and executive customer engagements; and supports consultative and transformative sales opportunities.
  • Maintains strong technical relationships across the Logicalis strategic cybersecurity partner ecosystem and understands how partner technologies can be integrated into broader Logicalis architectures and services to achieve customer outcomes.
  • Works with Logicalis services, solutions, and OEM partners to identify, develop, and operationalize new cybersecurity offerings and capabilities.
  • Supports offering ideation and development, partner alignment, workshop and consulting offer creation, pricing strategy, and value proposition development across the offering lifecycle.
  • Creates and delivers technical enablement for the design, implementation, and managed elements of cybersecurity offerings, including technical training, sales tools, internal communications, and practice updates.
  • Enables the Service Delivery team to implement Logicalis cybersecurity offerings successfully and enables Solutions Architects and Sales Engineers to position the offerings and their business benefits effectively.
  • Provides technical leadership, mentorship, and architectural guidance to Solutions Architects, Sales Engineers, and other cybersecurity team members, helping raise cybersecurity capability across the broader Logicalis organization.
  • Maintains a culture of learning and brings relevant market, threat, technology, and regulatory insights back to the organization to support the vision, strategy, and execution of the Cybersecurity Practice.
  • Participates in regional and national events and regional team meetings and speaks at industry events and conferences identified as valuable to Logicalis.
  • Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding of and commitment to the Logicalis mission by performing behaviors consistent with the organization’s values.
  • Maintains working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations, as well as Logicalis policies and procedures, and acts in an honest, ethical, and professional manner.
  • Supports and conducts themself in a manner consistent with customer service expectations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job has no direct supervisory responsibilities. The position is expected to provide technical leadership, mentorship, and architectural guidance across the Cybersecurity Practice and adjacent teams.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience/Technical Requirements/Certifications

Equivalent combination accepted.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field preferred.

Experience / Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity architecture, consulting, engineering, or technical pre-sales.

  • Demonstrated experience designing enterprise cybersecurity architectures spanning multiple security domains.
  • Experience translating business requirements, cyber risk, compliance requirements, and technical requirements into security strategies, target-state architectures, and roadmaps.
  • Experience combining Professional Services, Managed Services, and technology platforms into outcome-oriented client solutions.
  • Experience developing cybersecurity offerings, methodologies, reference architectures, workshops, or reusable consulting assets preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience communicating cybersecurity strategy and architecture with both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity and compliance frameworks such as the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53 and 800-171, CIS Controls, ISO/IEC 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, CMMC, and Zero Trust architectural principles.
  • Strong experience with cybersecurity solutions from leading manufacturers and providers, such as Cisco, Microsoft, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, and other strategic Logicalis partners.
  • Experience developing enterprise-wide solutions that integrate security technologies, advisory services, implementation services, and ongoing operational capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of cross-practice architecture and services, including cloud, networking, collaboration, data, Professional Services, and Managed Services.
  • Proficient use of Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and related collaboration tools.

Certifications


  • ISC2 Certified Information Systems Security Professional(CISSP)
  • ISACA Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
  • GIAC certifications beyond foundational or essentials-level credentials
  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Security or Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE)
  • Security Relevant Microsoft security certifications
  • Relevant cloud security certifications
  • Other advanced certifications aligned with Logicalis strategic cybersecurity technologies and services

Other Skills and Abilities


  • Ability to travel 25%-50%
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where organizational skills are essential.
  • Ability to explain complex technical issues in a way that non-technical people will understand; ability to provide understanding of how proposed solution will solve client’s business needs, requirements and problems.
  • Ability to have business level conversation with IT technical customers and C-level executives alike and assist them in deploying solutions to meet business requirements.
  • Fluency in formulating and expressing thoughts and ideas.
  • Outstanding oral, written, and technical/business communication skills.
  • Strong technical and customer interaction skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and accommodate requests from multiple clients and from Logicalis pre-sales, delivery and sales teams.

Physical Demands


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is constantly required to sit, talk, see, hear, and use hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand; move about, climb steps or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.


The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this classification. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of personnel so classified.


Logicalis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to employ people who are qualified by reason of education, training, experience, and demonstrated performance. We value inclusion and belonging at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, marital status, age, height, weight, disability, veteran status, or any other reason prohibited by applicable federal or state laws.


NOTE:It is Logicalis’ practice that when a client requires medical testing, the employee must accept that requirement as a condition of their assignment and either submit to the tests or show proof they’ve completed the test satisfactorily (i.e., TB Test negative).

jobs.title: Pharmacy Adherence Technician
jobs.excerpt: Location:Remote PositionHiring Range:$15. 60 - $26.
jobs.description:
Location:

Remote Position

Hiring Range:

$15.60 - $26.58

Position Summary


Responsible for scheduling orders for delivery or pick-up and documenting various updates related to therapy adherence. Will perform routine and non-routine pharmacy technician functions and activities related to the position. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: making/answering outbound/inbound calls to/from patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals, updating patient records, and providing medications to patients in a timely manner to encourage adherence to therapy.


The Pharmacy Adherence Technician will evaluate and maintain accurate medication information regarding therapy adherence, medication lists, and prescription barriers under the clinical supervision of licensed pharmacists. Must be able to exercise excellent communication skills to successfully interact with all levels of internal and external parties and to convey information appropriately. Must be able to effectively use, pronounce, and spell common medical and pharmacy terms. No patient counseling will be completed by the Pharmacy Adherence Technician.


Key Performance Areas


KPA 1 – Therapy Adherence

To ensure patients are adhering to therapy as indicated by the treating physician through effective communication about prescription refills and barriers in a timely manner.


Examples of job duties:

  • Navigates ONCO EMR to determine if the patient has had any notable changes in personal and therapy status to determine appropriateness of refilling a medication.
  • Gathers information regarding prescription barriers to help the patient maintain therapy. Refers clinical questions and concerns to clinical pharmacists.
  • Will work with pharmacists to document discharge summaries and medication on hold forms in order to report discontinuation and delays with therapy.
  • Actively participates in the process of continuous improvement within the pharmacy.
  • Attends team meetings and training sessions as required.

KPA 2 – Data Entry and Documentation

To ensure the accurate and timely documentation of patient information into multiple software systems.


Examples of job duties:

  • Navigates and documents accurately in CPR+, ORCA, ONCO EMR, and any additional pharmacy applications when needed.
  • Medication Reconciliation: Under supervision of clinical pharmacists, responsible for obtaining and documenting accurate medication lists to help avoid duplication, omission, and error to all patients.
  • Inform the clinical physician of any order status changes via patient EMR. This includes medication delivery dates, prior authorizations initiated, financial assistance initiated, reasons for holding or discontinuing an order, and any order clarifications as necessary.

KPA 3 – Pharmacy Support

To ensure that orders are processed in a timely manner by assisting the pharmacists and other departments with pharmacy related tasks.


Examples of job duties:

  • Maintain an encouraging attitude to create a positive work environment.
  • Will collect and process patient copayments.
  • Communicates delivery updates related to shipping delays with patients, caregivers, and providers.
  • Accurately processes and interprets pharmacy test claims. Triages order to other team members for assistance in resolving any discrepancies with test claims.
  • Gathers pertinent information regarding lost medication requests, vacation override requests, and medication synchronization.
  • Initiates prior authorizations, financial assistance, and insurance or facility verifications by gathering and providing relevant information to other pharmacy staff for investigation and resolution.

KPA 4 – Communications

To ensure that patients, caregivers, and providers can get timely responses and updates regarding orders.


Examples of job duties:

  • Responsible for answering incoming calls to the pharmacy phone queue, and appropriately transferring calls to other departments or team members, as needed.
  • Responsible for making outbound calls to patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers regarding order deliveries and updates.
  • Will be required to meet a pre-determined quota for outbound calls made and inbound calls received per shift.
  • Professionally and courteously communicates order information with patients, caregivers, and/or healthcare professionals. Demonstrates the ability to actively listen and understand patient questions and provide accurate answers and solutions. Will ensure that all concerns are addressed in a timely manner.
  • Will deliver messages via phone, email, patient EMR, and letter correspondence while following all HIPAA regulations.
  • All complex questions or information outside the Adherence Pharmacy Technician’s scope will be directed to a Clinician, Physician, or Pharmacy Benefit Manager for resolution.

KPA 5 –Compliance

Follows all federal/state pharmacy/healthcare regulations, and maintains necessary records pertaining to the Board of Pharmacy in the state of residence and compliance within the company.


Examples of job duties:

  • Complies with CMS regulations, HIPAA regulations, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Maintain continuing education requirements for licensure.
  • Complete Fraud Waste and Abuse Training as required by law and all other training assigned by management.
  • Participate in the pharmacy’s Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) program by identifying quality related events and reporting them to the pharmacist.
  • Keeps the direct supervisor/manager promptly and fully informed of any problems or unusual matters of significance.

Position Qualifications/Requirements


Education: High school diploma, GED or equivalent education is required


Previous Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience as licensed pharmacy technician in specialty, retail, mail order, or hospital pharmacy preferred.

Certifications/Licenses

  • Following applicable state regulations, state registration as Pharmacy Technician or PTCB Certification is required.

Core Capabilities

  • Analysis & Critical Thinking: Critical thinking skills including solid problem solving, analysis, decision-making, planning, time management and organizational skills. Must be detailed oriented with the ability to exercise independent judgment.
  • Interpersonal Effectiveness: Developed interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, diplomacy, tact, conflict management, delegation skills, and diversity awareness. Ability to work effectively with sensitive and confidential material and sometimes emotionally charged matters.
  • Communication Skills: Effective communication skills (oral, written, presentation), is an active listener, and effectively provides balanced feedback.
  • Customer Service & Organizational Awareness: Strong customer focus. Ability to build an engaging culture of quality, performance effectiveness and operational excellence through best practices, strong business and political acumen, collaboration and partnerships, as well as a positive employee, physician and community relations.
  • Self-Management: Effectively manages own time, conflicting priorities, self, stress, and professional development. Self-motivated and self-starter with ability work independently with limited supervision. Ability to work remotely effectively as required.
  • Must be able to work effectively in a fast-paced, multi-site environment with demonstrated ability to juggle competing priorities and demands from a variety of stakeholders and sites.
  • Computer Skills:
    • Proficiency in MS Office Word, Excel, Power Point, and Outlook required.

Travel: 0%


Standard Work Days/Hours: Monday to Friday (8:00am to 4:30pm, 8:30am to 5:00pm, or 9:00am to 5:30pm).

jobs.title: Video Producer
jobs.excerpt: USA TODAY Co.  is seeking a detail-oriented, platform-native video producer to expand video support for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms.
jobs.description:
USA TODAY Co. is seeking a detail-oriented, platform-native video producer to expand video support for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms. This full-time role will use strong editorial judgment and AI-assisted production workflows to turn local reporting, photos, data and graphics into timely, accurate and engaging short-form video. The producer will work directly with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories that can reach broader audiences through video. Coverage will span the range of local journalism, including breaking news, public safety, weather, government, education, business, consumer issues, community stories, major local events and other topics important to individual markets. This is a hands-on production and service role focused on helping local newsrooms publish more video efficiently across owned and social platforms.

What you’ll do:

Serve as a dedicated video production resource for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms, supporting market needs and network-wide local coverage priorities. Use AI-assisted platforms, including Stringr, along with templates, automation and editing tools to produce a high volume of accurate, on-brand video from local reporting, photos, data, graphics, user-generated content and newsroom briefs. Use Stringr AI UGC production capabilities to help local newsrooms identify and develop relevant user-generated content into publishable video while following verification, sourcing, rights and editorial standards. Use Stringr Clip Gen to create timely clips and short-form video from press conferences, public meetings, interviews, podcasts and other longer recordings. Use Stringr Show Stacker and other AI-assisted long-form production tools to assemble structured video from local programs, interviews, recurring shows and extended newsroom content. Partner with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories with strong visual, audience and distribution potential. Respond quickly to local breaking news and major developing stories while also supporting planned enterprise, service and community coverage. Create useful explainers that make complex local topics clear, accessible and relevant to the communities our newsrooms serve. Turn newsroom briefs and published stories into clear video treatments, selecting effective visuals, scripts, on-screen text, audio, pacing and formats. Adapt local journalism into platform-native vertical video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, YouTube Shorts and other platforms. Repurpose AI-assisted and automated content for owned-and-operated and social platforms, tailoring each version to the audience, market and platform. Optimize video length, aspect ratio, captions, headlines, thumbnails, metadata and calls to action using platform best practices and performance insights. Program videos on corresponding local articles and support distribution workflows that increase the reach and value of local journalism. Manage and prioritize requests from multiple newsrooms, communicate progress and blockers, and balance planned work with urgent coverage needs. Maintain editorial, legal, brand and visual standards, including accuracy, sourcing, attribution, captions, fonts, colors and overall presentation. Track core performance metrics, identify successful local formats and topics, and share repeatable lessons with newsroom and video partners. Test emerging AI and automation capabilities responsibly, helping improve templates, workflows and production standards for local newsroom use. Review videos produced by others for quality and accuracy and provide feedback

What success looks like:

Local newsrooms receive reliable, timely video support across a broad range of coverage needs. More high-priority local stories include relevant video on owned and social platforms. Story-to-video turnaround improves, particularly during breaking news and other time-sensitive coverage. Produced videos meet high standards for accuracy, clarity, audience value and brand consistency. Local newsroom partners have clear visibility into priorities, progress and production capacity. Strong formats and workflows are identified, documented and applied across additional USA TODAY Network markets. AI-assisted tools and automation improve production efficiency while preserving editorial judgment and quality.

Who you are:

A digital-first journalist or producer who understands the role video can play in extending the reach and impact of local journalism. A strong editor with sound news judgment, a sharp eye for visuals and the ability to identify the clearest audience takeaway from a story. Comfortable producing quick-turn, high-volume video without sacrificing accuracy, quality or brand standards. Able to move between breaking news, service journalism, enterprise reporting and community stories based on newsroom needs. Highly organized and able to manage requests from multiple markets, changing priorities and deadline pressure in a remote environment. A clear, responsive and collaborative partner who can work effectively with local reporters, editors, newsroom leaders and centralized video teams. Curious and adaptable, with a practical interest in AI, automation and new approaches to newsroom production. Committed to journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, transparency and responsible use of emerging technology.

Qualifications:

2-5 years Professional experience in digital journalism, video production, social video or a related field. Demonstrated video editing experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, mobile editing applications or comparable tools. Experience creating and publishing video for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube. Strong writing and editing skills, including the ability to create concise scripts, captions, headlines and on-screen text. Ability to work independently, make sound editorial decisions on deadline and collaborate across newsrooms and time zones. Experience working with local newsrooms or producing video from local reporting is preferred. Experience with AI-assisted production platforms, including Stringr or comparable tools, template-driven workflows, content-management systems or publishing tools is preferred.

How To Apply:

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job. Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration. #Newsgnt

The hourly rate for this role will range between $$25.48 and $$39.81. Variable incentive compensation, including commissions, is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, education level, location, and union representation, if applicable

POSITION SUMMARY

The Principal DevOps Engineer is the organization’s senior individual contributor for enterprise DevOps and platform engineering. This role defines and evolves cloud, automation, software delivery, and operational reliability patterns that align Architecture and business strategy. The position leads the design of secure, scalable Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS) platforms; establishes reusable infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, and governance capabilities; and sets technical standards adopted across Development, Architecture, Security, Network, Infrastructure, and Operations. Azure DevOps is the organization’s standard source-control, build, and deployment platform for application and infrastructure delivery across both cloud environments. The Principal DevOps Engineer serves as a hands-on technical authority, leads complex cross-functional initiatives and proofs of concept, mentors engineers, and uses measurable outcomes to continuously improve developer experience, delivery performance, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Essential Functions

Own the enterprise technical strategy and reference architecture for DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, software delivery, and engineering automation, translating business and Architecture direction into actionable standards and roadmaps. Design, implement, and support secure, resilient, scalable cloud infrastructure and shared platform services across Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS), including Kubernetes, containers, networking, identity, compute, storage, data, and other cloud-native capabilities. Architect and govern infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules, versioning, automated validation and testing, remote state management, policy checks, controlled promotion, and lifecycle management. Define and evolve enterprise CI/CD and software-delivery patterns using Azure DevOps as the organization’s standard source-control, build, and deployment platform, including Azure Repos, Azure Pipelines, quality gates, artifact management, release controls, progressive delivery, rollback, and traceability across Azure and AWS environments. Lead GitOps architecture and deployment practices using Azure DevOps, Argo CD, Helm, Kubernetes, and related technologies; establish secure, repeatable patterns for containerized and cloud-native workloads across Azure and AWS. Create automation and platform capabilities using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, SDKs, and event-driven integrations to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and increase engineering throughput. Establish Git and repository governance, including branching strategies, pull-request and code-review standards, release practices, dependency management, and software supply-chain controls. Design and enforce multi-cloud governance and security controls across Azure and AWS, including policy as code, identity and access integration, secrets and certificate management, network and workload security requirements, resource organization and tagging, cost governance, compliance evidence, and automated guardrails. Define the enterprise observability strategy across Azure and AWS using Datadog and OpenTelemetry as cross-platform capabilities, together with cloud-native telemetry services such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Amazon CloudWatch; establish standards for logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, service-level indicators, actionable alerting, and operational telemetry. Lead reliability engineering practices across Azure and AWS, including service-level objectives, capacity planning, performance engineering, high availability, disaster recovery, operational readiness, incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action follow-through. Monitor and analyze key delivery, reliability, security, and platform-adoption metrics; identify systemic constraints and lead improvements that produce measurable business and engineering outcomes. Chair or provide technical authority for architecture reviews, platform design decisions, change-control standards, and quality and testing requirements for software and infrastructure builds and deployments. Lead complex technology evaluations and proofs of concept; document findings, risks, total-cost and operational trade-offs, and recommendations for leadership. Create and maintain reference architectures, implementation guides, reusable templates, technical standards, decision records, training materials, and operational procedures for varied technical and executive audiences. Provide expert consultation, technical leadership, coaching, and mentoring to DevOps, platform, development, and infrastructure engineers without requiring direct people-management responsibility. Facilitate alignment across Development, Architecture, Security, Network, Infrastructure, and Operations teams; resolve cross-domain technical issues and influence adoption of enterprise standards. Participate in development, testing, deployment, implementation, and continuous-improvement activities across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Lead multiple concurrent initiatives of high scope, ambiguity, risk, and organizational impact; communicate status, decisions, dependencies, and risks clearly to leadership and stakeholders. Ensure completeness, accuracy, accessibility, and currency of required technical documentation. Support organizational values and cultivate a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, diversity, inclusion, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.

Experience

Ten (10) or more years of progressive experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical field. Five (5) or more years designing, implementing, managing, and supporting enterprise cloud infrastructure and cloud-based platforms in Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS), with demonstrated ability to design and operate across multi-cloud environments. Demonstrated experience functioning as a senior technical lead, principal engineer, architect, or equivalent authority for enterprise-scale DevOps or platform engineering initiatives. Hands-on experience designing and operating distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, containerized workloads, and production services in a large enterprise environment. Progressive achievement in job history, including successful delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable technical or operational outcomes.

Required Technical Expertise

Expert-level infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, including reusable module design, testing, state and dependency management, upgrade strategy, drift detection, and governed deployment workflows. Expert-level design and implementation of CI/CD and release-engineering systems using Azure DevOps, including Azure Repos and Azure Pipelines, for application and infrastructure delivery across Azure and AWS. Advanced Kubernetes and container-platform expertise, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), Helm, GitOps with Argo CD, workload security, cluster operations, upgrades, scaling, networking, storage, and troubleshooting. Advanced automation and software-development capability using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, SDKs, and Git-based development practices. Deep understanding of Azure and AWS governance, policy as code, identity and access management, secrets and certificate automation, network security, DevSecOps, software supply-chain security, resource organization, tagging, and cloud cost controls. Advanced multi-cloud observability and reliability engineering experience using Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Amazon CloudWatch, or comparable tooling, including SLOs, actionable alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis. Expert understanding of SDLC automation, Agile delivery, design and development practices, testing standards, change control, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and operational readiness. Ability to develop reference architectures and technical standards that balance security, reliability, developer experience, cost, maintainability, and speed of delivery.

Leadership and Professional Capabilities

Operates independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and exercises sound judgment when requirements are incomplete or priorities conflict. Influences technical direction across teams and levels through credibility, facilitation, clear decision frameworks, and evidence-based recommendations. Communicates complex technical concepts effectively to engineering, security, architecture, operations, business, and executive audiences. Demonstrates exceptional analytical, systems-thinking, troubleshooting, problem-solving, presentation, and technical-writing skills. Mentors engineers, promotes knowledge sharing, and raises engineering quality through reviews, standards, pairing, and practical guidance. Demonstrates strong attention to detail, accountability, collaboration, open communication, and commitment to engineering excellence. Must be willing to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, when required to support releases, incidents, or critical initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an internal developer platform, paved-road or golden-path capabilities, self-service infrastructure, or developer portals. Experience applying FinOps practices, cloud cost allocation, capacity optimization, and unit-cost or consumption metrics to platform decisions. Experience with enterprise risk, regulatory, audit, or compliance requirements and automated evidence collection. Relevant professional certification such as Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, or comparable credentials.

MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT AND WORK AIDS

Personal computer and associated software; Microsoft Azure; Amazon Web Services (AWS); Azure DevOps; Azure Repos; Azure Pipelines; Terraform; Kubernetes; AKS; EKS; Argo CD; Helm; PowerShell; Bash; Python; APIs and SDKs; Datadog; Azure Monitor; Application Insights; Amazon CloudWatch; OpenTelemetry; artifact-management, security, collaboration, and documentation platforms; and standard office equipment.

LICENSE(S) / CERTIFICATIONS REQUIRED

None required. Relevant advanced Azure, AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code certifications are preferred.

JOB DESCRIPTION NOTICE

This job description does not state or imply that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees may be required to follow other job-related instructions and perform other job-related duties as requested, subject to all applicable state and federal laws. “Commonly associated” is not intended to mean always or only. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

COMPENSATION

The salary range is $140,000-$160,000 USD per year, depending on experience, qualifications, and skills. This role may also be eligible for incentives, benefits, and other rewards as part of BMI’s total rewards package.
