jobs.excerpt: Duties & Responsibilities Enrolment & Seat Utilisation• Steer importers and dealers to nominate participants and achieve their training targets; promote scheduled courses to the markets.
jobs.description:
Duties & Responsibilities

Enrolment & Seat Utilisation

  • Steer importers and dealers to nominate participants and achieve their training targets; promote scheduled courses to the markets.

  • Manage training bookings and seat utilisation for every course.

  • Act as the primary contact for the markets on scheduling: handle enquiries, and communicate schedules, updates and requirements.

  • Support the Analyst with enrolment, registration, cancellation and rescheduling updates in TMSi, and with keeping importer and learner details current.

  • Support the Training Co-ordinator with collecting quarterly training requirement requests from the importers.

  • Support the Training Co-ordinator with maintaining the training calendar and managing changes, and support the Analyst with publishing training events in TMSi in line with the approved calendar.

Fill-Rate & Attendance (SLA)

  • Run the contractual fill-rate checkpoints for every course: the early-warning review 21 calendar days before start, the formal measurement 14 calendar days before start, and the final attendance check 5 to 3 business days before delivery.

  • Act on shortfalls: send participant reminders, escalate to importers and dealers, manage waiting lists and backfill places.

  • Document every contact attempt and escalation, so that the evidence is available for Deviation Requests and Legitimate Cause claims.

  • Support the Programme / Project Manager with preparing Deviation Requests before the 14-day measurement date, and Legitimate Cause claims with supporting evidence.

  • Monitor attendance and completion against agreed requirements, and help resolve differences between planned and actual attendance.

  • Support markets with visa applications for training participants.

Course Logistics & Readiness

  • Book and schedule training with suppliers, confirm the internal and variable trainers allocated to each course, and co-ordinate their logistics.

  • Support the Training Co-ordinator as an operational contact for external training vendors.

  • Prepare the venue for each course with the training centre reception: room set-up, catering, tools, vehicles and equipment; assist with procurement.

  • Ensure physical and soft-copy training materials are ready, available, shared with participants and compliant with BMW Corporate Identity before delivery; correct any gap within 48 hours of notice.

  • Support the Analyst in mapping course materials in TMSi so that they are accessible before delivery.

  • Prepare logistics for product launches, special programmes, events and conferences.

  • Take part in the Programme / Project Manager's briefing for each launch or event, and support the Training Co-ordinator with planning and delivering product launch training events.

Certification

  • Create certificates from training results and share them with the markets.

Market Communication

  • Organise the monthly market calls and prepare presentation materials.

  • Inform the markets of periodic webcasts.

  • Distribute the Importer Training Achievement reports, produced by the Analyst from TMSi data, to each importer at the end of every month, showing progress against the training requirements for the quarter.

  • Act as the first point of contact for importers on issues and queries about their Importer Training Achievement reports, and resolve them with the Analyst where the data needs to be checked or corrected.

  • Track each importer's progress towards achieving the training standards during the quarter, and highlight shortfalls to the importers and the Programme / Project Manager early enough for action to be taken.

  • At each quarter end, issue the final Importer Training Achievement reports to the importers and submit them to the BMW RO by the agreed deadline, confirming with the Analyst that the data is complete, accurate and reconciled with attendance and completion records.

  • Prepare an overview of the monthly and quarterly Importer Training Achievement results for the Programme / Project Manager, with support from the Analyst.

Compliance & Operating Standards

  • Maintain the compliance register of vendor agreements, work permits, licences, sub-supplier documents and their expiry dates.

  • Flag renewals to the Training Co-ordinator ahead of expiry, keeping the Programme / Project Manager informed as the accountable owner, so that no document lapses.

  • Support the Training Co-ordinator with vendor onboarding documentation, PO requests and invoice checks.

  • Develop and maintain the Operating Standards Manual, documenting the processes agreed by the training team.

  • Introduce and manage the agreed processes in the Operating Standards Manual across the team, and keep them current as processes change; report on the manual and process adoption to the Programme / Project Manager.

Data Integrity & Confidentiality

  • Keep enrolment, attendance and contact records complete and accurate; falsification of records is a potential Material Breach under the BMW contract.

  • Protect the confidentiality of participant and training data.

  • Support the Analyst's data-integrity checks.

Team Support

  • Take part in the weekly operations meeting and maintain action logs.

  • Support audits and BMW programme reviews with records and documentation.

  • Contribute to improving tools, templates and processes.

Ad Hoc Duties

  • Undertake additional duties associated with the successful delivery of the BMW ME training programme, as reasonably required by the Programme / Project Manager.

Key Performance Measures

  • Course fill-rate of at least 95% (minimum 8 participants where applicable) at the 14-day measurement, unless an Approved Deviation applies.

  • Fill-rate checkpoints completed and documented on time for every course.

  • Materials and venue ready before every delivery, with no content-readiness Non-Compliance Events.

  • Certificates issued to markets within the agreed time.

  • Importer Training Achievement reports distributed at every month end, and quarter-end reports submitted to the BMW RO complete, accurate and on time.

  • No lapsed vendor agreements, permits or compliance documents.

  • Timely, accurate responses to market scheduling enquiries.

Professional Competence

No day is the same, so it is important that you can prioritise, manage your time successfully, and work both proactively and reactively.

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail across many concurrent courses.

  • Confident follow-up and escalation with importers and dealers to secure attendance.

  • Logistics and event co-ordination experience.

  • Accurate record-keeping and document control.

  • Experience using a learning management system; working knowledge of TMSi is an advantage.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint and Teams.

  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is an advantage.

Personal Competence

  • Persistent and resourceful in getting things done.

  • Calm and composed under pressure and tight deadlines.

  • Service-minded, courteous and professional with all stakeholders.

  • Culturally aware across diverse Middle East markets.

  • Takes ownership of tasks and follows through.

  • Discreet with confidential information.

  • Collaborative team player.

  • Ability and willingness to apply science to decision-making and guide activities.
  • Experience in working with a broad variety of stakeholders related to the marine environment, including government officials, fishing communities, academia, NGO’s, others in Chile.
  • Experience completing tasks independently with respect to timeline(s).
  • Experience using common software applications such as Word, Excel, web browsers, etc.
  • Fluent with communication via written, spoken and graphical means in English and Spanish
  • Experience negotiating agreements.
  • Experience communicating with the public and/or media both in writing and verbally.
  • Possession of a valid Chilean Class B driver's license

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to explain conservation practices to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Completing tasks independently with respect to timeline(s).

This position requires a valid driver's license and compliance with TNC’s Auto Safety Program. Employees may not drive Conservancy-owned/leased vehicles, rental cars, or personal vehicles on behalf of the Conservancy if considered "high risk drivers." To learn more about the Auto Safety Program, visit the Auto Safety information page. Employment in this position will be contingent upon completion of a Vehicle Use Agreement, which may include a review of the prospective employee's motor vehicle record.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. ★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Marketing Manager, Communications & Content

Location: Remote – Mexico
Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Independent Contractor (ongoing)
Industry: Marketing & Advertising
Compensation: $1,000–$1,300 USD/week
Schedule: Self-directed; you set your own schedule and methods, with weekly or biweekly updates
English Proficiency: C1 (Excellent spoken and written English)
Start Date: November 16, 2026

About the Role

A leading independent PR, creative, and digital agency is seeking an experienced marketing and communications professional to support the agency's own brand, content, and visibility on a contract basis. The firm combines earned media, digital marketing, and generative engine optimization (GEO) with the agency's own research and studies, to help brands show up wherever buyers search, scroll, or ask, including in AI search and answer engines. Its communications work is done in house, spanning earned media, content, social, video, performance marketing, and AI-driven visibility.
This engagement covers a broad mix of work: PR and communications for the agency's own research and studies, social media, video, press release distribution, agency awards, paid search, and content built for generative AI search. It also includes applying AI automation to make the agency's marketing workflows more efficient.
You will deliver on an agreed-upon scope and content calendar while setting your own schedule and methods. This remote role is ideal for a self-directed marketer who is equally comfortable writing a press release, editing a video, and building an automated workflow.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Broad ownership of the agency's own brand, content, and visibility, not a narrow single-channel brief.
  • A mix of PR, social, video, awards, paid search, and AI-search content, plus marketing automation.
  • Real autonomy: you set your own schedule and methods, and deliver against an agreed scope and content calendar.

What You'll Do

Communications, PR & Research Visibility

  • Manage all communications for the agency's own research, studies, and related content.
  • Lead PR outreach to secure media coverage for that research and those studies.
  • Write, format, and distribute press releases through PR Newswire.

Social, Video & Content

  • Create and publish social media content according to the content calendar.
  • Produce and edit short-form video for social, blogs, and other channels.
  • Write GEO-friendly (generative engine optimization) content so the agency's research surfaces in AI search and answer engines.

Awards, Paid Search & Automation

  • Manage the awards program: identify opportunities, write and submit entries, promote wins, and coordinate trophy orders.
  • Plan, manage, and optimize PPC campaigns, with performance and spend reporting.
  • Build and maintain AI-powered automations for content production, distribution, and reporting.
  • Provide weekly or biweekly updates on progress and results.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, communications, or PR, ideally with or for an agency.
  • Strong writing across press releases, award submissions, social, and long-form content.
  • Experience with media pitching and securing coverage.
  • Hands-on video production and editing (Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, or similar).
  • Hands-on PPC experience (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads).
  • Familiarity with PR Newswire or other wire services.
  • Experience with GEO/AEO and SEO for AI search.
  • Experience building marketing automations with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier, Make, or similar).
  • Self-directed and organized, able to manage a broad scope without close day-to-day supervision.
  • C1 English (excellent spoken and written English).
  • Based in Latin America or North America, and able to work fully remotely.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:
  • Strong writing across press releases, award submissions, social, and long-form content.
  • Experience with media pitching and a track record of securing coverage.
  • Hands-on video production and editing.
  • Hands-on PPC experience (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads).
  • Familiarity with PR Newswire or other wire services.
  • Working knowledge of GEO/AEO and SEO for AI-driven search.
  • Experience building marketing automations with AI tools.
  • Ability to work in a self-directed way and manage a broad, multi-channel scope without close day-to-day supervision.
  • At least 3 years of experience in marketing, communications, or PR, ideally in an agency setting.
  • C1 spoken and written English.
  • Availability to work fully remotely from Latin America or North America.

How Success Is Measured

  • The agency's research and studies earn consistent media coverage and stay visible.
  • Social content stays on calendar, and short-form video supports the right channels.
  • Press releases are accurate, well formatted, and distributed on time through the wire.
  • The awards program runs smoothly: opportunities are captured, entries are submitted, wins are promoted, and trophy orders are coordinated.
  • PPC campaigns improve over time, with clear performance and spend reporting.
  • GEO-friendly content helps the agency's research surface in AI search and answer engines.
  • Marketing workflows become more efficient as AI-powered automations are built and maintained.
  • Stakeholders stay informed through clear, timely weekly or biweekly updates, and the agreed scope and content calendar are delivered.

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote opportunity from Latin America or North America.
  • Competitive compensation: $1,000–$1,300 USD/week, depending on experience.
  • An ongoing contract supporting the brand and visibility of a leading independent agency.
  • A results-focused culture that values adaptation, impact, and people who want to create what comes next.

Important Notes

Applications may not be considered if candidates:
  • Are not based in Latin America or North America.
  • Do not have at least 3 years of experience in marketing, communications, or PR.
  • Do not have C1 spoken and written English, or cannot show strong writing across press releases, social, and long-form content.
  • Do not have hands-on video production and editing experience, or hands-on PPC experience.
  • Are not comfortable working in a self-directed way, without close day-to-day supervision.

jobs.description:
Cerro Wire LLC

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

At Marmon Electrical, we power a bright future for millions of people around the world. From homes to industries that shape lives, we deliver solutions that keep people connected and energized—and it all starts with you. We’re doing things that matter. Our electrical engineering solutions impact millions worldwide through safe and dependable energy supply. We deliver electrical solutions from the ocean depths to outer space. As part of Marmon, you’re helping keep millions worldwide healthy, connected and safe.


Cerrowire®, a Marmon/Berkshire Hathaway company, is a leading U.S. copper wire supplier for residential, commercial and industrial applications. In addition to rugged and dependable, guaranteed products, including MC cables and aluminum wires, the Cerrowire focus is on customer service and delivering on time and in full from our wire manufacturing plants in Alabama, Georgia, Indiana, and Utah. We create our quality products in our new, state-of-the-art MC cable plant. As part of the Marmon Electrical family of companies, Cerrowire benefits from the financial strength, operational discipline, and long-term ownership philosophy of Berkshire Hathaway while maintaining the focused, entrepreneurial operating culture of a market leader in its category.


The Enterprise Data Solutions Manager builds the governed data products, Power BI solutions and applied AI tools that Cerrowire teams use to make decisions. Working in Microsoft Fabric and Azure AI Foundry, this role turns established business requirements into production solutions and owns technical delivery from design through support.


The role’s primary focus is the gold layer: semantic models, standardized metrics and the BI and AI experiences built on them. The Senior Data Engineer owns ingestion through the silver layer; this role owns everything users consume from there. The successful candidate brings solid Fabric, SQL and Python skills, hands-on generative AI experience, and the judgment to build AI that is secure, measurable and cost-aware.


Why Join Us?

  • Health Benefits effective day one (Life, Health, Dental, Vision)
  • Holiday pay effective day one
  • Vacation and Personal Time Off (prorated & accrued)
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Employee Discount Program
  • Six Sigma & Lean Training
  • Learning & Development Training
  • 401k with company matching

Key Responsibilities:

Data & Analytics

  • Build and maintain gold-layer data products, semantic models and standardized business metrics in Microsoft Fabric, partnering with the Senior Data Engineer on upstream pipelines.
  • Develop Power BI reports and Copilot-enabled experiences that let users securely interact with governed datasets.
  • Implement usage telemetry and adoption dashboards for BI, automation and AI tools, and recommend improvements based on usage patterns.

Applied AI & Automation

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions and agentic workflows using Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot and other approved enterprise AI platforms.
  • Build and maintain embeddings, vector stores and grounding strategies that connect AI solutions to governed data.
  • Evaluate AI solutions for retrieval quality, groundedness, reliability, latency and usability, and build in monitoring, logging, error handling and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Automate business processes with Power Automate and Power Apps where they are the right fit.

Security & Governance

  • Apply data classification, PII handling and access controls, including row-level security and Entra ID, to every BI and AI solution.
  • Design AI solutions to resist prompt injection and limit agent permissions to the minimum required.
  • Serve as a technical resource in Data & AI governance and use-case reviews.

Delivery & Standards

  • Own technical delivery once requirements are approved: design, development, testing, deployment, documentation and production support.
  • Follow SDLC practices, including Git version control, Fabric deployment pipelines, testing, release management and documentation of designs, data definitions, lineage and runbooks.
  • Build reusable components, templates and prompt patterns that speed future development.
  • Run proofs of concept and make evidence-based technology recommendations covering fit, security, scalability and cost, including Fabric capacity and AI consumption.

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Work with analysts, the Senior Data Engineer, plant and business stakeholders, and vendors on design, implementation and knowledge transfer.
  • Mentor peers through design and code reviews, and lead demos and office hours that build practical adoption of data and AI.

What Success Looks Like:

First 6 months

  • A gold-layer semantic model and Power BI solution in production on Fabric, adopted by its business users.
  • A first AI solution (RAG or agent) piloted with defined evaluation metrics and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Documented development, testing and deployment standards for the team’s Fabric and AI work.

About the Role

The QA Specialist leads the quality review work instead of doing every review. You will source, onboard, support, and audit a network of independent (1099) reviewers, define the rules our QAi tool checks on each claim, and act as the account expert and client escalation point. You use your own judgment to set the quality standard, decide whether work meets it, and decide how files are assigned.

You complete reviews yourself only after the leading work is done, and none during busy periods.

What You'll Do

  • Build the reviewer network: source and vet independent (1099) reviewers, working with leadership and recruiting, including confirming licensing and qualifications.
  • Onboard: create and maintain onboarding materials on carrier guidelines, account requirements, and our quality standards for independent reviewers.
  • Be the point of contact: answer independent reviewer questions on carrier guidelines and account requirements so files keep moving.
  • Audit and evaluate: audit completed 1099 work product against quality standards, give feedback on deliverables, and use quality and turnaround data to decide how files are assigned, including offering more files or ending an engagement.
  • Assign files: offer and assign files across the independent reviewer network so carrier deadlines are met, including in busy periods.
  • Set the QAi rules: define the rules QAi checks on each claim. You work with IT, who build and configure the tool.
  • Own your accounts: be the knowledge expert for the accounts you handle, including carrier guidelines, authority limits, and preferred systems.
  • Handle escalations: be the escalation point for files for the client, taking the load off field leaders and account executives.
  • Work the file: update the estimate based on the carrier rules and the photos provided, using your license in that state and the carrier's preferred system, such as Xactimate.
  • Review last: complete reviews when everything else is done. In busy periods, none. In slow periods or on tight timelines, you may review.
  • Measure the work: track process and time to complete tasks. This role manages quality and cycle time, not cost.

Availability

  • You are available during core business hours and peak periods, so reviewer questions and client escalations get answered while files are moving.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Strong quality judgment on residential property claims.
  • Working knowledge of carrier guidelines and account requirements.
  • Estimating skill in Xactimate or the carrier's preferred system, and an active adjuster license.
  • Comfort auditing work product and giving quality feedback to independent reviewers.
  • Ability to use data to judge quality and time in process.
  • Clear communication and accountability with clients, leaders, and 1099 reviewers.
  • Interest in how rules and systems drive automation.

How success is measured

Measures for leading the independent reviewer network and QAi are being built with leadership and will be shared before the roles go live.

Job Description: Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineer

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineers to contribute their expertise to a project focused on advanced inspection and measurement solutions.

In this role, you will help train and evaluate next-generation AI systems by providing high-quality, real-world metrology expertise. You will review and produce first-article inspection (FAI) deliverables using 3D scanning and advanced metrology software. Your work will involve validating scan-to-CAD comparisons, datum setups, and profile and position callouts while ensuring dimensional accuracy.

You will also assess whether measurement deviations result from actual part discrepancies or from fixturing and alignment artefacts, providing valuable technical insights to support FAI report reviews and sign-off decisions. Prior AI experience is not required; relevant industry expertise is what matters.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Review and validate first-article inspection (FAI) reports generated from 3D scan data.
  2. Perform detailed scan-to-CAD comparisons and analyze dimensional deviations and their potential causes.
  3. Establish, interpret, and document datum structures, profile tolerances, and position callouts in accordance with applicable industry standards.
  4. Apply Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) techniques and conduct measurement uncertainty analysis.
  5. Distinguish actual part deviations from artefacts caused by fixturing, alignment, or measurement setup issues.
  6. Provide clear, detailed written and verbal feedback to support FAI review and sign-off decisions.
  7. Contribute accurate and specialized metrology insights to support AI system development and evaluation.

Required and Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) and first-article inspection processes within manufacturing or quality environments.

Working at NLR

NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.

Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.



Job Description

The Geospatial Data Science (GDS) team within the Strategic Energy Analysis Center at the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) is seeking a 6–12-month intern to support modeling and analysis. The GDS group conducts research at the intersection of energy deployment, big data science, and geospatial modeling and visualization. Our team of researchers develops and applies geospatial algorithms and methods to evaluate the deployment potential for energy technologies, including geothermal, hydropower, transmission, bioenergy, wind, and solar. Geospatial modeling at NLR enables detailed techno-economic assessment, capacity expansion, and power systems modeling of energy resources under a variety of regulatory, sociopolitical, and environmental factors from local to continental scales.

The successful intern candidate will support a large and diverse modeling portfolio with activities involving geospatial analyses, literature reviews, cartography, scientific programming, and tasks focused on data preparation, processing, and validation. This position will assist geospatial scientists in developing novel analytical solutions to complex challenges in energy siting, deployment, and adoption. Candidates should be interested in working in an interdisciplinary field, together with geospatial data scientists, software developers, and policy analysts, which will require excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Duties will include:

  • Manipulating multiple data sources, models, and software tools with scientific and engineering workflows for decision support and data analysis
  • Preparing and processing geospatial data using open-source desktop software and programmatic approaches
  • Conducting background research on data sets, current modeling approaches, and existing tools
  • Developing literature reviews under the guidance of research scientists
  • Programming and scripting in Python to conduct analysis and visualize data
  • Working in distributed computing environments including internal servers, NLR's high-performance computing (HPC) system and the Cloud

About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we help improve the quality and reliability of clinical trial data by providing specialized clinical assessment, training, and quality oversight solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies around the world.

Our team partners with sponsors and research sites to support the consistent administration, scoring, and review of clinical outcome assessments across global clinical trials. Through services including central scoring, central review, image-based review, rater training and certification, calibration, and quality review and remediation, we help reduce variability, strengthen data quality, and ensure greater confidence in clinical trial endpoints.

Our work spans multiple therapeutic areas, including dermatology, where we engage experienced clinicians to bring indication-specific and scale-specific expertise to clinical trial programs. Our experts help ensure assessments are performed and evaluated consistently, from training and certifying site raters to centrally reviewing scores and images and identifying opportunities for remediation.

Our global team brings together clinical, scientific, operational, data, and technology expertise to solve complex challenges in clinical trials. At Cogstate, our goal is simple: to help sponsors generate high-quality, reliable data that supports confident decision-making throughout clinical development.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

About the Role

Cogstate is seeking experienced Dermatologists to support clinical research studies through a range of centralized assessment and quality oversight services. In this fully remote, contract-based role, clinicians may perform Central Scoring, Central Review, Image-Based Review, Site Rater Training & Certification, Calibration Activities, and Quality Review & Remediation across a variety of dermatology clinical trials.

Cogstate provides comprehensive, fully compensated training on study protocols, scoring methodologies, review processes, and operational requirements before clinicians begin study work. Ongoing calibration exercises and quality oversight activities help ensure consistency, reliability, and regulatory compliance across all study assessments.

Depending on study needs and individual expertise, consultants may contribute to one or more service areas, including:

  • Central Scoring: Independent scoring and interpretation of dermatology-specific clinician-reported and observer-reported outcome measures.
  • Central Review: Secondary review of completed assessments to ensure accuracy, consistency, and protocol adherence.
  • Image-Based Review: Evaluation of clinical photographs and imaging data to assess disease severity, treatment response, and endpoint compliance.
  • Site Rater Training & Certification: Training, certifying, and supporting site-based raters on proper scale administration and scoring procedures.
  • Calibration Activities: Participating in ongoing calibration exercises to maintain inter-rater reliability and scoring consistency across global studies.
  • Quality Review & Remediation: Identifying assessment quality issues, providing corrective feedback, and supporting remediation efforts to improve data quality and protocol compliance.

These are fully-remote, contract positions. Work is provided on an as-needed basis and scheduled according to clinician availability.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD or DO with specialization in Dermatology.
  • Board-certified or board-eligible Dermatologist preferred.
  • Active and unrestricted medical license in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of post-training clinical practice experience in dermatology.
  • Experience evaluating and managing patients with dermatologic conditions in clinical, academic, or research settings.
  • Demonstrated experience with dermatology clinical outcome assessments, disease severity scales, and clinician-reported outcome measures.
  • Experience with one or more dermatology indications such as atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, vitiligo, hidradenitis suppurativa, alopecia areata, prurigo nodularis, eczema, chronic pruritus, or other inflammatory and rare dermatologic disorders.
  • Familiarity with dermatology rating scales and assessments such as EASI, IGA, SCORAD, PASI, DLQI, VASI, PP-NRS, HiSCR, CDLQI, and other study-specific outcome measures.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently apply scoring criteria and identify assessment quality issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide training, feedback, and remediation guidance to site personnel.
  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and web-based clinical trial systems.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

jobs.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- MADRS Administration Experience Required
- Dutch Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Dutch Fluency
  • MADRS Administration Experience Required

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

jobs.excerpt: About the jobThe SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center.
jobs.description:
About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

Position Overview

Independent and small multi-unit restaurants run their restaurants on HotSchedules. This role makes sure they get value fast, use more of what they already own, and become fanatical advocates of our product.

You will own adoption and retention marketing for our SMB base, from first week to fifth year, as a joint plan with our Customer Success and Customer Care teams, and you will share the product adoption target with Customer Success. In SMB, retention is won at scale, so you will build programs that run without a person on every account.

  • Onboarding and adoption. In-app messaging, lifecycle email and journeys, built with Product, that get new customers live and using the modules that predict they stay.

  • Retention programs. Save and win-back plays, renewal communications and at-risk outreach, built with Customer Success and Customer Care on shared data.

  • Customer contact calendar. Own the calendar of every marketing touch to customers, so they hear from us at the right moments. You decide which customers get asked for reviews, references or new products, and when.

  • Customer communications. Product updates, release notes and the customer newsletter, written for a busy owner on a phone between shifts.

  • Customer voice. Regular surveys and NPS, with themes routed to Product, Customer Success and Product Marketing.

You will work closely with our two demand generation managers. One runs reviews, referrals and case studies to win new customers; the other owns cross-sell and up-sell pipeline. You own adoption, retention and the customer calendar that keeps all of it coordinated.


Key Skills and Competencies

  • 4+ years in B2B customer marketing, lifecycle marketing or retention, ideally with SMB or high-volume customer bases.

  • Hands-on with marketing automation and in-app messaging tools, and comfortable building journeys yourself.

  • Strong, plain-spoken writing for non-technical owners and managers.

  • Comfort with data: you can pull a cohort, read a churn curve and explain what changed.

  • A builder mindset. Some of these programs do not exist yet.

Preferred Experience and/or Qualifications

  • Restaurant or hospitality experience, either working in one or marketing to them.

  • Experience driving feature adoption in a multi-product SaaS customer base.

  • Experience with Braze or similar customer engagement platforms.

  • Experience with fintech or payroll products used by hourly workers.

Measures of Success

Your first 90 days

  1. Map the current SMB customer journey and every message a customer gets in year one. Kill what does not help.

  1. Launch an adoption journey for one module customers underuse, with a measured baseline.

What success looks like at 12 months

  • Product adoption at target, shared with Customer Success, with measurable gains in the cohorts your programs touch.

  • Lower early-life churn and better gross retention in those cohorts.

  • One customer calendar every team uses, with fewer, better-timed customer touches.

🏖 Unlimited PTO!

🏥 Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance!

🏦 401k Match!

👥 Parental Leave

💻 Laptop and equipment.

In July 2019, Fourth joined forces with HotSchedules to become the global leader in end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology solutions. As Customer Value Consultant, you will be the primary post-sales owner for customer success, helping customers realize measurable business value from their investment in Tricentis. Success is measured through customer value realization, adoption, portfolio health, retention performance, executive alignment, and the expansion opportunities that follow demonstrated value.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Own the Customer Success Plan for each customer, defining outcomes, milestones, and accountable actions that connect adoption to measurable business value.
  • Drive value realization by evidencing progress against agreed outcomes and translating adoption and utilization data into credible ROI narratives.

  • Convert technology adoption into measurable business outcomes and credible executive value narratives.
  • Apply the right depth of engagement across a portfolio that varies by value, complexity, risk, and segment.
  • Surface and address adoption gaps and stakeholder changes early enough to protect renewals and trusted relationships.
  • Connect retention priorities and expansion opportunities so that growth follows demonstrated value.
  • Align internal teams and partner organizations around shared customer outcomes, clear ownership, and clean handoffs, while respecting partner delivery boundaries on Co-Sell accounts.

SKILLS FOR SUCCESS


Required Skills

  • Customer success and value realization: Demonstrated success improving adoption, demonstrating customer value, and managing a portfolio of recurring-revenue customers, typically across 5 to 8+ years in Customer Success, Value Consulting, Account Management, Technical Account Management, or a comparable enterprise SaaS post-sales role.

Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

jobs.description:
About the Role

The Wales RESP needs to reflect national characteristics and priorities, driving whole energy considerations across all energy vectors. Think renewables, heat decarbonisation, hydrogen, energy networks, transport and flexibility! And how Wales needs differ, yet come together with the other nation and regions to form the Great British energy plan.

To achieve this, we have national and regional based teams – to work alongside our other teams in forming the hub and spokes needed for energy planning to benefit from and reflect local inputs.

Developing the RESP will require us to work with organisations at a local level (‘local actors’) including local government and gas and electricity networks, to improve understanding of the infrastructure needed in different parts of the country and attract investment for projects. Stakeholder engagement will be key to unlocking the benefits of integrated regional energy planning.

The purpose of this job is to lead engagement with technical audiences and coordinating technical and data interfaces with the Hub and other national / regional teams in developing RESPs.

Having an understanding and lived experience of Wales will be key.

Our focus in the immediate term is to build trust with our stakeholders, establish our process and methodology, and grow our capability in whole energy systems to best support local actors and industry stakeholders in developing credible plans to support net zero.

Climate change is the challenge of a generation, and the time to act is now. Join us and you won’t just be touching the lives of almost everyone in Great Britain – you will be shaping the way we use and consume energy for generations to come.

Key Accountabilities

  • Own and understand technical specific aspects of Wales’ energy system planning inputs into developing the RESP – e.g., understanding the data flows and design of the RESP products, as well as understanding the whole energy system (electricity networks, gas networks, other vectors)
  • Develop, consult and implement parts of the RESP methodology within Wales
  • Ownership of obtaining and validating national geospatial energy inputs
  • Work in matrix style structure within the wider RESP team
  • Represent NESO’s RESP function to local government and energy stakeholders
  • Understand, engage and gain required and beneficial inputs from stakeholders
  • Work with the Hub team in developing geospatial visualisations to support national insights
  • Create new ways to analyse and present problems and potential solutions

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK by the start of employment. Visa sponsorship may not be available for this role and will be considered in line with business requirements.

About You

We’re forging the path, and we know we cannot do it alone. That is why we need visionary minds like yours to join us on this transformative journey. In this case, we are looking for someone who has:

  • Understanding and lived experience of Wales
  • Technical experience within and knowledge of the energy sector, including of energy scenarios
  • Understanding of the ‘whole energy system’ with experience in one of the energy vectors
  • Experience working with or within energy distribution and/or transmission companies
  • Understanding and experience of geospatial data modelling, ideally applied in energy planning
  • Understanding and experience of applying comment methods and assumptions and validation of data
  • Ability to translate complex and technical information into easily understandable messaging for non-technical audiences
  • Experience of communicating with and influencing internal and external stakeholders
  • Project management, coordination and planning skills
  • An inquisitive mind with the ability to join the dots and a willingness to learn

What You'll Get

A competitive salary of £56,000 - £66,000 dependent on experience and capabilityAs well as your base salary, NESO's core benefits are the essential perks and advantages that form part of your employee package. - You will receive a bonus based on company performance- 26 days annual leave as standard - A competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. - Annual Enrollment to NESO Savings Plan, when you save between £20- £500 a month from your take-home pay, we will pay a 50% matching contribution.

NESO's flexible benefits programme provides you with more flexibility around your health, lifestyle and protection benefits, here's just a few available:
- Flexible Bank Holidays & Holiday Trading

- Additional Birthday Day Off

  • Cycle to Work Scheme, Retail & Gym Discounts
    - Private Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance & Personal Accident Insurance

About Us


At the National Energy System Operator (NESO), we play a vital role in tackling climate change and securing Great Britain's energy future. We already operate the world's fastest decarbonising electricity system and are working towards our ambition to run it carbon-free for a short period this year - provided the market supplies electricity exclusively from renewable sources. Alongside this, we provide expert advice to government on how to deliver a clean power system by 2030.

In autumn 2024, the Electricity System Operator (ESO) transitioned to become NESO - an independent, expert public corporation with a whole-system view across electricity, gas, and hydrogen. NESO operates independently and transparently, always acting in the best interests of all energy users.

Licensed and regulated by Ofgem, we make impartial decisions that balance sustainability, affordability and security. Our organisation is fully independent from government, the regulator and all commercial interests, with a clear focus on system-wide benefit, long term thing and public value.

The time to deliver is now. Join the energy transformation and help shape the future.

Your energy. Our future. Together


National Energy System Operator (NESO) recognises the potential of bright and talented individuals, and we encourage you to join us as Great Britain’s energy system undergoes an ambitious, exciting, and vital transformation. Together with industry, we are creating a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a proactive, hands-on Cloud Security Engineer to serve as the primary security partner for our Engineering and DevOps teams.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a proactive, hands-on Cloud Security Engineer to serve as the primary security partner for our Engineering and DevOps teams. In this role, you will be the "North Star" for secure cloud configuration, moving beyond simple alert triaging to building sustainable security foundations. You will bridge the gap between high-level security architecture and daily engineering execution, ensuring our AWS and Azure environments are resilient, compliant, and automated.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Cloud Governance & Guardrails: Lead the deployment and optimization of AWS Control Tower, Security Hub, and AWS WAF to establish a secure multi-account strategy.

  • Cloud Security Platform Ownership: Own cloud security outcomes across AWS (primary), Azure (secondary), and limited GCP, including secure landing zone standards, guardrails-as-code, detection coverage, and remediation automation.

  • Secure-by-Default Engineering: Design and implement reusable, secure-by-default cloud patterns that allow engineering teams to deploy safely without constant security intervention. Establish hardened Terraform modules, reference architectures, and baseline configurations so the secure path becomes the easiest path for teams building in AWS.

  • Container Security: Collaborate with the AppSec Architect to secure EKS and ECS environments, focusing on runtime protection, image scanning, and least-privilege orchestration.

  • Security Assessment & Roadmap: Perform a comprehensive baseline assessment of the current cloud environment to identify gaps and provide actionable, prioritized recommendations.

  • Identity & Access Management: Lead design and enforcement of least-privilege IAM architecture across AWS accounts and workloads.

  • Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain secure configuration standards, documentation, and operational procedures that enable engineering teams to consistently deploy and operate cloud services securely.

  • Detection & Telemetry Ownership: Partner with security operations to ensure security telemetry from AWS environments is complete, centralized, and actionable (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow logs, etc.)

  • Cloud Security & Compliance Alignment: Ensure cloud configurations and controls align with internal security standards and external compliance requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc.). Partner with Security and GRC teams to implement audit-ready controls, automate evidence collection where possible, and maintain clear documentation of cloud security control coverage.

  • Third-Party Integration: Manage secure access and configuration for security vendor tools (vulnerability scanners, assessment platforms, etc.) within the cloud environment.

  • Incident Response: Participate in an on-call rotation for one week at a time and serve as primary SME for cloud security incidents (IAM compromise, exposed keys, misconfigurations, etc.).

  • Vulnerability & Exposure Management: Build and run the cloud vulnerability management program for AWS and Azure workloads, container images, and base AMIs. Define severity-based SLAs, implement scalable scanning and patch workflows (e.g., AWS Inspector, ECR scanning, hardened base images), and partner with Engineering to reduce exploitable exposure.

  • Cloud Security Tooling Ownership: Own onboarding, coverage validation, and tuning of CSPM and MDR integrations across AWS, Azure and GCP. Drive measurable improvement in signal quality, alert fidelity, and remediation workflows through automation and engineering partnerships.

  • Secrets, Keys, and Credential Hygiene: Design and enforce secure secrets management patterns (AWS Secrets Manager/Parameter Store/Vault), automated rotation, and least-privilege secret access. Own KMS key strategy and governance (key policies, grants, rotation, separation of duties) and ensure no long-lived credentials in CI/CD.

  • CI/CD and Supply Chain Security: Secure the software delivery pipeline end-to-end, including identity federation for CI/CD, policy-as-code enforcement for Terraform and Kubernetes, artifact integrity controls (signing/provenance), and secure dependency/source controls. Ensure security guardrails are automated and developer-friendly.

  • Cloud Incident Readiness & Exercises: Build cloud-native incident playbooks (IAM compromise, crypto-mining, data exposure, suspicious network activity) and run periodic tabletop exercises. Ensure forensics readiness through log retention standards, immutable/auditable logging where appropriate, snapshot/containment procedures, and break-glass access controls.

  • Multi-Cloud & Hybrid Baselines: Establish minimum viable security baselines for Azure and GCP (identity, logging, storage, network, key management) and ensure telemetry parity into centralized detection. Partner with operation teams to secure hybrid connectivity with data center environments (segmentation, identity boundaries, secure administrative access).

  • Security Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Define and report on key cloud security metrics (coverage, misconfiguration trends, MTTR, control adoption, vulnerability SLAs). Use metrics to prioritize work, demonstrate risk reduction, and drive engineering alignment.

  • Leadership and Execution: Mentor other engineers and raise baseline security literacy in platform/DevOps teams through patterns, reviews, and internal enablement.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Information Security, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on AWS Cloud Security.

  • AWS Deep Dive: Deep hands-on experience designing and securing AWS environments, core services (IAM, VPC, S3, KMS) and security-specific services (GuardDuty, Inspector, Config).

  • IaC Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform for managing cloud infrastructure.

  • Containerization: Proven experience securing containerized workloads in EKS or ECS.

  • Azure Knowledge: Willingness to provide basic security support/maintenance for an existing Azure environment (Deep expertise not required; AWS is the priority).

  • Consultative Mindset: Ability to assess a complex environment and provide a "roadmap to green" rather than just identifying problems.

  • Collaborative Partnership: Ability to work side-by-side with engineers, speaking their language and helping them solve problems rather than just "blocking" tickets.

  • Strategic Documentation: Capability to translate technical configurations into clear, repeatable processes and procedures.

  • Automation First: A drive to automate manual security tasks to increase efficiency and reduce human error.

  • Education/Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field or equivalent work experience.

  • Industry certifications such as Azure security certification, AWS Certified Security – Specialty or related are highly desirable.

jobs.description:
About Smartwyre

Founded in 2018, Smartwyre is a venture-financed SaaS business delivering enterprise software to large agricultural businesses, operating in a $400 billion global industry. With an estimated 5 million farmers and over 5,000 distributors globally, Smartwyre works across the agricultural supply chain, from large corporations to local farms. Presently, we work from the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, and South America.

We are building a B2B SaaS platform to network together the commercial operations of the companies that supply the world’s farmers with seeds, fertilizer, chemicals, and services, with their target markets being the United States, Europe, and Latin America. We aim to first offer SaaS applications to solve key commercial pain points (pricing, costing, quoting), then network these companies using a common data platform (transactional data exchange, product information publication, people networking, and user analytics), and finally empower the network to facilitate new business model amongst network participants.

About the role

  • Overview: A remote, permanent, full-time Cloud Platform Team Lead reporting to the SVP of Engineering, requiring working-hours overlap across the UK and US. You will lead the cloud team and own the Azure platform.
  • The Mission: A hands-on role combining infrastructure design and operations with team leadership. You will provide secure hosting for internal agents and MCP workloads, own SOC 2 infrastructure compliance, and drive developer self-service so other teams can deploy independently.

What you'll do

  • Hands-On Infrastructure & Terraform: Design, write, and review modular Terraform across multiple environments, and operate core production Azure services (App Service, Functions, PostgreSQL, Key Vault).
  • Developer Self-Service & CI/CD: Build versioned infrastructure templates and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) to empower engineering teams to provision and deploy services independently.
  • AI & Agentic Workloads: Own secure, repeatable hosting and deployment patterns for internal agents and MCP workloads, partnering with Architecture on network guardrails and cost controls.
  • Team Leadership & Delivery: Run team ceremonies, 1:1s, performance reviews, and capacity planning while actively mentoring and developing engineers.
  • Security & SOC 2 Compliance: Maintain first-class cloud security (least-privilege IAM, network isolation) and own the infrastructure controls, audit evidence, and pen-test remediation for SOC 2.
  • FinOps & Cost Reporting: Track cloud spend, drive optimisations (reservations, rightsizing), and coordinate consolidated monthly cost reports across Azure, Snowflake, and Estuary.

Experience

  • Proven experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps, including leading engineers and owning team delivery.
  • Strong production experience with Azure across multiple subscriptions and environments (networking, Entra ID identity, PaaS data services, cost management).
  • Expert-level Terraform skills (reusable modules, state management, multi-environment deployments, line-by-line plan review).
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps, plus reusable infrastructure patterns for other teams.
  • Strong scripting capabilities in PowerShell, Bash, or Python (heavy usage of PowerShell).
  • Hands-on security and compliance experience (SOC 2 or ISO 27001 control ownership, audit evidence, access reviews, pen test remediation).
  • Demonstrated leadership in capacity planning, developing engineers, driving adoption, and engaging senior stakeholders.
  • Practical background in platform monitoring, incident response, backups, and tested recovery procedures.
  • Clear written communication skills for RFCs, runbooks, and executive reports, alongside participation in on-call rotations.

Desirable

  • Experience with AI/agent platforms (Azure AI Foundry, MCP) and daily use of AI coding assistants.
  • Deep PostgreSQL operations and FinOps practice.
  • Containerisation proficiency (Docker, Azure Container Apps) and monitoring expertise (Grafana, Azure Monitor, SLOs).

Short Term / Long Term Disability Cover (US)

Critical Illness and Income Protection (UK)

Self-directed PTO

Flexible Work Location
