About the Role
We are seeking an experienced, systems-driven Wholesale Operations Manager to take full leadership of our Wholesale and Order Capturing operations. In this role, you will directly manage, mentor, and govern distributed teams while owning the end-to-end operational pipeline for all wholesale and retail partner orders—from initial inquiry and order capture to invoice generation, payment tracking, and global warehouse dispatch.
You will serve as the operational bridge connecting internal teams, international retail buyers, global 3PL/warehouse hubs, and finance stakeholders. If you excel at managing remote personnel, driving daily accountability, building rock-solid Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), eliminating fulfillment bottlenecks, and steering teams toward zero-error order accuracy, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
1. End-to-End People & Team Management
  • Directly manage, develop, and supervise the Wholesale and Capturing Team across multiple shifts and international time zones.
  • Establish clear daily operational expectations, individual task allocations, and attendance/output benchmarks across all team members.
  • Lead structured weekly 1-on-1s, pod standups, performance calibrations, and hands-on coaching sessions to ensure high accountability and engagement.
  • Monitor pod capacity, balance workloads during peak retail cycles, and oversee onboarding, training, and continuous skills development for new and existing team hires.
  • Track individual and pod-level KPIs, holding team members accountable for order accuracy rate (>99%), first-response turnaround time (TAT), and SLA adherence.
2. Buyer Communication & Warehouse Alignment
  • Supervise team interactions with all B2B retail buyers, guaranteeing timely, professional, and accurate responses regarding order statuses, inventory availability, shipping updates, and custom account requirements.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for buyer inquiries, resolving complex logistics issues and maintaining high buyer satisfaction.
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison with global warehouse and 3PL teams to coordinate stock allocations, pack-and-ship timelines, and custom dispatch schedules.
  • Rapidly troubleshoot and direct team resolution on shipment discrepancies, backorders, damages, or transit delays with logistics partners.
3. SOP Architecture & Process Optimization
  • Author, maintain, and continuously refine detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) spanning order capture, verification, buyer communication, warehouse dispatch, and returns/claims.
  • Enforce strict team compliance with documented SOPs, ensuring workflow standardization across all account coordinators.
  • Continuously audit workflows to identify manual bottlenecks, streamline communication loops, and implement process improvements that shorten order fulfillment cycles as volume scales.
4. Invoicing, Payment Tracking & Reconciliation
  • Ensure all wholesale and retail commercial invoices, credit memos, and packing lists are accurately generated, logged, and organized by the capturing team.
  • Supervise the recording and tracking of incoming buyer payments, matching settlements against open purchase orders to prevent documentation gaps.
  • Partner directly with internal Bookkeeping and Accounting teams to facilitate timely payment reconciliations and resolve billing disputes promptly.
  • Identify, audit, and escalate payment or credit anomalies directly to executive leadership.
Qualifications & Requirements
  • 5+ Years of Operations Experience: Proven background in B2B wholesale operations, retail order management, or e-commerce supply chain operations.
  • Direct People Management Track Record: Minimum 2–3 years of proven experience directly managing, supervising, and coaching distributed remote teams (customer support, order capturing, or operations coordinators).
  • Performance & Accountability Driven: Demonstrated experience running performance evaluations, conducting 1-on-1s, managing team SLAs, and handling corrective action or workload reallocations.
  • Logistics & 3PL Literacy: Direct experience liaising with third-party logistics (3PL) providers, freight forwarders, and warehouse teams across multiple geographic hubs.
  • Financial & Billing Acumen: Solid experience with B2B commercial invoicing, payment term tracking (Net terms, wire transfers, deposits), and working alongside bookkeeping teams on reconciliations.
  • SOP & Systems Mastery: Proven ability to build clear, scalable SOPs, process maps, and workflow automations using modern tools (Lark/Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, ERP/WMS platforms).
  • Communication & Fluency: Exceptional written and verbal business English communication skills, with experience managing professional relationships with international retail accounts and leading internal team alignments.
  • Autonomous & Detail-Oriented: Highly structured mindset with an uncompromising standard for documentation, protocol-driven execution, and zero-error order entry.
What We Offer
  • 100% Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with a structured, asynchronous operational rhythm.
  • High-Impact Leadership: Direct autonomy to lead teams and shape operational infrastructure for high-growth global consumer brands.
  • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside dedicated executive leadership, creative minds, and operational specialists.
How to Apply
Please submit your resume along with a brief cover note detailing:
  1. Your experience managing remote teams (team size, structure, and how you manage day-to-day accountability and SLAs).
  2. Your background managing B2B wholesale order lifecycles and coordinating with 3PL warehouses.
  3. The operational tools/ERPs you have used to manage inventory, invoicing, and order capture.
  4. An example of an SOP or process workflow you built that measurably improved accuracy or turnaround time.

  • ведення реєстру доменів у Jira Assets, документації, процедур, автоматизація перевірок і сповіщень.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • 3+ роки досвіду в управлінні доменами та DNS; портфель із кількох сотень доменів у різних реєстраторів;

  • досвід в iGaming: дзеркала, блокування доменів, ліцензійні домени;

  • практичний досвід із трансфером доменів, продовженням, відновленням після закінчення терміну дії (redemption) та оновленням WHOIS;

  • глибокі знання DNS: делегування, ns, типи записів (A, CNAME, MX, TXT), ttl, діагностика за допомогою dig/nslookup;

  • досвід роботи з cloudflare: зони, nameserver'и, керування доступами та api-токени;

  • ssl/tls-сертифікати: типи, методи валідації (DNS, HTTP, email), продовження, усунення несправностей;

  • верифікація доменів у зовнішніх сервісах через DNS-записи;

  • самостійність, досвід роботи з документацією.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • Terraform (провайдер Cloudflare), автоматизація через api реєстраторів і cloudflare (python або bash);

  • Jira Assets / Insight, Jira Service Management;

  • опрацювання abuse-звернень, UDRP-спорів, запитів на усунення хибнопозитивних спрацювань у security-вендорів;

  • адміністрування доменів у Google Workspace.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

jobs.excerpt: About Extend:Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth.
jobs.description:
About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About The Role

Our Growth & Sales teams hear something new from merchants every day: a coverage gap that cost us a deal, a feature our partners keep asking for, a trend in the data nobody has acted on yet. The way we win is by connecting those signals and turning them into something that will grow revenue for Extend and our merchant partners.

We are looking for a GTM Strategy & Program Manager to own that feedback loop for a portfolio of retail verticals. You will listen to what our merchant partners want and need, decide what is worth building, drive the right teams to build it in a scalable way, and make sure your Pod knows exactly how to sell it. Your success shows up in new deals won, existing partnerships grown, and stronger margins on both.

This is a role for someone who presents ideas without hesitation, can hold a room with leaders, and never settles for not knowing the answer.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the feedback loop. Run a regular cadence with Sales, Growth and Analytics to pull together merchant feedback, win/loss reasons and performance data, and turn it into a clear, prioritized view of what we need to build to win more.
  • Grow the top and bottom line. Find the opportunities that win new merchants and expand existing partnerships, and build the business case for each one in terms of revenue and margin impact.
  • Turn merchant needs into scalable solutions. Listen to what our partners are asking for and shape it into products, features and program offerings that work across your verticals, not one-off custom builds.
  • Run the project plan. Set scope, milestones and owners for every initiative, hold teams accountable to deadlines, and raise risks early when something starts to slip.
  • Know exactly what is being built. Understand every feature well enough to explain how it works, who it is for and where its limits are, from requirements through launch.
  • Enable your Pod. Equip your vertical Pod with the playbooks, talk tracks and training they need to sell and use each new feature, and track adoption after launch.
  • Present with conviction. Pitch new ideas to cross-functional partners, executives and leadership, back your recommendations with data, and drive the decision.
  • Go find the answer. When a question comes up that nobody can answer, dig into the data, the contracts or the market yourself and come back with the answer and a recommendation.

Required Qualifications

  • Relevant experience. 5+ years in GTM Strategy, BizOps, or a similar cross-functional role at a fast-paced tech company.
  • Ownership from idea to launch. You have taken an initiative from a customer or partner need through build, launch and enablement, and can point to the commercial results.
  • Project management discipline. You run several initiatives in parallel, set realistic plans and keep cross-functional teams on deadline without being chased.
  • Executive presence. You put ideas in front of people early and often, present to executives with conviction, and hold your ground when you have the data to back it up.
  • A numbers-first mindset. Advanced Excel and strong analytical skills. You size opportunities, build models and root your recommendations in data.
  • Relentless curiosity. You do not accept "we don't know" as an answer. You go dig it up and report back.
  • An AI-native way of working. You already use AI tools like Claude to research, analyze and move faster, and you pick up new tools quickly.

Nice To Have

  • SQL or BI tool experience
  • Experience in retail, finance, or consulting
  • Exposure to underwriting concepts like frequency, severity and loss ratio

Expected Pay Range: $125,000 - $135,000 per year salaried

*The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

Life at Extend:

  • Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.
  • Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.
  • Generous, flexible paid time off policy.
  • 401(k) with Financial Guidance from Morgan Stanley.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Reference Data team, you will build services that form the data backbone of Alpaca’s brokerage infrastructure. Almost every service at Alpaca needs information about the assets it operates on. Our team provides that information and supports the events that affect those assets throughout their lifecycle.

The team owns two core areas: Security Master, the central source of information about tradable assets, their characteristics and whether, when, and how they can be traded; and corporate actions, which involves ingesting third-party information about dividends, stock splits, mergers and other events, then calculating the changes and transactions needed to reflect them in customer and partner holdings.

You will work across both areas, helping Alpaca enter new markets, expand its portfolio of products and improve the reliability, performance and operability of existing systems. This is a hands-on backend engineering role focused on distributed systems, data modelling and correctness across interconnected services. You will take open-ended problems from scoping and design through implementation, rollout and production support, working closely with the teams that depend on reference data.

Things You Get To Do

  • Design, build and maintain distributed backend services, APIs and data models for Security Master and corporate actions.

  • Extend reference data systems to support new instruments, asset classes and market-specific requirements, including futures and prediction markets.

  • Build reliable workflows for ingesting, validating and processing third-party instrument and corporate action information.

  • Develop internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and improve the reliability of reference data operations.

  • Help redesign how foundational asset information is structured and shared across Alpaca, contributing to architectural decisions with company-wide impact.

  • Work closely with engineering and business teams that consume reference data, coordinating changes across services.

  • Own complex features and technical decisions from design through production, including testing, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • Strong experience building and operating event-driven, distributed backend systems.

  • Strong database and data-modelling skills, with an understanding of eventual consistency and data replication.

  • Excellent system design fundamentals, including designing and evolving APIs.

  • Proficiency in a strongly typed programming language and willingness to work in Go.

  • Experience taking complex or ambiguous problems from initial requirements through delivery and production operation.

  • Ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly, collaborate across teams and reason through cross-system dependencies.

  • Senior-level engineering judgement and ownership; we assess capability and impact rather than applying a fixed years-of-experience threshold.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Experience in trading, brokerage, capital markets, crypto infrastructure or related financial technology.

  • Experience with reference data, Security Master, instrument or asset data, or corporate action processing.

  • Understanding of financial instruments, particularly options, futures and other derivatives.

  • Experience with third-party data ingestion, internal tooling and workflow automation.

  • Experience guiding other engineers and working across interconnected services and teams.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

jobs.title: Director, Data and AI
jobs.excerpt: Help Us Turn Extraordinary Data into Cures St.  Jude is where those with a passion for making a difference come to break new ground.
jobs.description:
Help Us Turn Extraordinary Data into Cures

St. Jude is where those with a passion for making a difference come to break new ground. Located in Memphis, Tennessee, the mission of St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital is to advance cures, and means of prevention, for pediatric catastrophic diseases through research and treatment.

Every day, St. Jude generates some of the most valuable data in pediatric medicine, including genomic and multi omics data, medical images, clinical records, and the operational detail of running a hospital and research institute. We are seeking a Director of Data and AI to take that data further and help make trusted, AI ready data part of how St. Jude works.

This leader will guide the next phase of our enterprise Databricks platform on Azure and drive adoption across research, administration, operations, and clinical integration. The Director will lead a talented team of data engineers, AI engineers, product leads, platform architects, and solutions engineers, translating platform capability into measurable mission impact.

This position may be eligible for remote work. However, St. Jude requires all remote employees to:

  • Travel to our Memphis campus for the interview process and/or orientation, if selected
  • Travel to Memphis to work on-site for one week per quarter, or as requested based on business needs, if hired.

By applying, you acknowledge and agree to these travel requirements as a condition of employment.

This position is remote within approved U.S. locations. Due to state-specific employment regulations, we are unable to consider applicants currently residing in California for remote work; however, candidates based in California who are willing to relocate to an approved location may be considered.


Your Top Priority: Make Our Data Platform the Way St. Jude Works


We have built a strong foundation on Databricks. Your central goal is to make it the first place teams turn for trusted data, analytics, and AI. A platform creates value when people use it and when it keeps pace with what they will need next, so you will lead both the overall data platform strategy and the adoption strategy that makes it matter across the institution.


  • Set the platform strategy and stay a few steps ahead. Keep a clear roadmap of what to enable next, anticipate where research, clinical, and operational needs and AI capabilities are heading, and advise the Vice President, Data & Analytics on where we need to go.
  • Set the adoption strategy. Define success and establish targets for active users, teams onboarded, certified data products in use, self service usage, AI solution adoption, and legacy reports and tools retired.
  • Know your users. Engage scientists, clinicians, finance and HR teams, and operational leaders to understand what they need, what slows them down, and what would make them change how they work.
  • Make it easy. Remove friction in access, onboarding, and tooling. Provide ready to use data products, templates, and natural language tools that help users get answers without waiting for a custom build.
  • Build a network of champions. Create a federated model of embedded partners and data champions who teach, support, and advocate within their departments.
  • Teach and enable. Launch training, office hours, communities of practice, and clear guidance on data tools and responsible AI use for every level of the organization.
  • Retire the old to make room for the new. Consolidate redundant reports, data marts, and shadow tools so teams have fewer, better, and more trusted sources.
  • Show the value. Measure and communicate time saved, decisions improved, research accelerated, operational performance improved, and legacy technology retired.

What You Will Lead


Build the Platform That Powers the Institution:


  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and continued implementation of the enterprise Databricks platform on Azure, including lakehouse architecture, pipelines, workspaces, security, identity, networking, reliability, performance, capacity, and cost management.
  • Set direction with platform architects on enterprise standards, reusable reference patterns, technical decisions, and operating practices that are secure, scalable, supportable, and designed to last.
  • Deliver governed, reusable data products across research, administration, and operations. Integrate clinical data in close partnership with the Director of Clinical Data and Analytics.
  • Assess and introduce capabilities such as AI/BI Genie, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakebase, Mosaic AI, MLflow, model serving, and Vector Search where they solve real institutional problems.
  • Manage platform vendors, consulting partners, cloud providers, contracts, budgets, service levels, and FinOps practices.

Deliver AI Ready Data Products:


  • Make each priority data product trusted, documented, governed, discoverable, reusable, and ready for use by people and AI systems.
  • Build semantic layers, metadata, lineage, ontologies where appropriate, and quality standards that allow tools such as Genie and AI agents to provide accurate and explainable answers.
  • Prepare structured and unstructured data for AI use, including document extraction, embeddings, vector search, retrieval pipelines, and knowledge grounding.
  • Establish measurable criteria for certified and AI ready data products and track the number, adoption, quality, and business value of priority assets.

Deliver Data and AI That People Actually Use:


  • Research: Give scientists scalable, reproducible access to genomic, multi omics, imaging, clinical, and other scientific data in partnership with the Office of Data Science and in support of St. Jude’s open science mission.
  • Administration: Deliver data products, analytics, and AI for finance, human resources, legal and compliance.
  • Operations: Deliver solutions for capacity, scheduling, supply chain, facilities, and patient and family experience, including predictive and optimization models.
  • Clinical integration: Work closely with the Director of Clinical Data and Analytics to connect clinical, research, and operational data into a cohesive enterprise ecosystem. Together, establish shared strategies, priorities, governance, ownership, and service expectations that enable questions spanning traditional organizational boundaries while preserving clear clinical domain accountability.

Make St. Jude an AI Enabled Organization:


  • Define and lead the enterprise AI strategy across machine learning, generative AI, and agentic applications in alignment with institutional governance and the Office of Data Science.
  • Lead AI engineers in building and deploying production solutions on Databricks, including machine learning models, LLM applications, retrieval augmented generation, and agents.
  • Establish MLOps and LLMOps practices for model and prompt versioning, registry, evaluation, monitoring, observability, drift detection, incident response, rollback, and safe promotion from pilot to production.
  • Partner with the Senior Director of Data Governance and institutional AI governance bodies to operationalize responsible AI, including privacy, security, model risk review, bias and fairness testing, human oversight, and auditability.

Work Hand in Hand with Data Governance:


  • Turn policies, standards, and the stewardship model established with the Senior Director of Data Governance into working platform controls, including lineage, classification, access control, quality rules, metadata, monitoring, and audit logging.
  • Define certified and AI ready data products, ownership, service expectations, quality thresholds, and compliance measures together.
  • Work with Information Security, Privacy, Compliance, Legal, and research oversight partners to protect PHI and research data under HIPAA, IRB and consent requirements, NIH data sharing policies, and applicable controlled access requirements.

Run Delivery Like a Product Organization:


  • Empower product leads to own roadmaps, intake, prioritization, user discovery, delivery, adoption, and outcomes for each domain, with AI readiness and adoption included in every product’s definition of done.
  • Prioritize investments by mission impact, user value, feasibility, risk, and total cost, and sequence them against the platform roadmap.
  • Create transparent demand management, delivery, and value realization practices that give leaders a clear view of progress, tradeoffs, risks, and results.

Grow People. Build Leaders. Represent Data and AI.


  • Mentor and coach team members through regular one on ones, direct and timely feedback, meaningful recognition, and individualized development plans.
  • Build clear career paths for data engineers, AI engineers, architects, solutions engineers, and product leads across technical, product, and management tracks.
  • Sponsor team members for stretch assignments, certifications, publications, conference presentations, and advancement opportunities. Develop successors and a strong bench of future managers, principal architects, and senior product leaders.
  • Create a culture of psychological safety, curiosity, inclusion, accountability, and continuous learning where concerns are raised early and teams learn from mistakes.
  • Teach the team to explain tradeoffs and communicate effectively with clinicians, scientists, operational leaders, executives, and board committees.
  • Represent data and AI to executive leaders, governance bodies, external collaborators, peer institutions, academic partners, and technology vendors. Translate complex topics into mission and business terms using stories, visuals, and measures that matter.

What You Bring


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, computer science, data science, information science or related field required.
  • Master's degree preferred.

Minimum Experience:


  • Minimum requirement: Ten (10) significant years experience in an IT functional area with experience managing mid-large teams with focus on both achievement of objectives as well as critical skill-building.
  • Experience having led large-scale projects/processes through to implementation.
  • Experience with operational mgmt., budget planning & vendors and resource mgmt.
  • Prior experience in building external connections with peers, emerging technology communities, and vendor networks.
  • Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role.
  • Ten or more years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, AI and ML engineering, analytics, architecture, or related technology disciplines, including at least five years leading teams and managing budgets is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise data platform implementation and adoption with measurable growth in users, use cases, certified data products, and mission or business outcomes highly preferred.
  • Experience leading blended teams across engineering, architecture, product management, platform operations, and solutions delivery highly preferred.
  • Experience establishing enablement programs, federated or hub and spoke operating models, and data champion networks highly preferred.
  • Experience moving machine learning or generative AI solutions from pilot to reliable production operation highly preferred.
  • Experience managing vendors, consulting partners, contracts, budgets, and cloud investments highly preferred.
  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, biomedical research, an academic medical center, pediatric medicine, or oncology highly preferred.
  • Experience with enterprise systems such as Epic, Workday, Adaptive Planning, Visier, HR and workforce management, CRM, ServiceNow, and financial planning platforms highly preferred.
  • Databricks or Microsoft Azure certifications highly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:


  • Enterprise Databricks expertise, preferably on Azure, including Delta Lake, Apache Spark, Lakeflow or Delta Live Tables, Databricks SQL, workflows and orchestration, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Mosaic AI or model serving, Vector Search, Genie, and agent frameworks.
  • Azure architecture, security, Entra ID, networking, storage, private connectivity, cost management, capacity planning, and FinOps.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in CI/CD, Git, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, DevOps, DataOps, automated testing, observability, and production support.
  • Data architecture and modeling expertise, including lakehouse and medallion design, dimensional modeling, batch and streaming ingestion, and integration with enterprise, research, and clinical source systems.
  • AI ready data product delivery, including semantic layers, metadata, lineage, data contracts, data quality, structured and unstructured data preparation, embeddings, retrieval, and knowledge grounding.
  • MLOps and LLMOps, including evaluation, monitoring, versioning, guardrails, human oversight, incident response, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience operating data and analytics as a product practice.
  • Data governance implementation in a modern platform, including cataloging, ownership, stewardship, classification, access control, lineage, quality, and responsible AI controls.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA and privacy practices, including de identification and access controls for sensitive clinical and research data.
  • Strategic thinking and roadmap planning ability, including tracking emerging data, platform, and AI capabilities, translating them into a sequenced roadmap of what to enable next, and advising executive leaders on investment and direction.
  • Strong executive presence and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear, plain language to senior executives, boards, clinicians, scientists, and external audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder engagement, emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across clinical, scientific, administrative, operational, and technical groups.
  • Experience speaking at conferences, publishing, or representing an organization in external data and AI collaborations.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience with EHR data and healthcare standards such as Epic, Cerner, HL7, FHIR, OMOP, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, and DICOM.
  • Experience with genomic, multi omics, imaging, high performance computing, or GPU enabled research environments.
  • Experience supporting open science and secure data sharing with external collaborators, including cloud based research environments and controlled access data.
  • Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or biomedical vocabularies that improve data interoperability and AI accuracy.
  • Certification or formal training in product management, agile delivery, or organizational change management.

Why Join St. Jude?


You will work on data that matters in service of a mission unlike any other. You will have the backing of institutional leaders who see data and AI as essential to St. Jude’s future and the opportunity to build a team and platform that people across the institution rely on to advance cures and save children.

Compensation

In recognition of certain U.S. state and municipal pay transparency laws, St. Jude is including a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This is an estimate offered in good faith and a specific salary offer takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the salary range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is $138,320 - $262,080 per year for the role of Director, Data and AI.

Explore our exceptional benefits!


We are committed to a human-centered hiring experience. Technology may support portions of our process, but recruiting decisions involve human review and engagement. Learn more about our approach to AI.


St. Jude is an Equal Opportunity Employer


No Search Firms

St. Jude Children's Research Hospital does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. Please do not call or email. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee or other representative at St. Jude via email, the internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place and approved by HR will result in no fee being paid in the event the candidate is hired by St. Jude.

Purdue Global offers term-by-term, non-tenured teaching appointments to qualified individuals who are dedicated to providing high-quality educational experiences. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work within a collaborative professional learning community where faculty contribute to and engage in instructional best practices for adult learners in an innovative, nontraditional university setting.

Job Summary

Adjunct faculty serve in part-time teaching roles and are responsible for delivering high-quality instruction while fostering an inclusive, supportive, and student-centered learning environment conducive to student success.

Adjunct faculty may teach up to two courses per term, not to exceed ten courses per year. Teaching assignments may fluctuate and are contingent upon program needs and course scheduling.

Faculty are expected to participate in continuing professional development and may also engage in faculty governance, curriculum activities, and additional service responsibilities as assigned. Scholarship is not required.

Qualifications and Experience

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | Spain | Remot
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is €85,000 - €107,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

We’re on a mission to modernize insurance, making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that has remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a Senior IT Manager to lead the IT Support function as we expand into the next chapter!

What you'll be doing:

    You will be a senior member of the team, and a cross-functional leader within PolicyMe. This is an opportunity to completely reshape the IT strategy and execution as PolicyMe moves to the next stage of scale and growth, building durable policies and process that will be used for years to come! You will be the decision-maker! In your day-to-day, this will lead you to:

  • Define the vision and roadmap for IT Support: You will articulate the strategic goals for the IT Support team and define the roadmap for how we get there. You will communicate progress against the roadmap and goals to all key stakeholders (e.g. Business Operations, Engineering, Leadership, People and Culture).
  • Hands-on ownership of IT equipment: You will take on the direct responsible of ensuring PolicyMe employees have continuous access to the tools they need (laptops, external monitors, etc.), while also ensuring the inventory management and disposal follow proper governance. This will include managing budgets and strategic thinking on equipment selection decisions.
  • Prioritize what to work on: You will have to decide what other IT Support team members invest time on and in what order. By developing and executing a disciplined process, you will prioritize process improvements, security rollouts, bugs and maintenance activities.
  • Collaborate in PolicyMe’s Information Security Committee: You will work closely with senior leaders from Business Operations and Engineering to maintain a robust information security program where your direct responsibilities will include ownership of access control and maintenance of PolicyMe’s SOC 2 certification. This requires deep attention to detail on role-based access control and third party vendor management.
  • Coordinate on-call availability: You will be responsible for designing and executing alongside the IT support team, on support availability timelines and SLAs within the company based on defined priority levels.
  • Develop the backlog: You will ideate with stakeholders across PolicyMe and then manage a backlog of new IT initiatives to meet our employee’s needs, improve our back-end integrity, innovate and ultimately reach the defined vision.
  • Rally the team behind secure best practices: You will serve as the central point across all functions and ensure that any IT-equipment and access-related roadblocks are removed to achieve success. This includes ensuring information security and IT-related governance is well understood and communicated across the organization.
  • Coordinate the launch: You will work with the Engineering and Business Operations teams to ensure that the patches and new security releases has been thoroughly tested and are ready to launch.
  • Measure and learn: You will measure the key metrics for our IT support team and report out to the broader organization.

What are we looking for:

  • Relevant IT support experience: You have 3-5 years of experience in IT support management, Information Security, or Engineering, preferably in a start-up or scale-up technology setting. You can speak to your track record of leading projects and delivering measurable results.
  • A hands-on aptitude: You have the ability to both think and plan strategically while also remaining a “do-er” for the day to day tasks and activities. This hands-on attitude is incredibly important at PolicyMe and flows through our culture even at the most senior levels.
  • AI mindset and willingness to innovate: You are excited about the opportunities that AI presents for the IT area and are actively learning about new applications and technologies. You are keen to play a major role in the transition of PolicyMe’s AI adoption and development of AI-first capabilities.
  • Exceptional collaboration skills: You have high emotional intelligence and can "be the glue" between many different stakeholders in the organization.
  • Curiosity and highly comfortable with technical topics: You are naturally curious about how everything works. You will work closely with some wicked smart Engineers, so you know when to ask clarifying questions and are not shy about diving into complex topics.
  • A mindset for risk identification and assessment: You understand that the PolicyMe business model inherently handles high sensitive personal information. You take a risk-mindful approach to problem solving and identify risks before they present themselves as problems. You are comfortable assessing the probability and severity of risks and communicate these clearly.
  • Strong problem solving skills: You have the ability to take an ambiguous problem and structure it yourself. You are someone who can start with an idea and manage it from concept to deployment. You present and execute solutions that are durable, that is they will solve today’s problem and tomorrow’s edge case!
  • Strategic decision making: You can balance tradeoffs and consider many side to a problem before arriving at a decision. Decisions are based on strong supporting data, consider the second and third order impacts, and are communicated concisely and clearly.

Why join us:

  • Generous PTO - 20 vacation days
  • A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe
  • Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential
  • An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry
  • Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)
  • Access to stock options based on performance
  • Compensation: The total target cash compensation for this role is $132,000–$154,000 CAD, based on experience. We’ll walk through the details together during the interview.

About PolicyMe:

At PolicyMe, we are Canada’s leading digital insurance solution, offering straightforward and affordable financial protection for families from coast to coast. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs. We also offer B2B2C solutions, partnering with organizations to provide seamless digital insurance options. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible. Since our launch in 2018, we have grown exponentially, selling over $20 billion in insurance coverage to Canadians.

We are proud of the team we’ve built and are excited for those that are yet to join us. We operate with a remote-first culture, attracting top talent from across Canada. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working alongside incredibly ambitious yet humble humans, we may be the right place for you! To learn more, visit .

  • Job Vacancy: This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope. We’re hiring to support increasing demand and continue delivering an exceptional customer experience.
  • Commitment to Equal Opportunity: PolicyMe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and provide fair consideration regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.
  • Accessibility Statement: We are committed to providing an accessible hiring experience. If you require accommodations during the application process, please indicate this in the “Additional Information” section of your application.

This role is ideal for a seasoned title professional who thrives on investigative research, resolving intricate property defects, and working alongside legal staff to achieve successful outcomes.

Role Overview

As a Title Examiner, you will serve as a cornerstone of our residential mortgage foreclosure practice. Your daily duties will center on reviewing title documents, investigating public registries, and correcting title defects to prepare properties for the market and upcoming sales.

  • Title Analysis & Examination: Review title commitments, preliminary reports, and land records; reconstruct clear chains of title; and pinpoint encumbrances, judgments, easements, and priority disputes.
  • Curative & Resolution: Partner with title agencies, lenders, and outside entities to remove title roadblocks by securing corrective instruments, releases, and lien satisfactions.
  • Public Records Research: Search county clerk portals and online repositories to interpret deeds, tax liens, mortgages, and recorded restrictions.
  • Foreclosure Team Support: Collaborate directly with attorneys and paralegals to produce concise title briefs, monitor file progression, and compile FHA/VA title packages as required.
  • Quality Control: Keep case management records accurate, up-to-date, and fully compliant with internal standards and statutory requirements.

Candidate Qualifications

  • Two to five years of hands-on experience in title examination, curative real estate workflows, or property law.
  • Solid grasp of core title principles, lien priorities, and common ownership defects.
  • Proven ability to dissect title commitments and evaluate public land records.
  • Strong investigative drive paired with practical fluency in county recording software.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and time-management capabilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and legal database platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional background inside a law office, title insurance agency, or mortgage servicing environment.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Legal Studies, Real Estate, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with the foreclosure lifecycle and specific FHA/VA title guidelines.
  • Direct experience bridging chain-of-title breaks and resolving difficult liens.

Total Rewards & Benefits

  • Eight paid company holidays annually

  • Company-funded life insurance and short-term disability plans

jobs.description:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Product Manager for our Digital Forensics team.

This team builds AI-driven intelligence capabilities that turn large, messy, real-world datasets into clear answers and actions for operators and investigators. The product has strong traction and is entering a period of rapid growth – many more users and far higher volume, fast. We’re hiring the PM who will own it through that scale-up.

This is not a traditional roadmap role. You will take in incomplete, conflicting inputs from users, customers, stakeholders, and the product itself, and decide what we should build – and what we shouldn’t – as demand accelerates.

You will work closely with operators, product engineers, forward deployed engineers, and mission colleagues to find high-leverage problems and drive them through a shipped capability. You’ll often need to set aside loud or conflicting inputs and make calls others disagree with.

Order Forms and Deal Desk

Audits and Data Quality

Policy Process

Legal and Executive Support

  • Receive and respond to subpoenas and records requests, coordinate with internal teams to locate records, and track every request.

Required

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to NDAs, data sharing or data use agreements, or basic commercial contracts.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent paralegal experience. A paralegal certification is not required.

Why Join Us

  • Hands-on mentorship from the Director of Legal and exposure to our CEO, COO, and outside counsel.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams.   • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Neurology Medical Marketing - Insights & Congress Strategy, Senior Manager

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead U.S. Neurology external insight generation and the broader congress activation strategy across gMG and NMOSD.


Reporting to the Neuro Medical Marketing Lead, this individual will ensure customer, scientific, field, and congress learnings are translated into clear strategic implications that shape franchise strategy, indication planning, customer engagement, content, and investment decisions.

This role has end-to-end accountability for advisory board strategy and execution, a structured field-insight model with the Thought Leader Liaison (TLL) team, insight synthesis and communication, and the strategic activation of the congress portfolio. Within the Neuro Medical Marketing Lead's integrated U.S. congress strategy, the Senior Manager owns sponsorship strategy, activation planning, and cross-functional pull-through while leading and developing the team members responsible for assigned workstreams. Professional Marketing retains ownership of booth-related and sales-driven assets, including development and deployment of Tier 3 local conference kits.

Lead External Insight Strategy and Advisory Boards

Lead Congress Strategy, Sponsorships, and Activation

Lead Cross-Functional Strategy and Investment

  • Contribute to annual brand planning, long-range planning, quarterly priorities, and tactical plans by bringing forward customer, scientific, field, and congress implications.
  • Manage insights and congress budgets, agencies, and external vendors with strong financial stewardship, rigorous prioritization, and accountability for timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Represent Insights and Congress Strategy Medical Marketing in key franchise forums and communicate emerging risks, opportunities, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize insight generation, field intelligence, congress planning, activation measurement, and knowledge sharing through new capabilities, technologies, analytics, and AI.

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

  • Directly lead, coach, and develop team members responsible for insights, advisory boards, congress activation, and related Medical Marketing workstreams; establish clear priorities, decision rights, accountability, and development plans.
  • Create an operating model that balances strategic leadership with disciplined execution, enabling the team to manage complex workstreams while maintaining a strong customer and business focus.
  • Foster a culture of scientific curiosity, customer centricity, ownership, collaboration, innovation, and high standards of execution. Live and role model Amgen Values across the UPLIZNA brand team and cross-functional partners.

  • Doctorate degree and 2 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR
  • Master's degree and 4 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR

Location: Remote

We are seeking experienced Bioinformatics Scientists to contribute their specialized expertise to an innovative project focused on advancing AI systems.

As TTEC Digital’s WFM domain expert in-region, you are the go-to authority whenever a client is implementing, optimising or scaling a workforce management capability. You may carry profit-and-loss (P&L) accountability for the portfolio and take on leadership in aspects of larger and multiple concurrent client engagements and projects — interpreting complex client business issues and recommending best-practice solutions beyond WFM alone.

This is a remote role for someone based in Australia, Sydney or Melbourne, reporting to the Director, Client Service Desk with some domestic travel to metro and interstate client sites.

TTEC Digital is a leading global customer experience (CX) consulting and technology services firm. This role brings together two capabilities the business is scaling in Australia — trusted-advisor customer success and specialist WFM knowledge — so that our most important clients get both a single accountable relationship owner and credible, hands-on WFM leadership

What you will be doing

    1. Customer Success & Strategic Account Leadership

    • Own the portfolio. Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor across key strategic accounts, accountable for satisfaction, retention, renewal and growth.
    • Drive value realisation. Build and maintain account success plans mapped to each client’s business outcomes and CX objectives, and demonstrate measurable value against them.
    • Run the cadence. Lead regular business reviews (QBRs), maintain account health scores, and proactively surface risks and opportunities before they escalate.
    • Grow the relationship. Partner with sales and pre-sales to identify and progress renewal, expansion and cross-sell opportunities within the portfolio. Lead the negotiation of strategy, scope and statements of work with senior and executive client stakeholders.

    • Own escalations. Serve as the senior escalation point for client issues, driving timely resolution and protecting CSAT / NPS.
    • Lead within engagements. Take on leadership in aspects of larger and multiple concurrent client engagements and workstreams, working independently with little or no day-to-day guidance and owning quality and delivery outcomes.
    • Own the commercials. Hold profit-and-loss (P&L) accountability for the portfolio — managing engagement economics, margin and commercial governance to the parameters defined in each engagement agreement.

    • Lead on implementations. Provide domain leadership across the WFM lifecycle: forecasting, scheduling, intraday management, adherence, capacity planning, shrinkage and reporting.

Ovation Healthcare is hiring a mid-level MSSQL Developer / DBA to develop, support and maintain the SQL Server and Azure SQL databases and ETL pipelines that power our Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) operations. You will write and tune T-SQL, build and support ETL pipelines, handle day-to-day database administration, resolve production issues, support enterprise reporting, and help migrate legacy ETL workflows to Microsoft Fabric and Azure.

You will work alongside senior engineers who set standards and handle top-tier escalations, while owning assigned databases, tickets and changes end to end. The right candidate brings a careful, "first-time right" approach to production changes, always prepares a rollback plan, and asks the right questions to turn incomplete requests into clear requirements. You will handle healthcare data (PHI/PII) under HIPAA requirements.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design, write and maintain T-SQL stored procedures, functions, views and tables that support applications, ETL pipelines and reporting
  • Build, maintain and troubleshoot ETL pipelines that extract, transform and load healthcare and financial data into SQL Server, including data validation, error handling and job scheduling
  • Manage backups and restores, SQL Agent jobs, index and statistics maintenance, user access and permissions, and capacity monitoring across SQL Server and Azure SQL
  • Diagnose and resolve performance issues, blocking, deadlocks, failed jobs and data inconsistencies; escalate complex issues to senior staff with a clear summary of findings
  • Author, test, peer-review and execute production data scripts, with a rollback script prepared before every data modification or schema change
  • Review execution plans, indexes and stored procedures to refactor inefficient T-SQL and prevent recurring issues
  • Build, modify and troubleshoot SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) reports, subscriptions and underlying datasets
  • Support the conversion of legacy ETL processes built on PowerShell and stored procedures into Microsoft Fabric and Azure, and provide operational support after migration
  • Apply least-privilege access, protect PHI/PII under HIPAA, and follow team standards for source control, code review and change management in Azure DevOps; track work in JIRA

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • 3–5 years of hands-on MS SQL Server database development and administration in a production environment
  • Strong T-SQL skills: set-based queries, stored procedures, functions, views, CTEs and transactional logic
  • Experience writing parameterized dynamic SQL (sp_executesql) safely, and using WHILE loops and cursors for iterative and batch processing, with judgment on when a set-based approach is the better choice
  • Proven experience building and supporting ETL pipelines that use SQL Server as the backend, including staging, transformation logic, incremental loads, data validation and failure recovery
  • Working knowledge of database administration: backup/restore, SQL Agent jobs, index and statistics maintenance, security and permissions, and monitoring
  • Solid understanding of explicit transaction management (BEGIN TRAN, COMMIT, ROLLBACK), error handling (TRY...CATCH) and backout script patterns
  • Experience using DMVs, Query Store, Extended Events and execution plans to troubleshoot performance issues
  • Understanding of isolation levels, locking and blocking, and indexing strategies
  • Experience with Azure SQL Database or Azure SQL Managed Instance
  • Experience developing and supporting SSRS reports, including parameters and datasets
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools: Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot
  • Proficiency with SSMS, Azure Data Studio, Git-based version control and JIRA
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain technical findings in plain language to business partners

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Practical experience with Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory pipelines, Warehouses/Lakehouses) or Azure Data Factory

The Project Research Associate recruits qualified panellists and non-panellists for market research studies by conducting outbound and cold calls, following up with potential respondents by email, and completing desk research to identify additional candidates. Project Recruitment

  • Clearly communicate study requirements, participation details, and next steps to potential respondents during recruitment calls.
  • Promptly inform the line manager of recruitment issues, delays, or foreseeable risks that may affect project delivery, and provide relevant information to support corrective action.
  • Provide relevant feedback on project feasibility and recruitment conditions using market intelligence gathered through conversations with potential respondents.
  • Meet daily call-volume and recruitment strike-rate targets.
  • Adhere to established phone communication quality standards and guidelines.

Panel Recruitment & Engagement

  • Follow up with study participants by phone to convert them into registered panel members.
  • Cold call physicians and other healthcare professionals to recruit them to the panel.
  • Contact inactive panel members and invite them to participate in studies to reactivate their accounts.

Panel Support

  • Provide professional support to research participants throughout the recruitment process.
  • Use multiple systems to investigate and resolve issues, manage complaints, and offer appropriate solutions or alternatives.
  • Collaborate with US and EU teams to resolve project-specific issues while balancing participant advocacy with company profitability.

Alternative arrangements may be available where required and are handled confidentially through Human Resources.
