jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for:

Circle has built its reputation on being compliant and transparent. That reputation rests on data that is right.

As a Data Engineer at Circle, you'll build and operate the pipelines and data models that our risk and compliance teams depend on to monitor activity, screen for risk, meet regulatory reporting requirements and produce evidence that stands up to scrutiny. You'll work with large-scale on-chain and internal data and turn it into datasets that people can trust, explain and defend. You'll join a team of passionate engineers who care about data reliability, learn from experienced senior and staff engineers, and take on a growing share of ownership as you go. If you pay close attention to detail, get bothered when the numbers don't tie out, are excited to learn from our expert risk and compliance partners, and want to understand how our systems really work, we would love to talk to you.


What you'll work on:

  • Partner with product engineering, risk, compliance, data analytics and data science teams to understand what data they need and why, and help turn those needs into well-specified requirements, models, business logic and pipelines.
  • Develop a working understanding of how the business thinks about risk and compliance obligations, such as transaction monitoring, sanctions and AML screening, regulatory reporting and audit evidence, and how our data supports each one.
  • Own the pipelines and models you build, including on-call for them. Write and maintain runbooks, add data quality checks and alerting, and fix root causes rather than symptoms when something breaks.
  • Work with on-chain data at scale, ingesting and modeling data from multiple blockchains and handling the realities of that data, such as reorgs, late or missing records and upstream schema changes.
  • Deliver new sources, domain models and backfills with limited supervision. Escalate early on large or ambiguous efforts, and bring ideas for better approaches to your senior teammates.
  • Apply access and control requirements correctly in your own work, such as authorized views and PII handling, and flag gaps you find.
  • Build scalable automated solutions using SQL, Python, orchestration and transformation tooling, and AI.
  • Review peers' code and models, document what you ship, and keep your partners informed on progress and risks.

You will aspire to our four core values:


  • Multistakeholder - you have dedication and commitment to our customers, shareholders, employees and families and local communities.
  • Mindful - you seek to be respectful, an active listener and to pay attention to detail.
  • Driven by Excellence - you are driven by our mission and our passion for customer success which means you relentlessly pursue excellence, that you do not tolerate mediocrity and you work intensely to achieve your goals.
  • High Integrity - you seek open and honest communication, and you hold yourself to very high moral and ethical standards. You reject manipulation, dishonesty and intolerance.

What you’ll bring to Circle:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Finance or similar), or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and models.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python, and experience with a modern data stack: a cloud data warehouse, an orchestrator such as Airflow, and a transformation tool such as dbt.
  • A track record of delivering well-scoped work independently, with high-quality, tested code and few errors.
  • Clear communication and a collaborative approach, including the ability to explain to non-technical partners how the pipelines you build work.
  • A strong sense of ownership: when a number looks wrong or a pipeline breaks, you dig in, find the root cause, and keep partners informed until it is fixed.
  • Experience with blockchain data, financial services, risk, compliance, banking or other regulated industries is a plus, but not required.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position.  Recruitment Coordinator, IndiaRemote (India) | Full-TimeAlso searched as: Recruitment Coordinator, Recruitment Administrator, Talent Coordinator, Talent Acquisition Executive If we handed you every candidate Contour is talking to right now and said nothing slips, where would you start?
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.


Recruitment Coordinator, IndiaRemote (India) | Full-Time

Also searched as: Recruitment Coordinator, Recruitment Administrator, Talent Coordinator, Talent Acquisition Executive

If we handed you every candidate Contour is talking to right now and said nothing slips, where would you start?

On a typical day you might move an interview at one of our Australian campuses and rebook the room before lunch, bring a dozen candidate records in Rippling up to date with a note on each so the Talent Partner can read status at a glance, and chase an overdue video assessment and a hiring manager's feedback before you log off.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. This role sits in the Talent Acquisition team within People and Culture, which hires for all three brands.

Contour runs dozens of open roles at a time across tutoring, campus and support teams. This is the seat every one of those candidates passes through.

About This Role

You are the coordinator behind Contour's hiring pipeline: the person who books every interview, keeps every candidate record in Rippling accurate, and follows every assessment and piece of feedback through until it lands.

You report to the Talent Partner, who is based in Australia. They own hiring strategy, phone screens and interviews, offers, and the relationship with hiring managers. Everything that moves a candidate from one of those conversations to the next is yours: scheduling, records, assessments, follow-ups, and the talent pools behind upcoming roles. Candidate calls stay onshore. Your work is written, in Rippling, email and SMS, across every candidate at every stage.

Two things separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, process discipline: you run the workflow the same way every time, and when a step keeps breaking you flag it before it costs a missed interview. Second, you chase early and you chase again: an unconfirmed interview, an overdue assessment or a hiring manager's feedback never sits in your queue waiting for someone to ask about it.

You are the only coordinator on the team and you have no reports. The sourcing and talent-pool work is the part of the seat that grows with you.

Hiring at Contour has outgrown the time one Talent Partner can give to coordination. You take that work on, so their time goes to sourcing, hiring managers and offers. By the end of month three, every active candidate's status in Rippling is accurate within a day of any touchpoint, new interviews are booked within two working days of the request, no candidate has gone five business days without hearing from us, and the first talent pools for recurring roles are built and current. The templates, trackers and pools you set up in those months will outlast the roles they were built for.

Where the Work Lives

  • Rippling:the ATS. Interviews are booked from here and candidates receive their invites from it, and every candidate record, stage move and note lives here, so a touchpoint you have not logged does not exist as far as the team is concerned.

  • VideoAsk:video assessments go out and come back through here. You send them, watch for what has not come back, and sort out resubmissions when a file is corrupted or the audio is missing.

  • SEEK Talent Search:sourcing and talent pools, against criteria the Talent Partner sets. Templated outreach is yours to send; anything off-template goes past the Talent Partner first.

  • Shared inbox and calendars:candidate queries land in the shared inbox and you decide which ones need escalating; reschedules and cancellations move through the calendar the same day hiring priorities change.

What You Will Do

  • Own interview scheduling end to end.Book, confirm and reschedule interviews across phone, video and campus formats, send candidates the time, location and interviewer, line up interviewer availability, raise room bookings for interviews at our Australian campuses, and follow up anyone who has not confirmed, by SMS when email goes quiet.

  • Keep the Rippling pipeline accurate for every open role.Move candidates to the right stage as it happens, log each touchpoint as a note (assessment sent, follow-up made, video resubmitted), file documents to the right candidate, and action hiring managers' requests on the profile itself.

  • Run assessments and get overdue feedback in.Send pre-interview and skills assessments, track completion against due dates, and push overdue hiring-manager feedback before it stalls a pipeline.

  • Handle routine candidate communication.Status updates, extension requests and confirmations of receipt go out on approved templates on behalf of the Talent Partner, at every stage of the process. You flag anything that needs the Talent Partner's judgement.

  • Source and keep talent pools warm.Build longlists and shortlists in SEEK Talent Search against the Talent Partner's brief, send first-contact and follow-up messages on the approved templates, and keep pools for recurring and hard-to-fill roles current.

  • Support reporting and the admin around hiring.Pull open-role, stage-count and time-to-fill data from Rippling, format job ads, candidate summaries and interview packs, and take the notes in recruitment catch-ups and follow up the actions.

If a template, tracker or tool would remove a manual step, make the case and we will back it.


Requirements

What You Need

  • 1 to 4 years in a recruitment or HR coordination role, agency, RPO or in-house, where you kept a live pipeline of candidates on track

  • Hands-on Rippling experience​

  • Hands-on with an ATS: you can move stages, log notes, upload documents and pull a basic report without help

  • Writing that lands with someone who has never met you. Your confirmations, follow-ups and status updates are a candidate's whole experience of Contour until interview day, so a clear, warm, correct email is the core skill of this role

  • Organised at volume: many candidates across many roles, each at a different stage, none of them dropped

  • Detail that catches problems early: a wrong interview time, a stage that does not match the last note, a misspelt name, all caught before the candidate sees them

  • Same-day turnaround on scheduling requests, follow-ups and record updates. A pipeline that waits on you slows down for everyone

  • Comfortable sourcing on a platform like SEEK Talent Search or LinkedIn against a set brief

  • Comfortable working fully remote across the India and Australia time difference, with an onshore Talent Partner as your daily counterpart

Nice to Have

  • VideoAsk or another video assessment platform

  • Experience supporting an Australian or other overseas hiring team from India

  • EdTech, education services or a student-facing organisation background

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here

The people who do well here see a gap and close it without waiting to be told. They keep their work visible: on a remote team, the difference between a coordinator the team trusts and one it has to check on is whether the team can see what is happening, so being visible is part of the job. They give direct feedback and expect it back. They give a candidate bad news with the same care as good news. When a process is not working, they say so and bring a fix with them.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What Good Looks Like

  • Nothing slips:every candidate knows where they stand, and no interview or assessment sits unconfirmed past its date.

  • The pipeline tells the truth:any hiring manager can open Rippling and see exactly where a candidate is up to.

  • Ready before the role opens:talent pools for recurring roles are current, so a new requisition starts with names already in hand.


Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India, with no travel. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience; we discuss it openly early in the process.

From application to offer: a short written screen, a video interview, a practical exercise (a small mock pipeline to prioritise and a follow-up email to draft), a conversation with our People team, and a final interview with the Talent Partner, in about four weeks.

Apply with a CV and one paragraph on a process you ran where something nearly slipped: what it was, how you caught it, and what you changed so it could not happen again.

jobs.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ: DXCM) ist ein Pionier und weltweit führend im Bereich der kontinuierlichen Glukoseüberwachung (CGM). Dexcom begann als kleines Unternehmen mit einem großen Traum: Die Art und Weise, wie Diabetes behandelt wird, für immer zu verändern. Informationen und Erkenntnisse zugänglich zu machen, die zu besseren gesundheitlichen Ergebnissen führen. Heute, 25 Jahre später, haben wir eine ganze Branche geprägt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Wir erweitern unsere Vision über Diabetes hinaus, um Menschen zu befähigen, ihre Gesundheit selbst in die Hand zu nehmen. Das bedeutet: personalisierte, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse, die darauf abzielen, wichtige gesundheitliche Herausforderungen zu lösen. Unser Ziel bleibt: Die menschliche Gesundheit zu verbessern.


Angetrieben werden wir von Tausenden ehrgeiziger, leidenschaftlicher Menschen weltweit, die wie Kämpfer darum ringen, das Vertrauen unserer Kundinnen und Kunden zu gewinnen – durch Zuhören, Integrität, große Visionen und Verlässlichkeit. Wir haben bereits Millionen Leben verändert – und sind bereit, Millionen weitere zu verändern.

Unsere Zukunftsvision ist es, ein führendes Unternehmen im Bereich der Gesundheitstechnologie für Verbraucher zu werden, während wir weiterhin Lösungen für ernsthafte Gesundheitsprobleme entwickeln. Wir werden dieses Ziel erreichen, indem wir kontinuierlich einzigartige Erfahrungen mit Biosensor-Technologie neu erfinden. Auch wenn wir weit von unseren Anfängen als kleines Unternehmen entfernt sind – unsere Träume sind größer denn je. Die Chance, die Gesundheit weltweit zu verbessern, liegt vor uns.


Lerne das Team kennen:

Unser Pharmacy-Team entwickelt den Apothekenkanal von Dexcom in Deutschland. Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnerapotheken machen wir kontinuierliche Glukosemessung im Apothekenalltag zugänglich. Als Key Account Manager Pharmacy verantwortest du die vertriebliche Entwicklung deiner Region. jobs.title: SEO & GEO, Senior Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, technology, and AI to make a mark on our communities, our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors.
jobs.description:
Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, technology, and AI to make a mark on our communities, our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors. We relentlessly pursue (and share) the truth, bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources, enhanced by responsible, human-centered AI. Our purpose is to unlock potential across these communities, envisioning a world where doing the right thing is intuitive and informed.

At Seer, we see AI as a catalyst for innovation, collaboration, and creativity. Regardless of your division or discipline, leveraging AI is a core part of how we deliver smarter, faster, and more strategic outcomes for our clients. Our AI Council drives company-wide integration by focusing on education, purposeful implementation, and continuous learning, ensuring that AI is embedded in how we think, operate, and grow.

If you’re ready to uplift others, challenge your ego, commit to the truth, and be better than yesterday—keep reading.

Seer is a remote-first agency and a Certified B-Corp, with team members across the country. If an office environment is more your style, this position can also sit in our HQ office in Philadelphia. We can only consider candidates based in the US who can work continental US-based hours.

The Role:

You, the Senior SEO & GEO Account Manager of our dreams, are a strategic consultant and will spend your days creating digital marketing strategies that tie into clients' overall marketing plans and business goals. At Seer, AI is embedded in how we deliver smarter, faster, and more strategic outcomes and search is evolving beyond traditional rankings into AI Overviews, generative results, and LLM-powered discovery experiences.

In this role, you are the day-to-day strategic lead on your accounts, deep in the data, driving the project plan, and running the client relationship at the operational level. A Channel Lead may sit above your accounts to handle executive stakeholder relationships and portfolio-level decisions, but you are the engine. Your instinct for what to do next and your ability to communicate it clearly to clients and associates is what makes accounts move

You will be passionately engaged with this evolving search landscape and understand how to position brands for visibility across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-driven interfaces. You don't just optimize for rankings, you think about discoverability, content visibility within AI-generated results, and how search behavior is shifting.

You're intellectually curious, systems-minded, and not afraid to test emerging tools, design AI-driven workflows, or challenge conventional SEO thinking.

Role Highlights

  • You have experience managing a portfolio of 4–6 active client accounts simultaneously, keeping deliverables on track across multiple industries and stakeholder contexts without losing the thread on any of them.
  • You will lead organic strategy for a portfolio of clients, building annual and quarterly roadmaps that account for both traditional SEO performance and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) visibility across AI-driven search environments.
  • You will serve as the day-to-day primary point of contact for clients, running weekly status calls, managing the project plan, fielding questions, and keeping strategy on track. While a Channel Lead may own the executive relationship on larger accounts, you are the operational lead your client relies on
  • On any given week, you might respond to a dozen client-related messages, prep a QBR, onboard a new stakeholder, and triage an unexpected client ask, all while keeping deliverables on track. You are comfortable context-switching quickly and know when a fast response is more valuable than a perfect one.
  • Conduct in-depth content gap analyses, competitive research, keyword strategy, and SERP landscape analysis including evaluating how client content surfaces within traditional Search, AI-generated results and other generative search experiences.
  • Translate performance data from GA4, Adobe, and Search Console into clear, actionable insights, connecting ranking shifts, traffic trends, SERP feature changes, and generative visibility signals back to client goals.
  • Strengthen technical foundations such as site architecture, internal linking, and structured data to improve crawlability, entity clarity, and overall discoverability across both traditional search engines and generative platforms.
  • Work closely with 1-2 associates per account, directing their work, reviewing deliverables, and developing their skills. This is not formal people management — their team lead owns that — but you are the day-to-day mentor and quality check. Strong account managers can explain not just what to fix but why.
  • Leverage tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and automation platforms (Zapier, APIs) to accelerate research, synthesize insights, and support scalable SEO and GEO workflows.
  • Test, refine, and document AI-driven workflows and GEO experiments that enhance strategic thinking, surface new opportunities, and shape Seer's evolving approach to modern organic visibility.

Essential Skills

  • You have proven experience building and driving SEO strategy across multiple industries, with the ability to evolve strategy as search shifts toward AI-generated summaries and generative search interfaces.
  • Enterprise-level clients are your comfort zone, you've navigated complex stakeholder structures, long deal cycles, and high expectations before, and you know how to deliver at that level.
  • You have a strong technical SEO foundation, including site architecture, structured data, indexing diagnostics, and performance analysis with an understanding of how these elements influence both traditional rankings and generative visibility.
  • You are able to tie SEO and GEO performance to business outcomes and confidently communicate strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • You are comfortable working in Wrike as your daily operating system, managing blueprints, tracking deliverable burn, setting task dependencies, and keeping accounts moving within the interface. On accounts without a dedicated PM (roughly a quarter of your book), you own the project management layer.
  • You are comfortable working with AI and LLM tools beyond surface-level usage, using them to analyze data, pressure-test ideas, support research, and improve workflows.
  • You have strong analytical fluency across platforms such as GA4, Adobe, Search Console, and leading SEO tools, with curiosity around emerging GEO measurement indicators such as AI Overview presence, generative citations, and SERP volatility.
  • You are a critical thinker who evaluates AI-generated insights and GEO opportunities through real business context rather than relying solely on automation.

90 Day Goals

  • By Day 30, you will have completed division training and begun to support at least 1 client
  • By Day 60,you will have onboarded to at least 3 client accounts and are taking over strategy for them
  • By Day 90, you will have ownership of your accounts and be delivering independently

This might not be the right role for you if

  • Time-management, context-switching, and juggling multiple projects is quite challenging
  • You do not want continued-learning and innovation to be an expectation
  • Change management is difficult and you struggle with adapting to new tools and processes
  • Your AI usage stops at asking ChatGPT for content drafts or simple edits, or you struggle to adapt when tools break
  • Client communication feels like overhead rather than a core part of the value you deliver. The most successful account managers here genuinely enjoy talking to clients, navigating ambiguity with them, and spending real time on relationship management, not just strategy decks.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $95,000-$115,000 annually. Your final offered compensation will be determined by your skills and experience
  • Evaluation of comp at least once a year
  • Benefits highlights

Our team is excited to read your application responses and will be using them to help determine who we’d like to meet with!

jobs.title: Staff Accountant
jobs.excerpt: Convergent Research is a non-profit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO): a startup-style team built to tackle one ambitious scientific problem that academia and industry can’t.
jobs.description:
Convergent Research is a non-profit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO): a startup-style team built to tackle one ambitious scientific problem that academia and industry can’t. We’re launching moonshot science projects which may change the trajectory of scientific progress. Today we support 14 FROs and counting across the US, the UK and Chile, with an annual budget of $75 million and growing. Large-scale brain mapping, climate measurement and software for math all have something in common: they each need a nonprofit legal entity, payroll providers, health benefits, boards, contracts, office space, press releases, websites… For every FRO we support, Convergent provides the backend infrastructure that lets them move fast.

About the Role

As a Staff Accountant, you are a fully qualified accountant who owns the books across Convergent, its disregarded entities and its subsidiaries in the US and UK. You will do the hands-on work end to end: record journal entries, revenue and intercompany activity, reconcile accounts, maintain schedules and keep us audit-ready, with review from the Finance & Accounting Managers and the Controller. Reporting to the Controller, you will work independently, with team review at key points, and grow your expertise alongside a team of experienced accountants.

This is a fully remote position with domestic travel required quarterly for team and organizational onsites, and as needed.

You Are

  • A solid nonprofit accountant. You have five or more years of accounting experience (or three or more with a master's), ideally in nonprofits, public accounting or research organizations. You understand fund accounting, net asset restrictions and how contributions and grants are recorded.

  • Reconciliation-ready. You enjoy reconciliations and know a clean balance sheet when you see one. You can trace a variance to its source and fix it.

  • Comfortable with complexity. Whether in-house or at an audit or accounting firm, you have worked with multiple entities, clients or funding sources, and you understand intercompany activity, allocations and how restricted gifts and grants flow through the books.

  • Audit-aware. You have prepared schedules or supporting documentation for an audit and know what good documentation looks like.

  • Pleasantly detail-obsessed. You sweat the details, but don’t get hung up on immaterial ones. You know when to raise a question for compliance or GAAP sake.

  • Systems-savvy. You are comfortable in accounting systems and spreadsheets, and you pick up new tools quickly. You know when to ask for systems help too!

  • A natural collaborator. You can translate a journal entry into plain English for a non-finance colleague without breaking a sweat.

  • Eager to grow. You take feedback well, ask good questions, and want to build your career in accounting.

You Will

  • Own your part of the close. Record journal entries, prepaid and accrual entries, and bank and account reconciliations across our entities, deliver them on the close calendar, and support the monthly, quarterly and year-end close.

  • Own intercompany entries. Record intercompany activity and IDC charges to Convergent, and prepare the entries and reconciliations that support our US/UK consolidation.

  • Record revenue and restrictions. Record revenue, track donor restrictions and releases of restrictions, and prepare entries for review by the Finance & Accounting Managers.

  • Keep the books clean. Code bank transactions, maintain fixed asset and lease schedules, and resolve discrepancies as they come up.

  • Support payroll, payables and receivables. Record payroll journal entries and allocations, reconcile payroll expenses and benefits liabilities, handle AR invoicing, review AR and AP agings with a questioning eye, and support year-end 1099s.

  • Help us stay audit-ready. Support the Controller and Finance & Accounting Managers with year-end audit and tax prep, including schedules and supporting documentation for the annual audit, the Single Audit and the 990.

  • Follow and improve our processes. Work within our SOPs and internal controls, help document processes, and suggest improvements to workflows and systems.

In 6 months you will have (6 months goals)

  • Learned our entities, structure and systems, and how the work of Convergent and each FRO fits together.

  • Built strong working relationships with the finance team and become a reliable source of support for Convergent and the FROs.

  • Owned the monthly books end to end, including reconciliations that tie out on a consolidated basis.

  • Contributed schedules and support to the audit, 990 and other year-end work.

We Offer (Amazing Benefits)

  • A rare chance to build institutional architecture for frontier science and work with some of the smartest and most talented experts from different fields

  • Competitive Salary: $115,000 a year. Convergent uses a consistent compensation philosophy across all roles, and we offer a 5-10% premium for those working from especially high cost of labor locations (e.g. NYC, San Francisco) or from our NYC office. This structure helps us keep pay transparent, consistent, and equitable.

  • Up to a 6% 401k match because future-you deserves comfort

  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance—majority of options are fully covered for you and your dependents. Stay healthy, my friend

  • Company-paid life insurance, AD&D, long- and short-term disability insurance, as well as voluntary supplemental insurance options

  • 19 holidays (including a full week off at the end of the year—yes, we enforce it)

  • 3 weeks PTO with tenure increases, with separate allotments for sick and parental leave

  • Generous fertility benefits and childcare reimbursement—because tiny humans are a big deal

  • Education and professional development benefits

  • Wellness allowance for fitness and wellness activities (treat yourself to climbing shoes or Calm.com—no judgment)

  • 3x/year offsite team retreats and additional opportunities to meet your teammates in person

Convergent Research aims to help fill a structural gap in today's R&D system. We enable fundamental research that requires unusual levels of scale and coordination yet is not rapidly monetizable by industry. We’re bringing together top talent from academia, industry, and startups to build a new model for innovative R&D.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We believe in hiring individuals based on their unique talents—not on race, color, religion, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law or our company policies. We are more than a proud Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Our goal is to foster a healthy, safe, and respectful environment where all employees are valued and treated with dignity. Harassment of any kind is not tolerated here.

Our tooling and frameworks have already helped enable the deployment of more than 70 services, reducing manual effort and operational complexity.

We’re a collaborative team that values technical ownership, knowledge sharing, and practical problem-solving. You’ll have the opportunity to work on high-impact engineering challenges, influence platform architecture, and build solutions adopted by teams across Splunk. If you enjoy creating tools and platforms that make other engineers more productive, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Impact

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Framework & Runtime Services team, you’ll design and develop the foundational tools, frameworks, and services that enable Splunk engineering teams to build and deploy applications efficiently at scale. You’ll work on distributed systems and Kubernetes-based infrastructure, helping simplify how services are developed, deployed, and operated across cloud and on-premises environments. Your contributions will directly influence developer productivity, platform reliability, and the speed at which Splunk delivers new capabilities.

  • Design and build scalable developer platforms: Develop backend services, APIs, tools, and frameworks using Go and Python to simplify service development, onboarding, and deployment across multi-tenant Kubernetes environments.
  • Advance cloud-native infrastructure: Build and enhance platform capabilities that support workloads across AWS, GCP, Azure, and on-premises environments, improving deployment automation, consistency, and scalability.
  • Improve developer productivity: Collaborate with engineering teams to identify common development and deployment challenges, create reusable solutions, and reduce the time and effort required to bring new services into production.
  • Drive technical excellence and reliability: Contribute to architecture discussions, technical design documents, code reviews, testing, and production troubleshooting. Participate in a scheduled, compensated on-call rotation to support platform reliability and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate and influence engineering practices: Partner with cross-functional engineering teams, contribute to technical roadmaps, mentor fellow engineers, and explore AI-assisted development tools and automation to improve engineering workflows and productivity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with 7+ years of related experience, Master’s degree with 4+ years of related experience, or PhD with 1+ year of related experience.
  • 4+ years of experience developing backend software using Go (Golang) or Python, including designing, implementing, and maintaining production services or infrastructure tooling.
  • Experience working with Kubernetes, including deploying, configuring, or troubleshooting containerized applications in production environments.
  • Experience developing or maintaining distributed systems, internal developer platforms, or shared infrastructure tooling used by multiple services or engineering team.
  • Experience working with at least one public cloud platform (AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure), including deploying or operating cloud-based applications or infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing backend applications, automation, or infrastructure tooling using Python.
  • Experience building reusable developer frameworks, self-service tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or infrastructure automation to improve developer productivity and service onboarding.
  • Experience with networking concepts, service-to-service communication, databases, or storage technologies in distributed and cloud-native environments.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools or automation to support software development, testing, troubleshooting, or other stages of the software development lifecycle.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Job Title:

Director, Strategic Ecosystem Partnerships

Job Description:

Why Work at Entegris


Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future.


Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences, and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort, as we recognize that there are leaders at every level of the organization.


We put our values at the core of how we operate—not just when it is convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside the office.




The Role:


Entegris is currently seeking a Director,Strategic Ecosystem Partnerships to join our Materials Solutions team. This role will identify, develop, negotiate, and execute strategic partnerships, joint development programs (JDPs), technology licensing agreements, strategic investments, and inorganic growth opportunities that accelerate Entegris’ long-term growth across the semiconductor materials ecosystem.


In this role, you will serve as a key bridge among Corporate Development, Entegris Venture, business units, R&D, Legal, Finance, and executive leadership team. You will combine deep semiconductor-industry knowledge with proven transaction experience to assess opportunities, structure complex commercial relationships, and create values through partnerships, investments, licensing arrangements, and acquisitions.


The successful candidate will have a demonstrated record of independently leading end-to-end strategic transactions and a strong understanding of global semiconductor manufacturing equipment and materials ecosystem and market landscape, supply chains, and competitive dynamics.


What You’ll Do:


  • Develop and execute a strategic ecosystem partnership roadmap aligned with corporate and business-unit strategic long range planning process and growth priorities.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of partnership, licensing, investment, and acquisition opportunities across semiconductor manufacturers, equipment suppliers, materials providers, technology startups, research institutes, universities, and industry consortia.
  • Support end-to-end M&A and strategic investment activities, including target identification, strategic assessment, valuation support, due diligence, negotiation, deal structuring, transaction execution, and integration planning.
  • Develop investment theses, business cases, synergy assessments, risk analyses, and executive recommendations for inorganic growth opportunities.
  • Structure and negotiate strategic alliances, JDPs, joint ventures, supply agreements, technology collaborations, term sheets, definitive agreements, governance models, commercial frameworks, and risk-sharing mechanisms.
  • Lead negotiations for IP licenses, technology-access agreements, know-how transfers, and cross-licensing frameworks in close partnership with R&D, Legal and IP teams.
  • Establish partnership success metrics, governance processes, executive steering committees, and business reviews.
  • Evaluate market attractiveness, TAM/SAM opportunities, competitive positioning, and ecosystem influence, and deliver executive-level recommendations on strategic priorities.
  • Establish a repeatable framework for evaluating and executing strategic ecosystem opportunities and deliver measurable growth, technology differentiation, and customer access.

What We Seek:


  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Business, or a related discipline; MBA, MS, PhD, JD or an equivalent combination of technical and business education strongly preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in semiconductor materials, semiconductor equipment, semiconductor manufacturing, technology strategy, business development, corporate development, or a related industry.
  • Demonstrated experience executing end-to-end mergers and acquisitions, strategic investments, IP licensing agreements, JDPs, joint ventures, technology partnerships, and commercial term-sheet negotiations.
  • Recognized as a visionary expert with deep, broad-based knowledge of the semiconductor ecosystem and the ability to shape long-term strategy, innovation, and business direction.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve critical, highly ambiguous issues with significant and sustained organizational impact, operating with wide autonomy and sound judgment.
  • Proven ability to serve as a principal advisor, influence senior executives and external stakeholders, establish new approaches and principles, and set direction for others across functions and regions.
  • Strong knowledge of semiconductor materials and manufacturing ecosystems, with familiarity across logic, memory, advanced packaging, and AI infrastructure; working knowledge of relevant process areas such as CMP and Depositions.
  • Strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen, financial-model interpretation, business-case development, risk assessment, and value-creation skills.
  • Experience leading cross-functional due diligence involving Finance, Legal, IP, Technology, Operations, Commercial, and Regulatory stakeholders.
  • Executive presence and demonstrated ability to influence without authority, align diverse stakeholders, govern partnerships, and resolve conflict.
  • Experience engaging directly with C-suite stakeholders and operating effectively in a global, matrixed organization.
  • International experience across North America and key semiconductor regions in Asia preferred.
  • Investment banking, management consulting, venture capital, private equity, corporate strategy, or corporate development experience is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally based on business needs; anticipated travel more than 25%.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This is expected to be a senior-level individual contributor role. Scope and organizational responsibilities may be scaled with business needs.

Our Mission:

MDpanel is one of the largest providers of expert medical opinions in the United States. We are committed to being the most coveted partner for physicians, carriers, attorneys, and patients by connecting those in need of medical opinions with the most qualified and highly regarded medical professionals in the U.S. MDpanel allows our member healthcare professional partners to maximize their time and produce unparalleled revenue opportunities. In return, our carrier and attorney clients receive timely, complete, thorough, and easy-to-understand opinions to support the medical legal inquiry.

MDpanel is revolutionizing the medical opinion space by creating the first true marketplace to connect those in need of medical opinions to those capable of providing them. Unlike traditional, services-based models, we are devoted to our healthcare professionals and are relentless about removing the burden of administration, securing exam volume, preparing for and supporting physical examinations, backend processing, report submissions, and billing. At the heart of MDpanel, our team is committed to delivering an unparalleled experience for all stakeholders. We think big, start small, and move fast. Our culture is built on supporting each other with accountability, transparency, and passion for our mission.

Position Summary:

The Physician Success Manager owns the relationship with, and the revenue from, a portfolio of Qualified Medical Evaluator (QME) physicians made up of established and growing physicians and physicians who are newly activated with MDpanel. This role is directly accountable for growing and retaining that portfolio's revenue: getting new physicians productive quickly, keeping calendars full, and keeping physicians with MDpanel.

This is a proactive role, not a support queue. The Physician Success Manager spends most of their time reaching out to physicians on a planned cadence, spotting growth opportunities and early risk, and following up before the physician has to ask. When a physician needs help, the PSM steps in on what affects the relationship and relies on Physician Support/Client Care Associates for routine, real-time requests.

Reporting to a Senior Physician Success Manager, this role is the entry point to Physician Success. Strong performers grow into larger, higher-value portfolios and responsibility for top-tier physicians.

MDpanel supports QME physicians through two complementary teams. Physician Success is proactive: it owns physician relationships and is accountable for portfolio revenue growth and retention. Physician Support is reactive: it answers every physician in real time through Live Chat, the Doctor Direct Line, and the support inboxes, and owns no relationships.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Grow Portfolio Revenue

  • Own a revenue growth plan for the portfolio, with growth levers identified for each physician.
  • Grow evaluation volume by expanding availability, improving site coverage, and increasing evaluation date utilization with Scheduling.
  • Identify physicians ready for more volume, additional sites, or new service lines, and bring the case to the Senior PSM with the numbers to support it.
  • Flag physicians whose growth warrants a higher level of service or a move to a Senior PSM portfolio if warranted.

Accelerate New Physician Activation

  • Get every new physician in the portfolio to a first completed evaluation within the target window, coordinating Credentialing, Onboarding, L&D, and Scheduling and owning the outcome rather than the handoff.
  • Set clear expectations early on production cadence, report quality, turnaround, and Studio use, so new physicians reach full productivity fast.

Run Proactive Physician Outreach

  • Contact every portfolio physician on a defined cadence, not only when there is a problem, to review volume, availability, report status, and upcoming needs.
  • Deliver a premium service standard: a response within 2 hours to every portfolio physician request to acknowledge, and no surprises on schedule, reports, or payments.
  • Hold practice reviews with growing physicians to set volume goals and agree on next steps.
  • Drive adoption of MDpanel Studio, AI Navigator and other new tools across the portfolio.

Protect Revenue Through Retention

  • Spot disengagement early: falling availability, slower reports, unanswered outreach, and recurring complaints.
  • Keep the doctor tracker current each week for every portfolio physician and write a recovery plan for every physician flagged at risk.Escalate to the Senior PSM before a relationship is lost, with the history and a recommended plan already assembled

    Resolve What Matters to the Relationship
  • Step in directly on issues that affect a physician's trust or revenue, such as repeated scheduling misses, late-report exposure, or payment questions, and drive them to closure with the owning team.
  • Route routine, real-time requests to Physician Support, and flag recurring issues so they are fixed at the source. Ensure the full resolution and closing the loop with doctors.

Represent the Physician's Voice

  • Bring specific physician feedback on Studio, Workbench, scheduling, and process into product and operations decisions.
  • Help contribute to internal testing and piloting of technology tools and new processes to ensure smooth roll-out among physicians.

Qualifications:

  • 3 - 5 years of account management, client success, or relationship management experience in healthcare, legal, or a similarly high-touch environment.
  • Track record of owning a book of relationships with a revenue, growth, or retention goal, not just responding to requests.
  • Comfortable with proactive outreach: initiating conversations, running reviews, and following through on commitments.
  • Sound judgment on prioritization and risk across many relationships at once.
  • Comfortable using dashboards and CRM data to spot growth opportunities and risk before they surface.
  • Clear, confident written and verbal communication with physicians and internal leaders.

Preferred Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with California workers' compensation, QME processes, or DWC regulations.
  • Familiarity with MDpanel Studio, Workbench, and Salesforce.

  • Develop and maintain security standard operating procedures and policies in accordance with industry best practices and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA, NIST CSF).
  • Stay informed of the latest developments in tactics, techniques, and procedures related to application and infrastructure vulnerabilities — especially in the healthcare space — and adapt the strategy or tooling to address new threats.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related field OR equivalent experience

  • Working familiarity with Terraform, GitHub, and DevSecOps workflows — particularly securing GitHub Actions and other CI/CD pipelines.

jobs.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

The Case Manager Lead is responsible for the day-to-day supervision, coordination, and execution of the pre-litigation case management team within the pod. This role ensures cases are properly investigated, documented, and progressed toward demand preparation and settlement.

The Case Manager Lead acts as the operational leader for the case manager team, ensuring case managers execute consistently, maintain organized files, and follow firm workflows and documentation standards. This role partners closely with the Pre-Litigation Attorney, who provides legal direction and strategy for cases.

What You Will Own

1. Case Manager Team Supervision

  • Supervise 3–5 Pre-Litigation Case Managers within the pod
  • Assign and balance workloads across the team
  • Provide guidance on case handling procedures and documentation standards
  • Ensure case managers understand priorities and case progression expectations
  • Provide coaching and day-to-day support to help case managers execute effectively
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison between the case manager team and the Pre-Litigation Attorney
  • Handle escalations from clients and providers, resolving issues before they reach the attorney or Ops Manager
  • Escalate friction points between case managers and the attorney to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager

2. Medical Management & Case Value Ownership

  • Own MRI rates, advanced treatment rates, and ensure diagnostics are properly tracked and attended
  • Monitor and drive case velocity — ensuring cases move efficiently through each pre-litigation phase
  • Ensure settlements meet expected value targets relative to policy limits
  • Identify roadblocks to case progression and proactively clear them
  • Flag systemic medical management issues to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager

3. Case Investigation & Documentation Oversight

  • Monitor progress of medical record collection and documentation gathering
  • Ensure case files contain required documentation and supporting evidence
  • Confirm liability and damages documentation is organized and complete
  • Review case files for completeness prior to escalation to the attorney
  • Maintain strong case file organization and documentation discipline

4. Data, Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Actively use dashboards and reporting tools to evaluate team KPIs and identify underperformance
  • Identify process changes and efficiency improvements through direct case experience and data analysis
  • Surface operational gaps and improvement ideas to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager
  • Be comfortable building or pulling reports independently — data literacy is a core expectation of this role, not optional

5. Team Support & Development

  • Lead onboarding and training for new case managers joining the pod
  • Provide informal coaching and identify skill gaps requiring additional training
  • Promote consistency in case handling practices and ownership mentality across the team
  • Model best practices in case management, documentation, client communication, and ownership through personal caseload performance

6. Personal Caseload Management

  • Manage approximately 50 active pre-litigation cases, with an emphasis on higher-value matters
  • Be held to a higher performance standard than case managers given the complexity and value of the assigned caseload
  • Balance personal case execution responsibilities alongside team supervision duties
  • Demonstrate full ownership over cases — regardless of what other departments (medical records, CV specialists, settlement, etc.) have or haven't done, the Case Manager Lead is accountable for outcomes on their cases
  • Identify workflow challenges or process gaps through direct case experience and escalate operational improvements when needed

What You Bring

Required:

  • 6-8 years of experience supporting Personal Injury pre-litigation matters on cases in multiple states or the state of Tennessee
  • Proven experience managing and leading a team of case managers, directing case strategy and workflow to efficiently drive files through each phase and toward timely settlement
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience requesting, reviewing, and summarizing medical records and bills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently while collaborating with a team

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Proven experience managing and developing a team within a legal environment
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-growing law firms
  • Familiarity with Personal Injury claims processes and insurance procedures
  • Experience with case management software (e.g., Filevine, Clio, SmartAdvocate)
  • Comfort working in evolving systems and processes

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

jobs.title: Sr Vault Engineer
jobs.excerpt: PurposeThis plan captures what an IBM HashiCorp Resident Architect (RSA) would do to move Synopsys from per-team namespaces to a self-service, pattern-based Vault onboarding model.
jobs.description:
Purpose

This plan captures what an IBM HashiCorp Resident Architect (RSA) would do to move

Synopsys from per-team namespaces to a self-service, pattern-based Vault onboarding

model. It is based on the recommendations from the June 5 and June 26 working sessions

with the Synopsys Vault team. An RSA is onboarded into your environment as a contractor

and builds alongside your Vault team, typically for a short engagement of around 3

months part-time.

Current state

Synopsys has been running Vault for about a year, with a few teams in production and

many in dev. Onboarding is automated for namespace creation only. Everything after that

falls to each team.

Namespace model: Root namespace, then an admin namespace, then one namespace

per team or application group. Teams receive namespace-level admin and manage their

own auth methods, policies and secret engines.

Onboarding flow: ServiceNow request, then the Vault team adds namespace and user

details to Terraform and pushes the change, which triggers the pipeline that creates

the namespace and policies. Teams then configure Vault themselves through the CLI,

UI or code, guided by an internal wiki.

Consumers: GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps pipelines, plus Kubernetes pods.

Human users authenticate through Okta.

Organization: No central platform team. Application teams have their own DevOps and

infrastructure engineers.

Challenges raised by the team

  1. Many consuming teams are new to Vault and need significant hands-on help to

integrate.

  1. Vault team effort grows with every team onboarded.

Page 1 of 4

Synopsys Vault Adoption: Recommended RSA Engagement Plan

  1. Teams on different CI platforms (Azure DevOps, GitHub, others) can't easily share the

same modules.

  1. No clear path to change models without disrupting teams already in flight.

Recommended target state

The target is a model where the Vault team's onboarding work is approving a request, and

a new team reaches its first secret in minutes.

Namespace model: The root namespace is reserved for platform administration.

Application teams onboard into a shared namespace and are isolated from each other

by ACL policies, not by separate namespaces. Additional namespaces are used only for

business-unit or operating-team boundaries.

Consumption patterns: Two or three packaged, end-to-end onboarding paths that

cover most use cases, built highest impact first. For Synopsys, the likely patterns are:

GitHub Actions pipelines, JWT/OIDC auth, KV secrets

Azure DevOps pipelines, JWT/OIDC auth, KV secrets

Kubernetes pods, service account auth, KV secrets

Okta for human access to manage each team's secrets

Self-service onboarding: A central onboarding repo in Azure DevOps. A team opens a

pull request with a short request file listing team name, application ID, distribution

email, Okta groups and pipeline or workload identities. The Vault team approves, and

Terraform provisions roles, policies and secret paths.

Welcome output: Each onboarded team gets generated instructions covering login, its

secret path, a seeded test secret and a ready-to-use pipeline snippet.

Two tracks: The paved path is the default. Experienced teams that need more

autonomy can be supported on a separate, agreed path.

Discoverability: Vault is documented as the secrets manager of record in an internal

catalog or wiki, so teams find it on their own.

Engagement plan

The RSA works inside your environment alongside the Vault team, in five phases. Each

phase builds on evidence from the one before it.

  1. Discover and assess

Page 2 of 4

Synopsys Vault Adoption: Recommended RSA Engagement Plan

Meet with the Vault team, key stakeholders, and one or two application teams

(current users or onboarding candidates).

Collect data on a set of onboarding candidates: application ID, platform, runtime,

language, and where it runs (pipelines, Kubernetes, cloud, on-prem).

Identify the prevailing client personas and the viable auth method for each.

Scope which secret types and usage to support first.

  1. Design the target model

Define the namespace strategy: root reserved for platform administration,

namespaces only for business-unit or operating-team boundaries, ACL policies for

team-level isolation.

Select two or three consumption patterns, prioritized by highest impact and lowest

effort.

Agree on the onboarding request format (YAML or HCL) and the approval flow.

  1. Build the onboarding automation

Build a Terraform module per consumption pattern that turns a handful of high-level

inputs into the full Vault configuration (roles, policies, secret paths).

Stand up a central onboarding repo in Azure DevOps with documentation and a

request template. Any team can open a pull request, so teams on other CI platforms

don't need to run the modules themselves.

Wire approval to a Terraform pipeline that provisions access automatically.

Use Terraform templating to generate a welcome message: login URL, required Okta

group, secret path, a seeded example secret, a pipeline snippet, and links to docs

and support.

  1. Pilot and iterate

Onboard a small cohort of willing teams that covers each pattern, and gather

feedback on what works and what isn't clear.

Expand to more teams with documentation only, treating them as beta testers.

Graduate to fully self-service pull requests, opening access gradually.

  1. Migrate and drive adoption

Route all new onboardings to the shared-namespace model while existing teams

keep running where they are.

Communicate the new model internally and set a re-onboarding window (around 12

months) for existing teams, with self-service tooling such as KV secret migration.

Page 3 of 4

Synopsys Vault Adoption: Recommended RSA Engagement Plan

Define the advanced-team path for teams that need their own namespace, by

agreement.

Establish Vault as the secrets manager of record: internal catalog or wiki presence,

a road show for business-unit leads, and a community channel.

What success looks like

The Vault team's onboarding work is reviewing and approving a request.

A new team goes from request to reading a test secret in its pipeline in minutes.

Two or three patterns cover roughly 80% of onboarding requests.

Vault team effort no longer grows in step with the number of teams onboarded

Job Title: Network Manager

Team: Infrastructure

Job Location: Remote

About Us

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare! We build software that simplifies the process of choosing the right health insurance for individuals. Our solutions help our health plan and government customers with the administration, reporting, and operational requirements of their plans. By tackling the complexities of enrollment, administration, renewal, billing, and more, we enable our customers and partners to concentrate on advancing their core missions.

Our Company Culture

Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and appreciation. We value each employee's unique talents and contributions and understand that every individual plays a critical role in our mission to transform healthcare. Every day, we celebrate our team's dedication, creativity, and expertise, which drive us closer to our goals.

At Softheon, our mission is making healthcare more affordable, accessible, and plentiful for every American. Our vision is that everyone can access and choose the healthcare they need.

About the Role

The Network Manager is a hands-on technical and people leader responsible for managing and maintaining Softheon's network infrastructure. This role combines day-to-day network engineering and operational responsibilities with team leadership, ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of network systems across on-premises and cloud environments.

The Network Manager will work directly in the network environment, troubleshooting complex issues, implementing network solutions, supporting projects, and identifying opportunities for improvement. This role will lead and develop network team members while partnering with Infrastructure, Security, and other teams to ensure network services meet organizational needs.

Please note that the requirements of this role are beyond the 9am - 6pm scope. It is expected that all leaders are available to the organization when needed.

Requirements

You Will:

Network Operations & Engineering

  • Own the design, architecture, and overall health of Softheon’s network infrastructure, proactively identifying and addressing risks, capacity needs, and opportunities for improvement; operate with a high degree of autonomy and serve as the primary technical owner, escalating critical issues to leadership as needed.
  • Manage and maintain Softheon's network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Configure, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, wireless networks, and related technologies.
  • Perform hands-on network configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization.
  • Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity and proactively address potential issues.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex network incidents and service interruptions.
  • Participate in critical incident response, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Perform regular network maintenance, upgrades, and configuration changes.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of network monitoring and management tools.
  • Ensure network infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and aligned with established technical and security standards.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage and provide day-to-day leadership to network team members.
  • Assign work, establish priorities, and monitor progress to ensure network activities and projects are completed effectively.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to team members when troubleshooting complex network issues.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, provide feedback, and support employee development.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, collaboration, accountability, and effective communication within the network team.
  • Establish and maintain team processes and procedures that support efficient network operations.
  • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for the network team.
  • Manage and oversee the team’s on-call rotation, ensuring appropriate coverage, clear escalation procedures, and timely response to after-hours network incidents.

Network Security & Compliance

  • Implement and maintain network security controls in partnership with the Security Team.
  • Configure and maintain firewalls, VPNs, access controls, network segmentation, and other network security technologies.
  • Identify, investigate, and address network vulnerabilities and security risks.
  • Support security assessments, audits, and remediation activities related to network infrastructure.
  • Ensure network changes and configurations follow established security, compliance, and change management requirements.
  • Support compliance requirements related to network infrastructure and organizational security standards.

Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead and participate in network infrastructure projects from planning through implementation.
  • Support network upgrades, migrations, implementations, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Evaluate network technologies and solutions to improve reliability, performance, security, and operational efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive network processes and improve operational workflows.
  • Develop and implement improvements to network processes, documentation, and procedures.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud, and other technical teams on cross-functional technical initiatives.
  • Assist with planning and prioritizing network-related projects based on organizational and operational needs.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Work with network technology vendors and service providers to troubleshoot issues and support network initiatives.
  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for network technologies, vendors, and solutions, providing technical leadership and recommendations for network procurement, vendor selection, and technology investments.
  • Lead network procurement activities, including evaluating solutions and vendors, defining technical requirements, conducting technical assessments, negotiating technical considerations, and making recommendations to ensure solutions meet Softheon’s operational, security, scalability, and business needs.
  • Monitor vendor performance and escalate issues as needed.
  • Communicate network issues, risks, project updates, and recommendations to Infrastructure leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Partner with other technical teams to ensure network solutions effectively support organizational requirements.

Talent Management

  • Collaborate with the Talent team to actively engage in the hiring and recruitment process, including but not limited to participating in interviews.
  • Leverage industry networks and expertise to identify and attract top talent that aligns with the company's objectives and values.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to team members within your department and across diverse functions.
  • Play an integral role in shaping and reinforcing the overall company culture, promoting values that enhance teamwork, collaboration, and employee engagement.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Own and participate in the team’s 24/7 network support and on-call operations, including developing team capabilities, establishing and managing the on-call rotation, ensuring appropriate coverage and escalation procedures, and personally responding to network issues and critical incidents as part of the on-call rotation.
  • Although we work in a remote-first environment, all roles require in-person attendance at our headquarters approximately 2 times per year (in addition to other travel requirements for this specific role, if applicable). These visits are essential for team collaboration, strategic planning, and fostering deeper connections across the organization. Travel arrangements will be supported to ensure a seamless experience.
  • Must reside in the Eastern or Central time zone. Must be located in one of the following states: AL, AR, CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, WI
  • 10% travel may be required

You Have

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field required.

Experience

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in network engineering, network administration, or a related network infrastructure role.
  • At least 1 year of experience managing, supervising, or leading a technical or network team.
  • Hands-on experience managing and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Experience supporting network projects, upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Experience with network monitoring, troubleshooting, and critical incident response.

Required Certifications:

  • Must have either the CCIE or CCNP

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
  • Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700)
  • Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)
  • Other relevant networking or security certifications.

Knowledge

  • Strong knowledge of networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, BGP, and OSPF.
  • Knowledge of Cisco networking technologies and NGINX.
  • Knowledge of firewalls, VPNs, network security, and network segmentation.
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking, particularly Azure and/or AWS.
  • Knowledge of ITIL practices for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with Cisco Firepower and ASA firewalls.
  • Required: Experience with Dell OS10 and SonicOS networking platforms.
  • Preferred: Experience with NGINX.
  • Preferred: Experience with Cloudflare.

Skills

  • Strong hands-on network configuration, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple technical issues and projects.
  • Ability to lead a team while remaining actively involved in day-to-day technical operations.
  • Strong communication, technical documentation, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to analyze network performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Attributes

  • Hands-on and technically engaged.
  • Strong people leader with a focus on accountability, collaboration, and employee development.
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented, and detail-oriented.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Adaptable and committed to continuous learning.

Benefits

What We Offer

Eligibility to Work in the U.S.: We are unable to sponsor or assist with visa-related processes. Candidates must have valid work authorization to work in the U.S. without any current or future need for employer sponsorship.

Join Softheon, and together, we'll shape the future of healthcare in America.

Are you ready to make a difference? Join us at Softheon and help revolutionize healthcare for all.
