jobs.excerpt: Make Every Experience MatterViseven is an AI-native Intelligent Experiences Enabler for life sciences, helping pharma and biotech organizations move from fragmented content operations to connected, compliant, and measurable omnichannel engagement with HCPs and patients.
jobs.description:
Make Every Experience Matter

Viseven is an AI-native Intelligent Experiences Enabler for life sciences, helping pharma and biotech organizations move from fragmented content operations to connected, compliant, and measurable omnichannel engagement with HCPs and patients. By combining proprietary technology — eWizard, eVa, Kheiron, and Lexi — with agentic AI and strategic consulting, we support the full content lifecycle: from creation and MLR validation to localization and omnichannel publishing. Our clients include Top 50 life sciences, pharma, biotech, and medtech companies around the globe. 

What you will own:

    • Turn ad-hoc work into a clear, documented and measured delivery process.
    • Grow the team's seniority through clear grades, development plans and mentoring.
    • Make sure every result is validated and answers the right business question before it reaches stakeholders.
    • Bring engineering practices to industry standard: version control, code review, CI/CD and automated data tests for all data work.
    • Make AI a safe, everyday tool of the team.
    • Evolve the data platform architecture and take on the hardest technical problems.

Responsibilities:

    Assessment and roadmap:

    • Audit the team, its processes and the data platform; find bottlenecks and improvement steps.
    • Build a roadmap of changes (what we try, adopt or drop) with quick wins and measurable targets; agree it with management and review it regularly.

    Processes and their control:

    • Define and document standards: lifecycle of an analytics request (intake → requirements → delivery → acceptance), Definition of Done, templates for requirements and reports, versioning and documentation rules.
    • Optimize intake, prioritization and estimation; build a catalog of typical requests with standard solutions.
    • Control execution through regular reviews and process metrics (lead time, rework rate, defects); adjust when needed.

    Team development:
    • Create or update the competency and grade matrix (Junior → Middle → Senior → Lead) with clear promotion criteria. Build an individual development plan (IDP) for each team member and review it regularly.
    • Run 1:1s, give regular structured feedback, take part in performance reviews together with the resource manager; handle underperformance.
    • Launch mentoring and knowledge sharing: internal demos, pair work, reviews as a learning tool.
    • Take part in hiring: position profiles, interviews, onboarding.

    Solution validation and quality:

    • Introduce mandatory peer / lead review of analytical results before they go to stakeholders.
    • Check that the analysis answers the right business question, not just "calculates numbers".
    • Find inefficiencies (manual routine, duplication, repeated requests) and remove them through automation and standardization.

    Architecture and engineering practices (hands-on):
    • Own the target architecture of the data lake and reporting; introduce a layered data model (raw → cleansed → business-ready) with consistent naming, documentation and ownership.
    • Put all code under version control with code review; build CI/CD and automated data tests; introduce Infrastructure as Code.
    • Choose and introduce modern tools where the assessment shows real value (e.g. dbt, orchestration, data quality tools).
    • Optimize performance and cost of queries and pipelines.
    • Take the most complex tasks yourself, across analysis, data engineering and visualization.

    AI and market trends:

    • Track trends in analytics: AI assistants, LLMs for analysis and insight generation, self-service BI, augmented analytics, data storytelling.
    • Run pilots of AI tools, measure their effect (time saved, quality, risks) and scale what works.
    • Set rules for safe AI use: data confidentiality, validation of AI outputs, accountability for conclusions.
    • Raise the team's AI literacy: training, internal guides, prompt libraries, best practices; work with the company's AI Adoption owner.
    • Present changes to management and stakeholders, justify investments in new tools.

    Opportunities and clients:

    • Take part in pre-sales: discovery, solution design, estimates, PoCs for data and analytics opportunities.

Requirements:

    Must have:
    • 5+ years in data analytics, data engineering or BI, with hands-on experience in all three: analysis, data pipelines, visualization.
    • 2+ years leading a team of 4+ people: 1:1s, feedback, performance, hiring.
    • Real experience building or rebuilding team processes, with concrete "before → after" examples.
    • Concrete stories of growing specialists: who, from which level, in what time, thanks to what.
    • Expert SQL; solid Python for data work.
    • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (S3, Athena, Glue, Lambda) or their equivalents in another cloud.
    • Strong data modeling: dimensional modeling, layered data architecture.
    • Version control, code review and CI/CD for data in practice.
    • Strong skills in at least one BI tool (Power BI preferred).
    • Critical thinking: can take apart someone else's solution and find logical and methodological errors.
    • Personal, practical use of AI in analytics work (not just general awareness), and examples of bringing a new tool or approach into a team, including overcoming resistance to change.
    • Experience working with different stakeholders, including top management.
    • English B2+ (client communication).
    Nice to have:
    • dbt or another transformation framework in production.
    • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK); orchestration (Airflow, Step Functions).
    • Data quality frameworks (dbt tests, Great Expectations, Soda).
    • LLM APIs inside data pipelines (e.g. Amazon Bedrock); text-to-SQL, semantic layer.
    • Life sciences / pharma or marketing / omnichannel analytics.
    • AWS certifications; pre-sales or consulting experience.
    Personal qualities:
    • Proactivity, ownership, structured thinking, confident communication.
    • Leads and influences without formal authority.
    • Coaching style; can give difficult feedback and work with underperformance.
    • Emotional intelligence; keeps motivation and trust in the team.
    • Balanced view of AI: enthusiasm plus understanding of its limits and risks.
    • Habit of continuous learning: communities, conferences, courses, experiments.

Why Viseven?

Purpose in Every Service

Your work will contribute to solutions that help pharmaceutical companies bring innovations to market faster and improve how healthcare information reaches people globally. We build technology with purpose — because better communication can lead to better health outcomes.

Care and Connection

We believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and connected. At Viseven, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and genuine care are part of everyday work — for our teammates, clients, and communities. From charity and sustainability initiatives to an inclusive and supportive environment, we grow stronger together.

Grow and Go Beyond

We encourage bold ideas, ownership, and continuous growth. Whether it’s leading new initiatives, shaping products, or expanding your expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to make a visible impact and evolve alongside a global organization.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based salary reviews

  • Professional and career growth opportunities in a global environment

  • Flexible work format with remote opportunities

  • Paid time off (18 business days) and sick leave according to company policy

  • Family leave (3 paid business days) for important life moments

  • Comprehensive medical insurance coverage

  • English language courses

  • Professional development through forums, conferences, and learning programs

  • Team-building activities and corporate events

  • A collaborative international team where your ideas matter

Grow your expertise while shaping communication for the world’s leading pharma brands. Over 50% of our team has been with Viseven for 5+ years. Join us!

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. Success is measured by data availability delivered: better coverage and quality that customers feel and a cost per record that improves every year.

  • Make the build, buy, partner, or acquire call on major data opportunities and defend each recommendation to executive leadership.

  • Design and run rigorous evaluations that measure net-new lift and accuracy against our own corpus, and deliver recommendations backed by numbers.
  • Build and run co-sell and joint go-to-market motions with strategic partners alongside Sales, Product Marketing, and Alliances.
  • Source and shape acquisition opportunities, partnering with Corporate Development through diligence and integration planning.

jobs.title: Research Environmental Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Why RTI RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition.
jobs.description:
Why RTI

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

RTI’s Center for Water, Agriculture, Natural Resources, and Energy Solutions (WARES) connects expertise across science, engineering, economics, and technology to develop practical solutions to complex environmental and economic challenges. WARES water resources work spans river forecasting and decision-support systems, water supply planning, watershed management, critical infrastructure risk analysis, and data management solutions for domestic and international clients.

We are seeking a Research Environmental Engineer to join our Forecasting and River Operations team. This team develops operational river forecasting systems, hydrologic and reservoir models, data workflows, and decision-support tools for water management agencies, hydropower utilities, and other clients. We conduct client-sponsored research to advance forecasting methods and adapt emerging research for use in operational systems. The team has extensive experience implementing and supporting river forecast systems, integrating hydrologic, hydraulic, reservoir operations, and other models, and developing workflows for data ingestion, quality control, visualization, reporting, and forecast evaluation.

Why Join Us?

  • Do meaningful work that helps forecasters and water managers make informed decisions for the communities they serve.
  • Develop practical solutions to complex water management challenges.
  • Collaborate with experts across water resources, data science, energy, economics, social science, and software development.
  • Translate research into useful day-to-day forecasting and water management tools.
  • Work directly with clients to understand their challenges and develop ideas for new projects.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will combine project leadership, senior technical input, client engagement, establishing and maintaining strategic partnerships, and business development. You will lead project teams, coordinate technical contributions across the group, and manage scope, budgets, and schedules to deliver high-quality solutions. You will strengthen client relationships, guide technically rigorous research and implementation, provide senior input across a diverse project portfolio, and help expand RTI’s footprint in water resources forecasting and operations.

Essential Duties:

Internal leadership, development, and project oversight

  • Provide senior input across multiple projects, helping define the technical direction on projects, interpret results, manage project risks, and produce high-quality deliverables.
  • Serve as a senior client-facing lead, building trusted relationships through strong technical judgment, dependable project execution, and clear communication to understand client needs.
  • Manage complex implementation and research projects from scoping through delivery, including planning, staffing, budget and schedule oversight, risk management, quality review, and communication with clients and partners.
  • Provide senior leadership across three or more key technical areas such as:
    • Hydrologic model development
    • Deterministic and ensemble forecasting
    • Data assimilation
    • Forecast verification and uncertainty characterization
    • Reservoir operations and river system management
    • Forecast-informed decision support
    • AI/ML and hybrid modeling for forecasting systems
  • Coordinate effectively with our multidisciplinary team and with external research or operational partners.
  • Mentor technical staff and project managers.

Business development and client relations

  • Identify emerging research with potential for implementation in client systems. Communicate these opportunities to clients and lead internal efforts to build the expertise needed to put them into practice.
  • Represent RTI in client meetings, technical workshops, conferences, working groups, and collaborative research activities.
  • Establish and maintain client relationships, building trust and understanding their evolving needs and priorities.
  • Identify and develop new opportunities with current and prospective clients, particularly where RTI can connect applied research, forecasting technology, and operational decision-making.
  • Lead or make substantial contributions to capture planning, proposals, and business development.
  • Help shape new service offerings, partnerships, and investment priorities that expand RTI’s forecasting and operations portfolio.

What You'll Need

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree and 12 years of experience, master’s degree and 10 years of experience, PhD and 8 years of experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Relevant fields includes civil engineering, environmental engineering, hydrology, water resources engineering, environmental science, computer science, geography, or a related discipline.

Required Qualifications

  • Deep expertise in core aspects of operational water forecasting and decision support, with the ability to provide credible senior guidance across adjacent water resources disciplines. Experience with the data, models, workflows, verification methods, and operational constraints that affect operational forecasting and decision support systems.
  • Proven experience leading technical projects, workstreams, or applied research efforts involving multiple contributors and stakeholders. Strong project leadership skills, including the ability to define scope, organize interdisciplinary work, anticipate risks, make sound decisions, and deliver high-quality work.
  • Success working directly with clients, sponsors, operational agencies, utilities, or research partners.
  • Experience contributing to business development through activities such as opportunity identification, client engagement, concept development, proposal preparation, or expansion of existing work.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical information to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to develop and articulate new technical or research ideas and translate them into fundable, executable work.
  • Ability to provide constructive senior review, mentorship, and technical guidance to project teams.
  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ensemble hydrologic prediction, probabilistic forecasting, uncertainty characterization, bias correction, post-processing, or forecast verification.
  • Experience developing AI/ML or hybrid process-based and data-driven methods for hydrologic forecasting or water management.
  • Experience applying data assimilation methods to hydrologic, snow, meteorological, hydraulic, or reservoir forecasting problems.
  • Experience with reservoir system modeling, forecast-informed reservoir operations, or optimization.
  • Experience with forecasting and modeling platforms or tools such as Delft-FEWS, National Weather Service forecasting models and workflows, RiverWare, HEC platforms, or comparable systems.
  • Experience with coastal modeling, urban/stormwater modeling, or groundwater modeling
  • Working knowledge of Python, geospatial tools, cloud computing, or data engineering.
  • Experience working with federal water agencies, River Forecast Centers, reservoir operators, or hydropower utilities.
  • Experience leading or contributing to collaborative research involving academic, government, nonprofit, and private-sector partners.
  • A record of technical publications, conference presentations, workshops, or leadership in professional and research communities.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Description

About AllCloud

AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America. www.allcloud.io

﻿Position Summary

AllCloud is looking for a Technical Lead CloudOps Engineer: a senior, hands-on engineer who works the hardest problems in our customers' cloud environments and raises the technical level of the engineers around them. This is an individual-contributor delivery role, not a management role. Most of your time is spent on the keyboard: resolving complex incidents, hardening monitoring and security, automating operational work and reviewing the work of the team.

Alongside delivery, you are the go-to technical resource for Level 1 and Level 2 CloudOps Engineers. You take the escalations they cannot solve, show them how you solved them, and build the ramp-up material and hands-on sessions that help them grow toward DevOps, Solutions Architecture or Data Engineering. You will also lead the technical side of customer conversations, all within standard business hours and with no shift commitments.

Key Responsibilities:

Hands-On Cloud Operations Delivery

  • Deliver advanced remote cloud operations for customer AWS environments across Health Monitoring, Security Operations (SOC), AWS Partner-Led Support and Cloud Operations: incident resolution, configuration, maintenance, patching, backup and disaster recovery.
  • Build and maintain the automation, scripts and tooling that remove repetitive operational work from the team.
  • Implement and tune monitoring, alerting and observability so issues are detected early and noise is kept low.
  • Apply and verify cloud security, backup/DR and cost-optimization best practices in customer environments.

Technical Escalation & Incident Resolution

  • Act as the final technical escalation point for complex infrastructure, network, security and application-level issues that L1 and L2 engineers cannot resolve.
  • Take technical command of critical and high-severity incidents: drive troubleshooting, coordinate with DevOps, SA and Security specialists, and communicate clearly with the customer until resolution.
  • Lead root cause analysis and blameless post-incident reviews, and carry the fixes through to runbooks, automation and monitoring changes.
  • Spot recurring problems across customers and engineer them out.

Mentorship & Knowledge Transfer

  • Design and maintain the hands-on technical ramp-up program for new and junior CloudOps Engineers, and run it.
  • Hold regular technical sessions, deep-dives and labs on AWS services, troubleshooting techniques, tooling and new technology.
  • Pair with engineers on live issues and review their configurations, scripts, runbooks and customer-facing technical communications, giving concrete feedback.
  • Help individual engineers build the skills they need to progress into DevOps Engineer, Solutions Architect or Data Engineer roles.

Runbooks, Documentation & Standards

  • Own the technical quality of the CloudOps knowledge base (Confluence): runbooks, troubleshooting guides, architecture notes and operational procedures.
  • Define the technical standards the team works to for incident handling, change, RCA and environment hygiene, and lead by example in following them.
  • Evaluate new AWS services, observability tooling and automation approaches and recommend what the team should adopt.

Customer Technical Engagement

  • Lead the technical content of customer calls, operational syncs, incident reviews and operational roadmap discussions.
  • Be the technical voice in customer escalations, explaining what happened, what was done and what will change.
  • Answer customer configuration and integration questions and model exceptional, customer-focused service for the team.

What Success Looks Like

  • Complex escalations are resolved faster, and fewer of them come back.
  • Fewer recurring incidents across customer environments.
  • L1 and L2 engineers ramp faster, handle more on their own, and progress into specialist roles.
  • Runbooks and knowledge base content are current, accurate and actually used.
  • Customers trust the technical guidance they receive from the CloudOps team.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud Operations, NOC/SOC, systems engineering or advanced technical support, with a track record of being the senior engineer others escalate to.
  • Deep, practical expertise in AWS and its core services (EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Lambda, EBS, EKS, ECS); working knowledge of Azure or GCP is a plus.
  • Strong Linux and Windows administration skills and solid networking and security experience in production environments.
  • Proven ability to lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis on complex, multi-component issues.
  • Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and in automating operational tasks.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, CloudWatch).
  • Experience mentoring, training or onboarding junior engineers, and a genuine interest in doing so.
  • Comfortable leading technical conversations directly with customers.
  • Strong documentation habits; experience maintaining runbooks and a knowledge base such as Confluence.
  • High independent-learning ability, attention to detail and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills in English.

Advantages

  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD experience.
  • Container technologies and orchestrators (Docker, Kubernetes, EKS, ECS).
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional, Security Specialty) or equivalent cloud/observability certifications.
  • Familiarity with AllCloud operational platforms (OneLogin, 1Password, AWS Console management, Jira, Salesforce).
  • Prior experience mentoring engineers into DevOps, Solutions Architecture or Data Engineering disciplines.

Key Competencies

  • Technical depth and hands-on execution
  • Structured troubleshooting and incident command
  • Mentoring and knowledge transfer
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Collaboration and influence without direct authority
  • Ownership and continuous improvement

Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development. We offer competitive salaries, bonus incentives, benefits, flexible hours, and mentoring. Apply now to become part of the team.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a full-time remote opportunity. We are considering candidates based in the US and Canada only, within the Eastern or Central time zones.

The Opportunity:

We are building Mobile Session Replay: a way for teams to see what users actually experienced in their iOS, Android, Flutter and React Native apps, inside Grafana Cloud.

Session Replay connects frontend signals to session-level evidence, so engineers can investigate production issues faster and with more confidence. Web replay is already available publicly. Mobile replay extends the same story to native apps as part of our Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM) strategy.

We are starting with Android. A working prototype already exists, and you will help turn it into a product customers can trust. The plan is to push ahead from there: iOS next, then our Flutter, React Native and OpenTelemetry mobile SDKs, so customers get a consistent replay experience across platforms.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Staff Mobile Engineers who are passionate about working with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team!

What you'll be doing

As a Staff Mobile Engineer you will be the technical lead for mobile capture and replay, working across the device, the ingest path and the player. Specifically, you will:

  • Own the on-device replay library end to end, starting with Android and extending to iOS.
  • Make privacy a default, designing masking and consent controls so sensitive data never leaves the device.
  • Keep the overhead low and measure it on real devices, protecting startup time, UI responsiveness, battery, memory, network use and disk, and profiling the impact of capture and masking while the app is actively being used. Give customers controls to trade fidelity against cost.
  • Build the integration layer so customers do not copy demo glue code: adapters that tie replay to the active RUM session, sampling decisions and screen or navigation changes.
  • Work across the stack with Frontend and Mobile Observability teams on the capture, upload and storage pipeline, session inactivity handling, the timeline player and the mobile sessions and replay experience in Frontend Observability. Evaluate the format and API tradeoffs rather than assuming the current prototype approach is final.
  • Define quality and compatibility: automated tests, CI, device and OS coverage, and backwards-compatible upgrade paths for an SDK that customers cannot easily update.
  • Engage directly with customers: join calls, gather structured feedback, and help teams instrument and adopt Mobile Session Replay
  • Mentor engineers and help grow technical leadership in the team

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

Technologies you'll work with

  • Kotlin (primary, Android-first) and Swift (iOS)
  • Android media and graphics APIs (MediaCodec / H.264 encoding, view and window capture, Jetpack Compose and View-based UIs)
  • Faro (Flutter and React Native SDKs) and OpenTelemetry Android and iOS SDKs
  • Go (collector and ingest services) and TypeScript / React (player and Frontend Observability UI), as you partner across the stack
  • OLAP Database / Object storage (S3)
  • Kafka/Warpstream
  • Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Tempo, etc.)

What makes you a great fit

Description

We’re growing and looking to hire a Technical Account Manager - Healthcare who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

Claroty is a global leader in protecting cyber-physical systems (CPS), dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

About the Role:

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will serve as a strategic technical partner to our enterprise customers, ensuring successful deployment, adoption, and ongoing value realization from Claroty’s platform. You will bridge the gap between customers and internal teams, driving technical alignment, proactive optimization, and long-term relationship success. This is a high-impact, customer-facing role ideal for a strong networking professional who thrives at the intersection of technology, strategy, and customer engagement.

Responsibilities

As a TAM, your impact will be:

  • Partner with customers to plan, design, deploy, and configure Claroty’s solutions to meet their technical and business objectives while driving measurable value
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers, owning all technical requirements and ensuring alignment with best practices
  • Provide ongoing technical guidance, architecture recommendations, and optimization strategies to maximize product adoption and performance
  • Proactively identify risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement across customer environments
  • Translate customer feedback, industry trends, and field insights into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams
  • Develop technical artifacts, documentation, playbooks, and best practices to streamline deployments and enhance service delivery
  • Support escalations and complex technical scenarios in partnership with Support and R&D teams
  • Drive executive-level technical conversations and present strategic roadmaps aligned with customers’ cybersecurity and operational objectives
  • Travel to support on-site engagements, workshops, and strategic meetings

Requirements

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Professional Services, Technical Account Management, Network Engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles
  • Strong understanding of networking standards and protocols, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, as well as healthcare specific protocols such as HL7 and DICOM
  • Familiarity with principles of network segmentation
  • Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure network architecture
  • Previous experience with cybersecurity products and work processes
  • At least basic experience working with databases (MySQL and Postgres preferred) to research and query for information
  • Project Management experience and skills
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and executive stakeholders
  • Customer-centric mindset with the ability to build trusted, long-term partnerships
  • Willingness to travel up to 10%

About Claroty

Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life. The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection. Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. To learn more, visit.

A Great Place to Work® certified company, Claroty is headquartered in New York City with employees across the world. The company is widely recognized as the industry leader in CPS protection, with backing from the world’s largest investment firms and industrial automation vendors, named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: IoT Security Solutions, Q3 2025, recognized by KLAS Research as Best in KLAS for Healthcare IoT Security five years in a row, and ranking on the Forbes Cloud 100 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for multiple consecutive years.

Expected compensation for the role is between $140,000 - $160,000 USD. This is a good faith estimate but does not include equity, bonus, or other forms of payment. Pay will be determined by experience level, but those outside the salary band are welcome to apply.

jobs.excerpt: We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure.
jobs.description:
We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.

Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.

About this role

As a Sr Electrical Engineer on Intersect's Innovation Execution team, you'll bridge the gap between emerging clean energy technologies and real-world utility-scale project delivery. You'll take on ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges across utility-scale solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and next-generation power infrastructure, translating novel concepts into safe, bankable, and constructible designs. Working closely with internal stakeholders, OEMs, and EPC partners, you'll own electrical engineering solutions from initial feasibility and system architecture through field execution.

You'll bring strong foundational electrical engineering instincts, practical field awareness, and the intellectual agility to ramp up quickly on unfamiliar technical topics.

Team overview

This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition. The Innovation Execution team is chartered with getting projects online faster, at lower LCOE, and with higher reliability. We do this by taking new technologies, creative system architectures, and novel infrastructure concepts and turning them into reality at utility scale. Joining this team means operating at the frontier of clean energy and data center power infrastructure, where curiosity, creative problem-solving, and practical engineering rigor directly shape Intersect's next generation of assets.

What you'll do

Architect and De-Risk Next-Generation Electrical Systems

  • Lead technical diligence on emerging technologies and OEM equipment (inverters, PCS, PV modules, trackers, MV switchgear, transformers). Evaluate and diligence based on performance claims, safety, and bankability, and assess market readiness from a TRL and MRL perspective.

  • Run fast, practical techno-economic analyses of new concepts against Intersect’s baseline designs. Quantify the impact on capex, LCOE, schedule, and reliability so leadership can make clear go/no-go decisions.

  • Challenge conventional design practices by asking “why not?” Find architecture changes that shorten time to COD, lower installed cost, or enable larger, more reliable projects.

Turn Promising Concepts into Real Projects

  • Take ideas that pass diligence from concept to field. Define the technical scope and requirements well enough for EPCs and Owner’s Engineers to carry out the detailed design.

  • Close the remaining technical and commercial gaps through targeted analysis, factory visits, OEM engagement, and pilot or demonstration deployments, moving technologies up the readiness curve toward utility-scale deployment.

  • Stay close to the work during construction and energization, through site visits and field walkdowns, to confirm new solutions perform as intended. Capture lessons learned so they can scale across the portfolio.

Lead Creative Problem-Solving and Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Manage a portfolio of innovation efforts running in parallel, from early diligence through field deployment. Prioritize ruthlessly and keep each one moving at the right pace for its stage.

  • Act as the technical bridge between Business Development and Core Engineering. Partner with Development, Procurement, Construction, and Operations to turn opportunities into practical solutions, and make clear, data-backed cases for when an innovation is worth adopting.

  • Work directly with OEMs, EPCs, and technology partners to diligence their products, shape their roadmaps, troubleshoot integration issues, and bring new solutions to market faster.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering; Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced degree is a plus.

  • 6+ years of electrical engineering experience in utility-scale power generation, with practical exposure to taking PV or BESS projects from concept through construction.

  • Hands-on experience leading technical diligence on new technologies or OEM equipment, including comfort assessing technology and manufacturing readiness (TRL/MRL) and pressure-testing vendor claims.

  • Strong electrical fundamentals (LV/MV power distribution, AC/DC systems, protection, grounding, and power electronics) and working knowledge of relevant codes and standards (NEC, NESC, IEEE, UL 9540/9540A). You know enough to spot the risks without needing to own every calculation.

  • Ability to run quick, decision-grade techno-economic analysis that ties technical choices to capex, LCOE, schedule, and reliability. Familiarity with tools like PVsyst, ETAP, or SKM is a plus.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects in parallel at different stages, prioritize ruthlessly, and keep each one moving.

  • A fast learner and creative problem-solver who ramps up quickly on unfamiliar technical topics and is comfortable making practical calls with incomplete information.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build alignment across Business Development, Engineering, Construction, OEMs, and EPCs without formal authority.

  • Commitment to collaborative execution and technical excellence, aligned with Intersect’s core values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First.

Equity: Beyond your salary, you’ll receive an Equity Grant, giving you a meaningful stake in our parent company.

Health & wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance available for employees and dependents

Family support: Up to 18 weeks of fully paid parental leave; access to family planning and family care support through Maven

K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior ASIC Design Verification Engineer whose role will be to verify the functionality, performance, and robustness of our custom silicon designs. You will help define the verification approach, contribute to methodology, and work closely with architecture, RTL design, DFT, firmware, physical design, and silicon validation engineers. This is a hands-on role with high ownership, deep technical engagement, and the opportunity to shape first-generation silicon.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute verification plans for block-level, subsystem-level, and full-chip environments. Build SystemVerilog/UVM test benches, including agents, monitors, scoreboards, checkers, and coverage models.
  • Write SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and integrate formal verification where appropriate.
  • Drive constrained-random and directed testing strategies to validate functionality, corner cases, and stress scenarios.
  • Run simulations, triage failures, drive root-cause analysis, and collaborate with RTL designers to resolve issues.
  • Implement and maintain functional coverage, code coverage, assertion coverage, and ensure coverage closure for sign-off.
  • Manage regression testing, simulation farms, and CI pipelines to ensure high test throughput and fast debug iterations.
  • Participate in design reviews, microarchitecture discussions, and influence design-for-verification (DFV) best practices.
  • Work closely with architecture, RTL design, DFT, firmware, physical design, and silicon validation engineers to ensure end-to-end coverage and test.
  • Support silicon bring-up and post-silicon validation through test reuse, diagnostics, and debug analysis.
  • Participate in ASIC team interviews.
  • Contribute to advancement of DV methodologies and improvements.
  • Engage external IP providers and verification partners when needed.

Qualifications

  • B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in ASIC/SoC verification.
  • Solid understanding of SystemVerilog, digital logic, RTL design, and hardware verification flows.
  • Proficiency with a simulation (VCS, Xcelium, Questa), waveform debug (Verdi, SimVision), coverage tool, and scripting languages (ex: Python, Perl, TCL).
  • Experience with testplanning, UVM-based testbench development, constrained-random testing, functional coverage, and SystemVerilog assertions.
  • Experience with regression management, coverage analysis, revision control (Git), and CI/CD automation.
  • Understanding of several industry-standard interfaces (ex: APB/AHB/AXI).
  • Familiarity with embedded processor-based designs and firmware/bare metal coding (ex: C, C++).

Nice to Have

  • Experience with developing and integrating reference models.
  • Understanding of low power verification.
  • Familiarity with gate-level simulation and analog behavioral models.
  • Involvement in post-silicon validation planning and execution.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience in space, telecom, or RF/digital mixed systems is a plus.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base salary range for this role is $170,000 – $250,000 + equity in the company
  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

Description

Location: Europe (Remote)

What is Vetric?

Vetric is the intelligence behind the teams that stop crime online.

Investigators, analysts and platform defenders use Vetric to see what bad actors do in the open, from fraud and impersonation to organized crime, terror networks and foreign influence, so they can act before harm spreads.
Vetric doesn’t do that work itself but powers the people who do.

The social and video intel runs inside customers’ own products, as a dependency their roadmaps are built on, which is why reliability and depth count for as much as coverage.

Operating globally, Vetric serves industry leaders across more than 20 countries in cybersecurity, digital risk protection and public safety teams.

﻿

Why Vetric?

Vetric is profitable from day one (fully bootstrapped - we haven’t raised external funding), and we’re building foundational technology - not chasing trends. Because this is infrastructure that matters, we operate with engineering discipline, strong ownership, and long-term thinking.

We’re at a true inflection point: the team is now large enough to require real infrastructure, yet still small enough that what you build will define how things work for the next several years.

This is infrastructure that matters and so is how we operate internally. You’ll be working with a sharp, focused team that takes engineering discipline seriously and is intentionally building an organization that matches the quality of its product.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Security Researcher to join our Mobile Reverse Engineering team, working remotely from anywhere in Europe. You’ll reverse engineer some of the world’s most widely used Android apps, uncover how they really work, and build the tools that turn your findings into the data pipelines our customers rely on.

Role & Responsibilities

As a Security Researcher, your role will include:

  • Reverse engineering major Android applications to extract strategic product intelligence.
  • Working with tools such as Frida, JEB, Ghidra, IDA, and custom-built instrumentation frameworks.
  • Analyzing obfuscation techniques, ARM-native binaries, and root/jailbreak detection mechanisms.
  • Assessing architectural and functional changes across app versions.
  • Developing internal tools and scripts to automate and scale static/dynamic analysis workflows.
  • Analyzing TLS and HTTP/2 fingerprints.
  • Extracting and reconstructing data structures such as Protobuf and GraphQL.
  • Researching and developing bot detection evasion techniques.
  • Analyzing RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection) mechanisms.
  • Analyzing hardware attestation mechanisms.
  • Using AI tools to speed up and support the research process.
  • Collaborating with engineering and intelligence teams to turn technical findings into actionable insights.

Note: All research is conducted strictly within legal and ethical boundaries. We do not engage in hacking or unauthorized access.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 3+ years in Android reverse engineering, mobile security research, or related low-level development roles.
  • Strong proficiency in Android internals and Java, with working knowledge of Smali and APK structure.
  • Scraping experience.
  • Deep understanding of Frida and runtime manipulation techniques on Android.
  • A curiosity-driven mindset with a passion for exploring undocumented system behaviors and edge cases.

We’d be lucky if you had

  • Familiarity with Typescript scripting for analysis automation.
  • Experience with anti-analysis evasion, obfuscators, or commercial packers.
  • Previous work with IDA Pro, Radare2, or other RE platforms.
  • Web scraping, JavaScript deobfuscation, browser security analysis and fingerprinting

We hire people, not just skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this role is a great fit for you, even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements.

Role Overview

  • Location: Toronto, Ontario. Remote, with in-person team days and events.
  • Employment Type: Full-time, permanent
  • Openings: 2

About elia

elia is the all-in-one workplace operations platform for large organizations. Desk and room booking, visitor management, occupancy sensors, smart lockers, digital signage, asset management: we bring it all together in a single platform. Large organizations trust us in Canada, the United States, and around the world. We are a fast-growing team of about 40 people, and we plan to reach about 120 over the next three years. Everyone has a direct impact on the product and on how we build the company, and AI is part of how we work.

The Role

Ask anyone who runs an office for a large company what their week looks like: meeting rooms double-booked, desks empty on Friday and fought over on Wednesday, visitors waiting at reception because nobody knew they were coming, and five different tools that don't talk to each other.

elia fixes that with one platform for the teams who run the workplace: Facilities, IT, and HR. We work with large organizations across Canada, and we are building our sales team in Toronto.

As an SDR, you open the door. You call people in Ontario's largest organizations, start real conversations about how their workplace runs, and book the discovery calls our Account Executive turns into deals. This is a high-volume phone role: you spend your days calling people you have never met.

What You Will Do

  • Make a high volume of cold calls every day to a defined list of large Ontario organizations (500+ employees).
  • Use the phone as your main channel, supported by email and LinkedIn.
  • Research each account before you reach out, so every call has a real reason behind it.
  • Book discovery calls with the right people in Facilities, Workplace, Real Estate, IT, and HR.
  • Write a clear handoff note for every call: who is attending, what problem they likely have, and why now.
  • Make sure prospects show up, and rebook when they don't.
  • Work closely with your Account Executive on which accounts to go after each month.
  • Keep HubSpot accurate ("If it isn't in the CRM, it didn't happen").

What You Bring

  • Ideally some experience calling prospects or customers cold: an outbound or SDR role, telemarketing, recruiting, or inside sales (any industry works; you do not need to know ours).
  • Recent graduates with real motivation for a sales career are welcome (experience gives you an edge, drive gets you in the door).
  • Comfort on the phone all day: you call people and don't hide behind email.
  • Resilience: most calls get no answer, and you keep going anyway.
  • Curiosity about how businesses work, and the discipline to research before you reach out.
  • Clear spoken and written English.
  • A quiet home workspace where you can make calls all day.
  • French is an asset.

Comfortable with Technologies

  • You should be comfortable with technologies and already be leveraging AI tools in your day-to-day work.
  • We are looking for someone who is tech-savvy, understands platforms well, and is curious to try out different tools.

Where This Role Leads

This is the first step on a published sales career ladder, not a dead end. The path is defined by a formula, not by opinion: SDRs move through five levels with clear targets, then to Sales Associate, where you own and close your own deals, and then to Account Executive. Strong performers are promoted to Sales Associate, often within about a year. You learn the workplace market from the ground up, and that knowledge is what moves you up.

What We Offer

  • Uncapped commission, based on the discovery calls you generate that our team then completes.
  • A clear, published career ladder from SDR to Sales Associate to Account Executive.
  • A home office we equip for you (as there is no Toronto office for now; a shared workspace may come later).
  • A flexible schedule.
  • Free access to Tonic Gym, or $100 toward sports.
  • Our famous G-PHEST team events.
  • Comprehensive group insurance.

Job Title: Executive Director, Strategy & Insights

Reporting Relationship:Dean of DeVoe School of Business, Technology, and Leadership

Summary of Position:The Executive Director, Strategy & Insights is a full-time, 12-month administrative position in the DeVoe School of Business, Technology, and Leadership (DBTL). Reporting to the Dean, this role connects DBTL's strategy to the systems, data, projects, and public voice that carry it out.

The Executive Director leads the DBTL Data & Insights team and works with IT, Salesforce, and data and analytics teams to prioritize DBTL's projects and deliver the program data faculty and chairs need. They own the master view of work in progress across the school and keep it moving. They supervise the Director, Undergraduate Program Success. They also lead DBTL's voice and visibility, turning faculty insight into content for external audiences, and support the Dean's work with the Advisory Council.

This role supports academic leadership rather than replacing it. Faculty and division chairs own curriculum and program development. The Executive Director makes sure they have the data, coordination, and visibility to do that work well.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Systems, data, and insight
    • Partner with IT, the Salesforce team, and data and analytics teams to prioritize and sequence the DBTL project portfolio
    • Translate faculty and administrative needs into scoped requests those teams can act on, and translate their constraints back into terms DBTL can plan around
    • Build and maintain dashboards that give faculty and chairs enrollment, retention, and program health data ahead of program review, not during it
    • Lead the DBTL Data & Insights team and its work on course, faculty, and student insights
    • Establish shared definitions for the metrics that matter, so DBTL and the broader University work from the same numbers
  • Voice and visibility
    • Lead DBTL's voice and visibility work, and convene the Voice and Visibility group
    • Own DBTL's content calendar. Work with the Center for Applied Ethics & AI, the Center for the Advancement of Followership, and other Center teams to keep calendars aligned
    • Draw insight from faculty and package it for external audiences, including articles, social media, podcasts, and events. Partner with the Associate Dean for Doctoral Programs, who leads faculty research and scholarship
    • Publish DBTL news on LinkedIn and other channels
    • Partner with IWU Marketing on brand standards, channels, and campaigns
    • Coordinate the event calendar with the Director of School Operations
  • Project and portfolio management
    • Own the master view of what's in process across new program development, systems work, and student success initiatives
    • Run the cadence for that work (intake, prioritization, status, and escalation), so projects move without the Dean having to chase them
    • Identify where a project has stalled on a dependency, and get it unstuck
    • Report portfolio status and decisions needed to the Dean and the school leadership team
  • Undergraduate student success leadership
    • Supervise the Director, Undergraduate Program Success, and set annual goals for undergraduate retention, progression, and student experience
    • Make sure retention and early-alert data reach the people who can act on it, including the Director, chairs, faculty, and advising
    • Partner with the division chairs, who own undergraduate curriculum and faculty, so curriculum and student success work toward shared outcomes
  • Advisory Council and external connection
    • Support the Dean's preparation, follow-up, and ongoing connection with the DBTL Advisory Council and its subcommittees
    • Prepare materials that let council members see DBTL's trajectory in data beyond individual stories
    • Support the Dean's external engagement, coordinating handoffs with IWU's partnership and enterprise teams
  • School leadership and service
    • Serve on the school's leadership team with the Associate Dean, division chairs, and directors
    • Serve on School, College, and University committees as assigned, and attend school meetings and commencement exercises
  • Perform other responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications:According to Indiana Wesleyan University employment policy all employees must possess a strong Christian commitment and adhere to the standards outlined in the IWU Community Lifestyle Statement.

Education

  • Master's degree from a regionally accredited institution required in business, technology, leadership or related field
  • A doctorate in business, technology, leadership, or a related field is preferred

Experience

  • Required experience
    • Significant professional experience, measured by both length of service and level of responsibility, in higher education administration, strategy, institutional research, or a related field
    • A record of turning data into decisions: working with analytics or IT teams to build reporting and dashboards that leaders actually use
    • A record of leading complex, cross-functional projects through to completion
    • Experience in content strategy, communications, or external relations
    • Supervisory experience
    • A strong commitment to the University's mission and to Christ-centered higher education
  • Preferred experience
    • Experience in adult, online, or professional higher education
    • Experience with student success or retention initiatives
    • Experience working with Salesforce or a comparable CRM

Required Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to translate between technical teams and academic leaders, and to earn the trust of faculty
  • Demonstrated project and portfolio management skills, including prioritization and running a regular operating cadence
  • Demonstrated proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools
  • Strong writing and editing skills for external audiences, including social media
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office products

Acknowledging visible or invisible differences, our community authentically values each member's earthly and eternal worth. jobs.excerpt: Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English.
jobs.description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.

About the project

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.

About the roles

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience& skillsets.

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November

  • Languages: French

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

  • Project compensation: varies depends on different programming language

  • Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

  1. Language test: short exercises in the target language.

  1. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

  1. Financial Onboarding & Role placement:complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

  1. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

Job Reference: #L1-CC1

Why Join Welo Data?

✨ Limitless Flexibility 

Project-based opportunities that fit your availability. Choose when and how much you want to contribute—fully remote, with complete autonomy. 
🌱 Limitless Growth 
Optional access to AI and Large Language Model workshops designed specifically for professionals like you. No coding required—just your expertise. 
🌍 Limitless Support 
Be part of a global contributor community with responsive guidance and support. 
💡 Real Impact 
Apply your expertise in the Legal field to influence the AI systems shaping the future of your industry—while collaborating with data professionals and expanding your skills.

How to Apply?

Apply now by answering a few quick questions to join our database and become part of our growing community.

About Welo Data

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.
At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

About DuploCloud

DuploCloud is an AI-native DevOps platform that provisions, secures, and governs cloud infrastructure across public and private clouds. Our AI DevOps Engineers, specialized agents for Kubernetes, observability, security, compliance, and cost optimization, don't just recommend changes. They execute real infrastructure work within guardrails, so engineering teams ship faster, patch vulnerabilities, manage costs and stay compliant.

From startups to enterprises, customers use DuploCloud to automate provisioning, CI/CD, and day-to-day operations while staying compliant with standards like SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI. DuploCloud has been named to the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies four years in a row. We are venture-backed by investors including WestBridge Capital and StepStone Group.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Product Marketing who knows how to win over deeply technical buyers. You'll own how DuploCloud is positioned, priced, packaged, and launched to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform and DevOps engineers, and developers, an audience that spots fluff instantly and rewards substance.

You'll work directly with our product team, Founder and analysts to sharpen the company narrative, shape pricing strategy, and bring our AI DevOps story to market. You'll also be an AI-first marketer: someone who uses AI tools every day to research faster, test messaging, produce content at scale, and turn data into decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with our leadership team. Act as a strategic thought partner on company vision, category positioning, and narrative. Translate our product and founder's technical vision into messaging that resonates with buyers, analysts, and investors.
  • Own positioning and messaging for technical audiences. Build persona-based messaging for CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform engineers, DevOps/SRE teams, security leaders, and developers. Make complex topics (Kubernetes, IaC, compliance automation, agentic AI) clear without dumbing them down.
  • Shape pricing and packaging. Bring a point of view on pricing models, tiers, and packaging for DevOps and AI products. Use win/loss data, competitive pricing, and customer research to recommend changes, and partner with the CEO, product, and sales on decisions.
  • Lead product launches. Own go-to-market plans for new capabilities, including AI DevOps Engineers, from beta through GA, for both new prospects and existing customers.
  • Hands on with the product. Ability to download, install and learn DuploCloud to do demos and build agents for customers, prospects and analysts to demonstrate our capabilities and shape our product strategy.
  • Enable sales. Build pitch decks, battlecards, demo narratives, ROI stories, and objection handling that help sellers and solutions engineers win technical evaluations.
  • Drive competitive and market intelligence. Track the DevOps, platform engineering, cloud security, and AI agent landscape. Turn insights into positioning, product feedback, and sales plays.
  • Create developer-credible content. Lead technical content such as blogs, solution briefs, reference architectures, webinars, and reports that earn trust with engineers and decision-makers.
  • Use AI across your work. Apply AI tools to market and competitive research, customer interview synthesis, message testing, content drafting and repurposing, sales enablement assets, campaign analysis, and launch workflows. Help the broader marketing team adopt AI-driven ways of working.
  • Be the voice of the customer. Feed customer and market requirements to product management to shape roadmap and integrations.

What You Bring

  • 8–10+ years of product marketing experience, with significant time marketing technical products such as developer tools, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or cybersecurity.
  • A track record of marketing to technical personas (CTOs, engineering leaders, developers, DevOps/SRE and security engineers) and demonstrating credibility.
  • Hands-on familiarity with DevOps and cloud concepts: AWS/Azure/GCP, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, observability, and security/compliance frameworks.
  • Experience shaping pricing and packaging for SaaS or usage-based products.
  • Experience working directly with founders or C-level executives in a fast-moving, venture-backed company.
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or AI-enabled marketing platforms) to work faster and better, and the judgment to know where human review matters.
  • Proven success building and running go-to-market programs and product launches.
  • Strong writing skills and the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, concise messaging, presentations, and plans.
  • Analytical mindset: comfortable with data, win/loss analysis, and turning insights into action.
  • Technical know-how for installing and using developer tools and platforms.
  • Ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across product, sales, partners, and marketing.
  • BS/BA required; technical degree or MBA a plus.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25%.

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing AI or agentic AI products.
  • Prior hands-on technical role (engineer, SE, DevOps) before moving into marketing.
  • Experience with cloud marketplace and hyperscaler partner go-to-market (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with product-led growth or developer community programs.

Compensation

At DuploCloud we recognize the value you bring. Our compensation package is tailored to your experience, location, and skills, and comes with a comprehensive set of benefits.

Range: $180,000 – $220,000, depending on location and level of experience.

Agility PR Solutions provides today’s communicators with powerful and intuitive AI powered media outreach, monitoring, and measurement solutions. For almost twenty years, Agility has helped clients from across industries and continents discover relevant journalists and influencers, make meaningful connections with the media, amplify their stories, monitor media coverage and social conversations, and report on the impact of their public relations activities. Agility is one of the fastest growing companies in the PR tech space and it’s recognized by users on G2 for ease of use, quick implementation, and outstanding customer service.

We are a remote-first company, with colleagues based across vibrant cities in Canada, US, the UK, Philippines and India. Reporting to the Vice President, Sales, the Account Executive, Strategic Growth is responsible for growing B2B SaaS revenue within our existing client accounts by expanding Agility into new locations, business units and regions.   • Collaborate with Revenue Enablement and Product Specialists to strengthen deal strategy and improve win rates
  • Work with Marketing on account-based campaigns and messaging that support expansion
  • Share market insights, competitive intelligence and customer feedback with internal stakeholders
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of sales processes, tools and best practices

What You'll Bring

  • Proven success selling B2B SaaS to mid-market and large organizations, with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota
  • Experience growing existing accounts through upsell, cross-sell or expansion into new teams, locations or regions
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage pipeline effectively
  • A consultative sales approach with strong discovery and objection-handling skills
  • Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying groups and building internal champions to close deals
  • Experience working within a modern, high-performing sales team that uses data, defined process and structured sales methodology to drive results

Why You'll Love It Here

  • RRSP matching

  • Career Development & Progression opportunities

This role offers On-Target Earnings (OTE) of approximately C$250,000-$275,000 annually, inclusive of base salary and target commission. Final compensation will reflect the successful candidate's experience, skills, and internal equity.

This is for a vacant role.

AI does not make hiring decisions at Agility. The Strategic Account Manager, Clinical Lab’s primary focus is to drive laboratory sales of their assigned accounts by providing product knowledge and sales expertise to the account and to collaborate with the Henry Schein HCS National and Regional Account Manager. Critical responsibilities include engaging Mid and Up Market key customer executive management to understand needs, recommending solutions and establishing contractual agreements. The SAM, Clinical Lab maintains customer relationships, advises with specific key customers, and works with HCS sales to communicate key initiatives and reports market trends and needs. This position will be customer facing and will require frequent travel.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Responsible for delivering a unique and superior customer experience to large Mid-Market, and Up-Market customers with regard to HS Clinical Lab equipment and POC technology and financial portfolios. Manage all lab related customer expectations and issue resolution with CLS/POC / HCS leadership and vendor partners.
• Achieve annual sales goals established by VP Capital Equipment and Senior Manager.
• Develop, implement and revise as needed our customer LAB power point presentation to be shared by LAB and HCS – a national one voice sharing our lab product and specialist’s capabilities. Provide overview lab sales training to HCS SAMS, NAMS to ensure comfort and overall understanding in front of customers. Become fluent in all GPO equipment pricing schedules in turn educating CLS/POC management to best choices / best practices.
• Work closely with HCS National Account Managers keeping them informed, updated and well connected to CLS/POC. Present with HCS to National accounts as needed. Develop formulary for lab offerings specific to the National and Regional Account.
• Participate in RFI & RFP requests from GPO contracts and work closely with HS GPO leaders that report to HCS GPO General Manger to ensure HS maintains and grows contract affiliation on the GPO for lab offerings. Assist HCS GPO managers in educating GPO’s as to Henry Schein’s capabilities in the lab market.
• Keep travel expense reporting current on a monthly basis while keeping them to a minimum.
• Attend HCS Customer presentations, Equipment Expos, Trade shows (selective), HSI sales meetings and all LAB team functions.
• Participates in special projects and performs other duties as required.


In addition to the essential duties and responsibilities listed above, all positions are also responsible for:

  • Meeting company standards pertaining to quantity and quality of work performed on an ongoing basis, performing all work related tasks in a manner that is in compliance with all Company policies and procedures including WorldWide Business Standards.
  • Adhering to Company policies, procedures, and directives regarding standards of workplace behavior in completing job duties and assignments.

Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Excellent sales skills and extensive medical equipment product knowledge


Experience:

• 5 years industry experience with strong lab background preferred.


The posted range for this position is $99,622 – 155,660 which is the expected starting base salary range for an employee who is new to the role to fully proficient in the role. Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including education, prior experience, training, current skills, certifications, location/labor market, internal equity, etc. At the time of this posting, this position is eligible for a bonus not reflected in the posted range subject to the achievement of the plan.
