WHO WE ARE

Elliott Davis pairs forward-thinking tax, assurance and consulting services with industry-leading workplace culture. Our nine offices — located in the fastest growing cities in the US — are built on a foundation of inclusivity, collaboration, and collective growth. We work daily to provide exceptional service to our people, customers, and our communities. Audit and assurance services are provided by Elliott Davis, LLC(doing business in NC and D.C. as Elliott Davis, PLLC), a licensed CPA firm.

Position Overview:

The Senior Solution Architect leads the enterprise data engagements from first conversation to go-live. You'll scope the work with client executives, design the architecture, and lead the team that delivers it. This is a Senior Manager-level role.

You'll work across platforms rather than inside a single toolset: cloud data warehouses, ERP and operational sources, integration, semantic models, and business intelligence. The role suits someone who understands what finance and operations leaders need, and who still builds when the problem is hard.

Within your first year, you'll take enterprise data opportunities from scoping through delivery without a Director running them. Clients will see you as their trusted architect, and our Principal Architect will rely on you for design reviews and standards.

Responsibilities:

Scoping and solutioning

• Lead discovery with client executives and turn business problems into solution architectures, roadmaps, and phased plans.

• Build estimates, staffing models, and statements of work, and own the technical content of proposals.

• Recommend the right platform and approach for each client's data, systems, budget, and team.

• Present and demo solutions to executive buying committees.

Engagement execution

• Lead enterprise data engagements end to end: design, build, testing, deployment, and adoption.

• Serve as the primary client contact and run design reviews, steering committees, and executive readouts.

• Manage scope, budget, risks, and timelines across concurrent engagements.

• Hold the delivery team to a high bar for quality and maintainability.

Architecture and technical leadership

• Design warehouses, lakehouses, integrations, semantic models, and reporting on the platform that fits the client, whether Oracle, Microsoft, Snowflake, Databricks, or others.

• Integrate ERP, CRM, and operational data from APIs, flat files, and middleware.

• Get hands-on for difficult modeling, SQL, integration, and performance problems.

• Bring AI into solutions and delivery, from AI-assisted development to AI-enabled analytics.

• Partner with our Principal Architect on reference architectures, standards, and accelerators.

Client advisory and growth

• Guide clients through ERP migrations and post-acquisition system and data consolidation.

• Identify expansion opportunities and help shape repeatable offerings.

People leadership

• Lead and develop consultants and architects, including distributed and offshore team members.

• Review designs, models, and code, and coach the team through client exposure.

Required

• 10+ years in data, BI, or analytics, including several years leading teams and data initiatives.

• Data warehouse and semantic model design, including dimensional modeling and star schemas.

• Strong SQL and integration experience across APIs, file-based feeds, and middleware or ETL tools.

• Experience with ERP-sourced data (for example NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards, or SAP) and the finance, sales, and supply chain processes behind it.

• Experience scoping and estimating data projects, for clients or internal stakeholders.

• A track record of measurable business outcomes, such as a faster close, better forecasting, or less manual reporting.

• Executive presence: comfortable leading steering committees and presenting to CFOs and larger audiences.

Preferred

• Experience across more than one BI platform (for example Power BI, Oracle Analytics Cloud, or Tableau).

jobs.excerpt: Senior Google Media Buyer MVR Digital | Remote | Full-Time About MVR DigitalMVR Digital is a performance marketing agency recognized by Adweek as one of the Fastest Growing Agencies.
jobs.description:
Senior Google Media Buyer MVR Digital | Remote | Full-Time

About MVR Digital

MVR Digital is a performance marketing agency recognized by Adweek as one of the Fastest Growing Agencies. We manage paid media for growth-stage DTC and e-commerce brands spending $100K to $1M+ monthly across Meta, Google, TikTok, and more.

We're remote-first with roots in New York, Denver, and Canada. Our clients come to us after being burned by agencies that overpromise. They stay because we own outcomes and tell them the truth.

The Role

You'll manage Google Ads campaigns across multiple e-commerce and DTC accounts, working closely with strategists and client success. This role is non-client-facing, but it's not purely executional either.

We want someone who understands Google's ecosystem well enough to have opinions. You know when the campaign structure is working against the algorithm, when Performance Max is cannibalizing Search, and when the bidding strategy needs a reset. You bring that thinking to the team, and you execute on it with precision.

EST hours preferred, with required overlap from 10 AM to 1 PM EST. As the agency scales, strong buyers get access to larger and more complex accounts.

What You'll Do

  • Own Google Ads execution across e-commerce accounts, including Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube, and Demand Gen
  • Monitor daily pacing and performance, adjusting budgets and bids as needed
  • Troubleshoot issues quickly and execute optimizations without waiting to be prompted
  • Contribute strategic input on account structure, testing approach, and campaign architecture
  • Run structured tests across bidding strategies, audiences, and creative formats
  • Stay current on Google platform changes, algorithm behavior, and best practices, and apply them proactively
  • Maintain tracking integrity across GA4, GTM, and conversion events, and flag data quality issues before they affect decisions
  • Build and maintain Looker Studio reporting that gives the CSM and strategist what they need without extra asks
  • Maintain clean campaign structures, naming conventions, and documentation across all accounts
  • Collaborate in Slack and ClickUp to stay aligned with strategists and client success

What You Bring

Google (Required)

  • 4+ years of hands-on Google Ads buying experience for DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Deep expertise across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and YouTube, including the strategic rationale behind each
  • Strong understanding of Google's machine learning systems and how campaign structure decisions affect them
  • Experience managing accounts with $100K+ monthly ad spend across multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to diagnose performance issues at the structural, bidding, and creative level
  • Solid command of GA4, GTM, conversion tracking setup, and attribution windows
  • Current on Google platform changes and able to translate them into account decisions
  • E-commerce background

Nice to Have

  • Meta Ads experience for DTC or e-commerce brands
  • TikTok Ads Manager experience
  • Microsoft Ads experience

Working Style

  • You work autonomously and follow through without reminders
  • You bring observations and recommendations, not just status updates
  • You communicate clearly in writing in an async-first environment
  • You flag performance shifts before they show up on someone else's radar

How We Work

Our values shape how we operate day to day, not just what we put on a website.

  • Act Like an Owner. You spot problems and bring solutions. Waiting to be told is not the standard.
  • Clarity Over Complexity. Clean structures, clear communication, simple systems. If it's complicated, we make it simpler.
  • Serve Clients' Best Interest. Your execution directly fuels client outcomes. That connection matters here.
  • Data-Informed, Human-Led. Numbers guide decisions. Judgment closes them.
  • We Win Together, We Lose Together. Strategists, creatives, and buyers succeed as a unit. Credit and accountability are shared.

Compensation and Perks

  • Full-time contractor arrangement
  • PTO, paid sick leave, and local holidays observed
  • Flexible Fridays
  • Fully remote

You're a Good Fit If

  • You know Google well enough to push back when the structure or strategy isn't right
  • You can spot whether underperformance is a bidding problem, a structure problem, or a tracking problem
  • You flag issues before they show up in client calls
  • You want a focused role with a high-caliber team and room to grow into more complex accounts
  • You've managed multiple accounts and know how to keep each one sharp without letting anything go stale
Salary: USD $5-6.5k

We’re looking for a hands-on, AI-driven Senior QA Manager to transform QA across our mobile, web, and instant games portfolio.

Your mission is to build an AI-first QA environment, developing and orchestrating AI agents, automating testing workflows, and continuously reducing manual effort while improving quality and release speed.

You’ll own QA automation across multiple games and platforms, combining technical execution, smart prioritization, and a strong drive for efficiency.

Qualified candidates are expected to complete an assignment.

Candidates must be based in the European Union.

Your Role:

  • Drive AI-first QA: Introduce AI tools, agents, and intelligent workflows to automate and continuously improve QA processes.

  • Build & orchestrate AI agents: Automate test generation, execution, bug detection, regression testing, and reporting.

  • Own QA automation: Develop scalable testing frameworks and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Optimize efficiency: Identify bottlenecks, eliminate repetitive manual work, and measure improvements in speed, coverage, and quality.

  • Manage multiple projects: Prioritize QA across games, platforms, and teams based on risk and business impact.

  • Ensure release quality: Oversee testing, bug prioritization, release readiness, and live monitoring across devices and platforms.

  • Collaborate & innovate: Work closely with developers, product teams, and external QA partners to continuously improve QA practices.

  • Stay hands-on: Personally build, test, and implement automation solutions rather than just managing processes.

Your Profile:

  • 5+ years of QA experience in mobile, web, or instant games, preferably live-operated F2P titles.

  • Strong hands-on automation skills, including frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or similar.

  • Practical AI experience: Using LLMs, AI coding tools, and ideally building or orchestrating AI agents.

  • Technical proficiency: Comfortable with scripting, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows.

  • Game QA expertise: Understanding of Unity, device compatibility, SDKs, ads, IAPs, analytics validation, and performance testing.

  • Monitoring & debugging: Experience with Firebase, Crashlytics, Datadog, or similar tools.

  • Multi-project ownership: Able to prioritize, switch contexts quickly, and coordinate distributed teams or external QA vendors.

  • Builder mindset: Proactive, resourceful, highly organized, and driven to replace manual processes with smarter solutions.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills, including excellent English.

Benefits:

SOFTGAMES offers a competitive package, including:

  • Remote-first, your way — Work fully remote from wherever you do your best work, or drop into our modern Berlin office whenever you like. You choose

  • Flexible hours — Structure your working hours to your needs. No crunch culture. No overtime

  • Generous vacation — Time to recharge, wherever in the world you are

  • Home office budget — We fund your setup so your home office actually works for you

  • Learning & development — Training budget for everyone, whether you're deepening expertise or picking up something entirely new

  • Top-tier equipment — A high-spec laptop, ready to get your best work done

  • Meal allowance — A monthly budget dedicated to your lunches

  • Company swag — Hoodies, bags, mugs — the good stuff

  • Annual company retreat — At least once a year, the whole company comes together to connect, align, and celebrate. Our events in general are epic but our off-site Retreat is one of a kind.

Requirements

SOFTGAMES is the leading instant gaming company. We develop casual, truly social games that can be played instantly across all devices. Our hypersocial blockbuster game “Bubble Shooter Pro” became a global top grossing game on Facebook and is played by millions of people around the world every day. We partner closely with Facebook, Samsung and more to craft the next generation of instant games that billions of people can play together. SOFTGAMES is a remote first company and the home of 100 people from all over the world. Job Requisition ID #

26WD101799

Locations

We are investing in remote Regional Field Sales roles across the United States.

Our Story

The world’s innovators, designers, engineers, builders and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make a better world for all.


Autodesk’s Design and Make Platform empowers customers to transform how they work through cloud-connected technology, automation, AI, data and insights. From the buildings and infrastructure around us to the products we use and the entertainment that inspires us, Autodesk technology helps our customers design and make the world around us.


Our customers are navigating significant change, including sustainability pressures, labor and supply-chain challenges, rapid technological advancement and increasing digital complexity. Global Expansion Sales helps them unlock greater value from Autodesk by uncovering new opportunities, expanding adoption and connecting Autodesk solutions to their most important business priorities.


Position Overview

As an Account Executive in Global Expansion Sales, you will lead Autodesk’s growth strategy across a focused portfolio of assigned customers.


You will operate as a senior business partner to the customer, bringing a hunter mindset to existing relationships: creating new demand, uncovering substantial whitespace, opening new buying centers and expanding Autodesk into strategic workflows, business units and transformation initiatives.


You will be expected to lead complex, high-value enterprise sales cycles, including seven-figure opportunities and multi-year commercial agreements, while orchestrating the broader Autodesk ecosystem around a common customer strategy. Success will be measured through sustained expansion growth, material pipeline creation, increased share of wallet, executive sponsorship, customer outcomes and forecast accuracy.


Responsibilities

  • Own and lead the multi-year growth and expansion strategy for assigned customers.
  • Develop deep knowledge of each customer’s business model, strategic objectives, operating environment, industry dynamics and transformation agenda.
  • Establish a clear point of view on where Autodesk can create differentiated business value for the customer.
  • Identify significant whitespace across business units, geographies, workflows, technology estates, user communities and executive priorities.
  • Create demand and originate large strategic opportunities, including seven-figure deals and opportunities that may not yet exist in the customer’s formal buying process.
  • Build relationships across new buying centers while deepening trusted relationships with existing stakeholders.
  • Develop C-suite and senior executive sponsorship across business and technology functions.
  • Bring external market, industry and customer insight into executive conversations, with relevant knowledge of Autodesk’s Design and Make industries.
  • Translate customer strategy into compelling multi-year value propositions, transformation roadmaps and business cases.
  • Lead complex, high-value and potentially multi-year sales cycles involving multiple business, technical, procurement, finance and legal stakeholders.
  • Develop and execute competitive strategies to win strategically significant new workloads and displace incumbent technologies.
  • Navigate sophisticated commercial arrangements and seven-figure negotiations with strong business and financial acumen.
  • Mobilize Autodesk’s executive leadership and broader organization around a unified account strategy.
  • Orchestrate Technical Sales, Customer Success, Industry, Partners, Marketing, Professional Services and other specialists at the appropriate stages of the customer journey.
  • Develop strategic ecosystem and partner relationships that increase Autodesk’s impact and relevance.
  • Maintain executive-level governance around opportunities, risks, dependencies and account priorities.
  • Apply account-planning, relationship-mapping, customer intelligence, forecasting and AI-enabled tools responsibly to support multi-year account strategy, executive engagement and opportunity governance.
  • Maintain rigorous pipeline quality and deliver accurate, evidence-based forecasts.
  • Represent the voice of the customer within Autodesk while bringing relevant Autodesk innovation, capability and thought leadership back to the customer.

What Success Looks Like

Sustained strategic revenue growth; creation and conversion of substantial new whitespace; increased Autodesk share of wallet; expansion into strategically important workloads and business initiatives; deep C-suite sponsorship; successful execution of seven-figure opportunities; strong multi-year account strategies; competitive displacement; measurable customer outcomes; and consistently high-quality forecasting.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated success leading complex enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud or strategic software sales.
  • Proven record of creating and closing significant opportunities within large, complex customer organizations, including experience with seven-figure deals or comparable commercial complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to create demand and develop major opportunities rather than simply manage an existing pipeline.[KS1]
  • Strong C-suite presence with the ability to engage credibly on business, industry and transformation priorities.
  • Exceptional strategic account-planning and whitespace-development capability.
  • Strong business and financial acumen and ability to build compelling economic and strategic business cases.
  • Experience leading sophisticated multi-stakeholder and multi-year sales processes.
  • Strong competitive selling, negotiation and commercial leadership capability.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large virtual teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling and executive presentation skills.
  • High standards of commercial judgment, accountability, pipeline management and forecasting.
  • Demonstrated fluency with CRM, strategic account-planning, relationship-mapping, pipeline and forecasting platforms. Experience with Salesforce, Clari, Altify or comparable platforms is valued.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of a relevant Autodesk Solution Group industry - AEC, Manufacturing or Media & Entertainment - where appropriate to the assigned customer portfolio.
  • Experience selling enterprise platforms, cloud technology or large-scale transformation solutions.
  • Experience navigating complex multinational customer organizations.
  • Demonstrated success developing multi-year executive relationships and transformation programs.
  • Track record of strategic competitive displacement and significant share-of-wallet growth.

How we work at Autodesk

At Autodesk, we work as One Autodesk and bring our One ORBIT values to life every day: Optimistic, Relentless, Brave, Ingenious and Trusted.


In this role, you will bring those values to life by leading as One Autodesk, bringing a bold and informed point of view to our customers, making smart decisions in complex environments, creating new possibilities and earning long-term trust at the highest levels of the customer organization.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

jobs.excerpt: The Education Clinical Support Manager provides direct, day-to-day clinical and experience support to candidates working with Aya Education, with a primary focus on school-based speech-language pathologists.
jobs.description:
The Education Clinical Support Manager provides direct, day-to-day clinical and experience support to candidates working with Aya Education, with a primary focus on school-based speech-language pathologists.

This is an individual contributor role that manages candidate support tickets, conducts select interviews for school-based candidates, provides coaching, and helps resolve escalated or sensitive situations involving SLPs. The role also provides general, non-clinical support to other professionals working in school settings, including teachers, paraprofessionals, and other education staff.

The ideal candidate is an experienced SLP with direct knowledge of school-based practice and an understanding of the broader school environment. This person combines clinical judgment with clear communication, empathy, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to recognize when a concern should be escalated for additional clinical, operational, compliance, or client-facing support.

Who We Are:

We’re a $8+ billion dollar, rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform.

At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally.

Responsibilities

Ticket-Based Candidate Support and Coaching

  • Manage and respond to candidate support tickets within Aya Education’s ticketing system.
  • Serve as a primary clinical resource for school-based SLPs throughout their assignments.
  • Provide coaching, guidance, and thought partnership related to clinical practice, role expectations, caseloads, documentation, communication and school-based challenges.
  • Help clinicians navigate assignment concerns, school environments, collaboration with school teams, and other issues that may affect their success.
  • Provide general, non-clinical support and problem-solving assistance to teachers, paraprofessionals and other school-based professionals when their questions or concerns fall outside a clinical SLP scope.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve candidate needs and ensure clear, timely follow-up.

Interviews and Candidate Evaluation

  • Conduct a limited number of interviews for SLP and other school-based candidates, as assigned.
  • Apply a practical school-based and clinical lens when assessing candidate readiness, role fit, communication and support needs.
  • Provide thoughtful input to Recruitment, Account Management and other partners regarding candidate strengths, questions and potential support considerations.
  • Help ensure candidates understand the clinical, role-specific, caseload, documentation, scheduling, and environmental expectations of school-based assignments.

Escalation, Documentation, and Quality

  • Use sound professional judgment to determine when an issue can be resolved through direct support and when escalation is required.
  • Assist with complex, sensitive, or high-impact candidate situations involving clinical concerns, assignment fit, performance, school expectations, workplace challenges or general support needs.
  • Recognize and escalate situations that may present clinical, compliance, legal, employee-relations, client or patient/student safety concerns.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential documentation of support interactions, coaching, ticket activity, escalation steps and outcomes.
  • Support consistent, clear, and high-quality responses within the Education support process.

Insight Sharing and Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring questions, themes, and challenges emerging from candidate support interactions.
  • Share actionable insights with leadership to inform coaching priorities, support resources and process improvements.
  • Contribute to the refinement of workflows, guidance materials, training, and tools that strengthen the education candidate experience.
  • Support short-term and ongoing projects related to education support systems, resources and clinician experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Active and unrestricted ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) in good standing.
  • Completion of the required two-hour professional development course in clinical instruction and supervision.
  • At least 18 to 24 months of full-time practice experience after receiving the CCC-SLP.
  • Active SLP licensure which must be maintained
  • Direct experience working as an SLP in a school, district or other K–12 education setting.
  • Understanding of the broader K–12 environment and the roles, responsibilities and common support needs of non-clinical school-based professionals.
  • Master’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong understanding of school-based speech-language pathology practice, including caseload management, documentation, collaboration and communication with school teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated coaching, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Sound professional judgment and the ability to recognize appropriate escalation thresholds.
  • Strong organization, documentation, follow-through and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple departments.

What We Offer:

  • Free premium medical, dental, life and vision insurance
  • Generous 401(k) match
  • Aya also offers other benefits to those that are eligible and where required by applicable law, including reimbursements and discretionary bonuses
  • Aya provides paid sick leave in accordance with all applicable state, federal, and local laws. Aya’s general sick leave policy is that employees accrue one hour of paid sick leave for every 30 hours worked. However, to the extent any provisions of the statement above conflict with any applicable paid sick leave laws, the applicable paid sick leave laws are controlling
  • Celebrations! We hit our goals and reward ourselves.
  • Company-sponsored virtual events, happy hours and team-building activities are always on the horizon — plus, you get a special treat on your birthday!
  • Unlimited DTO — we believe in time off!
  • Virtual yoga, meditation or boot camp classes offered daily

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (w/m/d) – Software & Full Stack Applications
jobs.excerpt: AI macht uns schneller.  Das Denken nimmt sie uns nicht ab.
jobs.description:
AI macht uns schneller. Das Denken nimmt sie uns nicht ab.
Was AI produziert, überprüfen wir. Für alles, was rausgeht, stehen wir gerade.
Beim Ausprobieren sind wir schnell, beim Ausliefern gründlich.

Du verstehst Business-Anforderungen und kannst sie mit technischem Denken in konkrete Lösungen übersetzen. Du weißt, welche Fragen geklärt werden müssen, bevor etwas entwickelt wird, und worauf es ankommt, damit aus einer guten Idee ein funktionierendes Feature wird.

Als Technical Product Owner (f/m/d) bist du Teil unseres Engineering Teams und arbeitest eng mit Entwicklern und Business Stakeholdern zusammen. Du sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen verstanden, Lösungen durchdacht und Features sauber umgesetzt werden. Dabei behältst du sowohl das große Ganze als auch die technischen Details im Blick.

Deine Mission

  • Bring Anforderungen auf den Punkt. Du sprichst mit denBusiness Stakeholdern, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist. Daraus entwickelst du verständliche User Stories, technische Tickets und konkrete Akzeptanzkriterien, mit denen das Engineering Team zielführend arbeiten kann.

  • Behalte den technischen Überblick. Du verstehst, wie Frontend, Backend, APIs und Datenbanken zusammenspielen. So kannst du technische Zusammenhänge nachvollziehen, Abhängigkeiten erkennen und gemeinsam mit den Entwicklern passende Lösungen finden.

  • Teste selbst, statt dich auf Annahmen zu verlassen. Du prüfst APIs, validierst Daten und führst Acceptance- und Smoke-Tests durch. Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, gehst du der Sache auf den Grund, grenzt Fehler ein und sorgst dafür, dass Probleme nachvollziehbar gelöst werden.

  • Bring die Umsetzung voran. Du koordinierst die anstehenden Aufgaben im Team, klärst offene Fragen und behältst Abhängigkeiten im Blick. Du begleitest Features von der ersten Anforderung bis zum Go-live.

  • Übernimm Verantwortung über den Go-live hinaus. Wir entwickeln und betreiben unsere Anwendungen selbst. Dazu gehören auch Maintenance, Fehleranalyse, Monitoring und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen. Du behältst die technische Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit im Blick und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team dafür, dass unsere Anwendungen langfristig funktionieren und weiterentwickelt werden.

Deine Skills

Du musst nicht selbst Software programmieren. Aber du solltest verstehen, wie Software entsteht, technische Zusammenhänge erkennen und dich mit Entwicklern auf Augenhöhe austauschen können.

  • Du denkst technisch und produktorientiert. Du verstehst fachliche Anforderungen, hinterfragst sie und übersetzt sie in konkrete User Stories, technische Tickets und aussagekräftige Akzeptanzkriterien.

  • Du verstehst moderne Webanwendungen. Du weißt, wie Frontend, Backend, APIs und Datenbanken zusammenspielen. REST-APIs sind dir vertraut und du hast praktische Erfahrung damit, Endpunkte zu testen, Responses zu analysieren und Daten zu validieren.

  • Du kennst moderne Entwicklungsprozesse. Git, Branches, Commits, Pull Requests und Merges sind dir vertraut. Du verstehst, wie Software entwickelt, getestet und ausgerollt wird.

  • Du denkst über den Go-live hinaus. Du hast ein Verständnis für Monitoring, Performance, Stabilität und Maintenance und weißt, worauf es beim zuverlässigen Betrieb von Anwendungen ankommt.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und kommunizierst auf Augenhöhe. Du erkennst Details und Abhängigkeiten, stellst die richtigen Fragen und bringst technische und fachliche Perspektiven zusammen. Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig, sorgfältig und lösungsorientiert.

Das ist ein Plus:

  • Erfahrung mit Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Jira oder vergleichbaren Tools.

  • Background in QA, Software Testing, technischer Business Analyse oder Softwareentwicklung.

  • Kenntnisse in Monitoring und Observability, beispielsweise Grafana, Prometheus oder Graylog.

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS oder GCP sowie mit DevOps oder CI/CD.

  • Erfahrung mit AI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen oder Coding Agents.

  • Erfahrung in agilen Softwareentwicklungsteams.

Unser Stack

Wir entwickeln, betreiben und verbessern moderne Full-Stack-Anwendungen. Dabei setzen wir auf einen JavaScript-basierten Technologie-Stack und beschäftigen uns intensiv damit, wie AI unsere Entwicklung und unsere Produkte weiterbringen kann.

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Backend: Node.js

  • APIs: REST

  • Datenbanken: SQL

  • Development & Collaboration: Forgejo, Jira

  • Infrastructure & Monitoring: AWS, GCP, Grafana, Graylog

AI & Development: Eigene GPU-Infrastruktur, Open-Weight-Modelle verschiedener Anbieter und AI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge wie OpenCode.

jobs.excerpt: True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes.
jobs.description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

Position Overview

True Zero Technologies is seeking an experienced Penetration Testing Team Lead to oversee and execute advanced penetration testing and Red Team operations across federal systems and environments. This role is responsible for leading offensive security assessments, identifying exploitable vulnerabilities, evaluating security controls, and providing actionable recommendations to strengthen the organization's cybersecurity posture.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on offensive security experience, strong technical leadership skills, and a deep understanding of penetration testing methodologies, adversary simulation, and federal cybersecurity standards.

Job Responsibilities

    Key Responsibilities

  • Penetration Testing & Red Team Leadership: Plan, coordinate, and lead comprehensive penetration testing and Red Team engagements across federal enterprise systems, networks, applications, cloud infrastructure, and APIs.
  • Security Assessment Execution: Oversee all phases of penetration testing engagements, including scoping, reconnaissance, vulnerability identification, exploitation, post-exploitation analysis, and reporting while ensuring adherence to authorized testing parameters.
  • Offensive Security Tools & Infrastructure: Manage, maintain, and optimize penetration testing tools, frameworks, infrastructure, and testing environments, including software patches, upgrades, inventory management, and evaluation of emerging technologies.
  • Compliance & Testing Methodologies: Ensure testing activities align with NIST SP 800-115, MITRE ATT&CK, DHS Risk and Vulnerability Assessment (RVA) standards, and applicable federal cybersecurity policies and procedures.
  • Vulnerability Analysis & Reporting: Develop detailed technical findings, risk assessments, executive summaries, and remediation recommendations. Collaborate with security engineering and operational teams to validate findings and prioritize corrective actions.
  • Team Leadership & Mentorship: Provide technical direction, mentorship, and quality assurance for junior penetration testers while promoting consistent testing methodologies, knowledge sharing, and continuous skill development.
  • Adversary Simulation & Security Improvement: Design and execute realistic attack scenarios to assess detection and response capabilities, identify security gaps, and recommend improvements to enterprise defensive controls.

Job Requirements

    Required Qualifications

  • Offensive Security Experience: Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in offensive cybersecurity, penetration testing, vulnerability exploitation, Red Team operations, or related technical security disciplines, including experience leading complex security engagements.
  • Professional Certifications: Must possess at least one of the following certifications: Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), Offensive Security Certified Expert (OSCE), GIAC Exploit Researcher and Advanced Penetration Tester (GXPN), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
  • Technical Penetration Testing Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on experience performing network, web application, API, and AWS cloud penetration testing within complex enterprise environments, including identifying, exploiting, and documenting security vulnerabilities.
  • Federal Security Frameworks & Methodologies: Strong understanding of NIST SP 800-115, MITRE ATT&CK, DHS RVA methodologies, and security assessment processes, with the ability to apply standardized testing techniques in regulated or federal environments.
  • Leadership, Communication & Reporting: Proven ability to lead technical testing teams, manage multiple assessment engagements, mentor junior personnel, and communicate complex security findings and actionable remediation strategies to both technical and executive stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: Alvotech is looking for a SAP Functional Analyst – Manufacturing, Quality & PP/DS This position sits in the IT department as part of the SAP team.
jobs.description:
Alvotech is looking for a SAP Functional Analyst – Manufacturing, Quality & PP/DS
This position sits in the IT department as part of the SAP team. The SAP Functional Analyst is the IT owner of the SAP S/4HANA processes that run manufacturing and quality: Production Planning (PP), Quality Management (QM) and Production Planning & Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS).


The role is the link between the business and the system. You will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain key users to understand how they work, keep the SAP solution stable and compliant, and improve it over time. That means resolving incidents, analyzing and designing changes, configuring the system, and making sure every change is properly tested, documented and validated before it reaches production.


This is a hands-on functional role in a regulated (GMP) manufacturing environment. You will not run the shop floor or the quality function yourself, but you need to understand them well enough to translate their needs into a reliable SAP solution and to challenge requirements where a better system approach exists.


Key responsibilities

Application support and operations

  • Provide functional support for SAP S/4HANA, with primary focus on QM, PP and PP/DS.
  • Support manufacturing and quality processes including production/process orders, master recipes, BOMs, work centers/resources, inspection lots, results recording, usage decisions and batch management.
  • Analyze incidents, perform root-cause analysis and resolve issues within agreed service levels, escalating to SAP technical resources or external partners where needed.
  • Provide day-to-day support and guidance to Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality key users.

Planning and scheduling (PP/DS)

  • Support and optimize PP/DS planning and scheduling, including heuristics, planning runs, alerts and planning issues.
  • Manage master-data dependencies and the integration between PP/DS and core S/4HANA (orders, resources, recipes, stock and demand).

Change and continuous improvement

  • Gather and analyze business requirements and define the appropriate SAP configuration or functional enhancement.
  • Translate requirements into functional specifications and coordinate development with SAP technical resources and external consultants.
  • Own SAP change requests end to end: impact assessment, configuration, functional and regression testing, UAT coordination and deployment to production.
  • Lead smaller SAP enhancements and improvement initiatives within the QM / PP / PP-DS area, and contribute to larger projects and rollouts.

Compliance, documentation and training

  • Follow GMP and computerized-system validation (CSV) requirements, including change control, test evidence and deviation handling for SAP changes.
  • Maintain functional documentation, SOP-related system documentation and end-user training material.
  • Train key users and end users on new and changed functionality.

Minimum requirements

  • BS/BA degree in Information Systems, Engineering, Supply Chain, Life Sciences or equivalent relevant education.
  • Minimum 5 years of SAP functional experience, preferably within SAP PP, QM and/or PP/DS.
  • Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA in a productive manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on configuration experience in at least one of PP, QM or PP/DS.
  • Good understanding of manufacturing, quality and production-planning processes.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.

• Fluent written and spoken English.


Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a GMP-regulated industry (pharmaceutical, biotech or medical devices) and with computer-system validation.
  • Experience with process manufacturing (process orders, master recipes, batch management).
  • Knowledge of related modules and integrations, e.g. MM, WM/EWM, PM and MES or LIMS interfaces.
  • Experience working with external SAP partners and an ITIL-based support model.

• SAP certification in PP, QM or PP/DS.


Personal attributes

  • Takes ownership of issues and follows them through to resolution.
  • Communicates clearly with both business users and technical teams.
  • Structured and detail-oriented, with a strong sense for quality and compliance.
  • Comfortable balancing day-to-day support with improvement work.

jobs.description:
At Clover, the Business Enablement team leads our technological advancement while ensuring robust security and compliance. We deliver user-friendly corporate applications, manage complex data ecosystems, and provide efficient tech solutions across the organization. Our goal is simple: we make it easy for the business to do what’s right for Clover.

We’re hiring an Engineering Lead to own the technology behind Clover’s acquisition journey, from the public website and lead generation through telesales, broker workflows, and enrollment. You will understand how the operation works, shape the product and technical approach, lead a small team, and help build the systems yourself.

This role focuses on autonomy and engineering-led delivery: take an important business goal, understand the people and data involved, choose a practical approach, ship useful increments, and own the result. You will also manage approximately two to three engineers, give them clear scope, and develop their judgment. Expect roughly 60% hands-on technical work and 40% management, planning, and work with business partners.

Your charter includes our content management systems, telesales technology, member app, and public surface area including our enrollment forms and customer data and public analytics platforms. You will work through the whole chain, from a data source or API to what an agent or prospective member actually experiences.

As an Engineering Lead, Growth, you will:

  • Own technical direction and delivery for acquisition systems, including the public website and assets, telesales, broker workflows, and enrollment experiences.
  • Work directly with sales, growth, marketing, and operating partners to understand the business problem, choose useful increments, and agree how their value will be measured.
  • Connect analytics, leads, customer data, CRM, and operating workflows. Make data flows, ownership, and failure behavior understandable and dependable.
  • Build and improve software personally. Use AI in development, investigation, analysis, prototypes, and useful product capabilities, and evaluate the result against actual behavior.
  • Lead and coach a small engineering team. Make scope and staffing decisions, give direct feedback, and stand behind credible delivery commitments.
  • Make pragmatic choices about architecture, vendors, and existing capabilities. Keep a focused solution moving while preserving engineering quality and control of important integration points.
  • Partner with IT on the operation and support of sales tools, and with Product and our special projects teams on discovery, dependencies, and business change.
  • Observe how prospective members, brokers, and sales staff use the systems. Use that evidence to improve the experience and the operation.

Success in this role looks like:

  • First 90 days: You understand the acquisition journey and existing systems, have a clear first delivery plan, and have shipped an increment that improves our users’ experience. Your engineers have clear ownership, and business partners understand the next commitments.
  • First six months: The team has landed a new telesales stack, and other agreed acquisition priorities, including the ongoing growth demands of a five star Medicare Advantage plan. Data and tools are improving the actual sales workflow, and the result is visible in agreed operational and acquisition measures.

You should get in touch if:

  • You are a strong production software engineer who has led work end-to-end and can reason across application, integration, data, and user-experience boundaries, especially in public-facing contexts.
  • You have managed and developed engineers while remaining directly involved in building. You enjoy the scope of an enduring small team.
  • You have strong product instincts and can translate a commercial or operating goal into a useful technical plan with measurable results.
  • You have built systems involving customer data, CRM, sales or acquisition workflows, public web and content management experiences, or similarly interconnected operations.
  • You use AI deeply in your own engineering work and have practical experience building or integrating AI-backed capabilities. You can explain how you check the result.
  • You work well with business partners, make tradeoffs clear, and can move work forward when the initial request is ambiguous.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

jobs.description:
About the Team

Our sales and success teams are the heart and soul of DoorDash, helping us partner with top merchants (think restaurants, grocers, convenience stores, retailers) across the country to grow their revenue and help them operate even better. As DoorDash grows both in scale and scope of offering, the strength of our sales engine and organizational structure must grow with it.

About the role

We are looking for a Manager in Sales Strategy and Operations to be the strategic and operational partner to our SMB Business Development (BD) team as it expands its remit and increases restaurant coverage. You will own the operating foundation for BD’s merchant sales motion, including goal setting, pipeline management, lead allocation, and performance reporting.

  • In this role, you will make sure we are Making efficient, data-driven decisions,
  • Building scalable operating systems for a growing sales motion,
  • Using and advocating for AI tooling, and
  • Centralizing the metrics that drive sales performance. You’ll work with our Sales, Selection, Operations, Product, Finance, and Analytics teams to build and scale that foundation, helping BD win new restaurant partners and grow those partnerships.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build from first principles. BD's sales motion is evolving to capture top restaurants in priority markets, and this role will design how it runs: goal structures, input and activity metrics, pipeline stages, and rules of engagement with adjacent sales teams. You'll question "this is how it's always been done" and build what the team needs next.
  • Drive operational excellence. You'll set up and run reporting cadences, rigorous pipeline reviews, and productivity inspection with sales leaders, taking each one end to end from idea to execution and grounding decisions in data.
  • Own lead strategy and GTM targeting. You’ll partner with our GM teams to point BD reps at the highest-value opportunities, with clear ownership across teams.
  • Operate at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. One day you'll size goals and model capacity for a growing team. The next you'll be in diagnosing and improving data fidelity or tracing a pacing gap to its root cause.
  • Look around corners with AI. You'll find where AI tooling can remove manual work from sales operations and reporting, then build and scale those solutions, helping the team become more efficient as it grows.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 6+ years of experience in sales strategy and operations, revenue operations, consulting, business development, analytics, or related fields, with a track record of leading initiatives and hitting goals
  • You have experience standing up or scaling sales operating systems, such as goaling and compensation inputs, pipeline management, territory or lead allocation, and CRM workflows (Salesforce or similar)
  • You are highly proficient in SQL and comfortable working independently with large, complex data sets, and you are skilled at modeling in Excel / Google Sheets and building dashboards in visualization tools (e.g. Sigma, Tableau)
  • You are fluent with AI tools (e.g. LLMs, AI-assisted coding and automation) and have used them to automate workflows, speed up analysis, or improve data quality, with the judgment to validate outputs carefully
  • You are a strong business thinker who lets data win arguments and can tell a clear story behind the numbers to audiences from frontline managers to senior leaders
  • You have strong cross-functional, project management, and communication skills, and you can align multiple stakeholders around a shared plan
  • You are an owner with a strong bias for action, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to roll up your sleeves and flex up or down as needed
  • You have a Bachelor's degree or higher

Why You'll Love Working at DoorDash…

  • We are leaders – Leadership is not limited to our management team. It's something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
  • We are operators – We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions to lead our company and our industry is what we do on every project, every day.
  • We are learners – Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or one minute. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our customers, merchants, and dashers.
  • We are one team – The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

We expect this position to be filled by 01/13/27

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$125,800—$185,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools: To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview.

How it works: Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support - rather than replace - human decision-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI-enabled tool in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law.

Entry-Level Freight Dispatcher — Load Documentation

Full-Time | Remote — United States | U.S. Transportation Operations

Accurate Documentation Keeps Freight Moving

We are hiring Entry-Level Freight Dispatchers to support U.S. trucking operations with a focus on load documentation, shipment records, dispatch coordination, and accurate communication.

This position is entry-level specifically in professional freight dispatching. Previous employment as a freight dispatcher is not required. Applicants must, however, have previous professional experience in trucking, transportation, logistics, or a closely related field and understand basic U.S. trucking operations.

Load Confirmations and Shipment Records

  • Review rate confirmations for load numbers, agreed rates, pickup and delivery locations, appointment details, and equipment requirements.
  • Compare dispatch instructions with information provided by freight brokers.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent shipment information.
  • Maintain organized electronic records for active and completed loads.
  • Confirm that drivers receive accurate load and shipment information.
  • Maintain accurate communication records throughout the load lifecycle.

Transportation Documentation

  • Track bills of lading, proof-of-delivery documents, rate confirmations, and other shipment records.
  • Identify missing signatures, incorrect reference numbers, and incomplete documentation.
  • Coordinate document corrections with authorized transportation personnel.
  • Organize documentation required for carrier invoicing and factoring.
  • Maintain accurate shipment histories.
  • Identify documentation requiring additional review or follow-up.

Dispatch Coordination

  • Communicate professionally with drivers and freight brokers regarding documentation and load status.
  • Use DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards to review available freight.
  • Assist with loaded-mile, deadhead-mile, and rate-per-mile calculations.
  • Monitor pickup, transit, delivery, and other shipment milestones.
  • Update dispatch and transportation records.
  • Document detention, layover, scheduling changes, TONU, and other applicable freight exceptions.
  • Escalate discrepancies, documentation problems, safety concerns, or operational issues requiring additional review.

Required Transportation Background

Previous professional freight-dispatch employment is not required.

Applicants must have previous professional experience or practical knowledge in an applicable transportation area, such as:

  • CDL-A trucking
  • Transportation or logistics operations
  • Fleet operations or administration
  • Truck-driver recruiting with practical trucking knowledge
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Carrier operations
  • Load planning
  • Transportation coordination
  • Comparable U.S. trucking operations

Required Skills

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and transportation operations.
  • Familiarity with U.S. freight load boards.
  • Understanding of common freight and transportation terminology.
  • Ability to review shipment information carefully and identify inconsistencies.
  • Ability to calculate loaded mileage, deadhead mileage, and rate per mile.
  • Understanding of common equipment types including Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, and Step Deck.
  • Fluent professional spoken and written English.
  • Strong professional telephone and email communication.
  • Strong computer and data-entry skills.
  • Ability to work accurately with spreadsheets and digital documents.
  • Reliable computer and stable high-speed internet connection.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Helpful Additional Experience

The Work We Do

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve organizations of different sizes and across multiple geographies, providing the right solution for each client’s business and technology needs.


Our solutions help financial institutions simplify complex technology landscapes by replacing multiple disconnected systems with integrated, front-to-back platforms. Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.

jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Strong knowledge of C and C++
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows, macOS, or Linux with C++.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Play to win
    • Build for People first
    • Engage Evidence over Ego
    • Decide and Deliver
    • Ship, learn and repeat

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Installer and/or Updater development on any OS
  • Windows internals like the BITS server or MSIX packages
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint is hiring a Shift Lead to supervise service-desk staff supporting the Defense Casualty Information Processing System (DCIPS) Future. During your assigned coverage period, you will manage queue priorities, coordinate escalations, keep users informed, and oversee handovers. You will use your technical-support experience to guide the team during daily operations and incidents.

You will keep ticket ownership clear and coordinate with application, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams through resolution. The role requires sound judgment, accurate records, and careful handling of sensitive Department of Defense information.

This position is fully remote. The DCIPS Future user-support service window is 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, excluding government holidays. Individual work schedules are assigned to support that coverage.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Direct assigned service-desk staff, allocate work, and maintain coverage during the assigned support period.
  • Review ticket categories, priorities, age, and service performance. Intervene when work stalls or is at risk of missing service targets.
  • Maintain Total Contact Ownership after escalation. Keep an assigned owner on each ticket, update the user, document next steps, and verify resolution before closure.
  • Coordinate incident triage, outage updates, and technical escalation under established incident-response procedures.
  • Review authorized dashboards, queues, and alerts. Refer availability, performance, or security issues to the responsible technical teams and track their response.
  • Conduct handovers that identify open incidents, responsible owners, pending actions, and escalation status.
  • Coordinate DCIPS application, network, account, software, and hardware-support issues, including repair-service dependencies, with designated technical owners.
  • Ensure account and credential requests follow identity verification, authorization, and audit procedures, with execution limited to personnel holding the required permissions. Reinforce Zero Trust principles in access handling and escalation.
  • Review how planned changes and deployments will affect support and whether the desk is prepared. Coordinate with Configuration, Change, and Release Management, and escalate missing approvals or unresolved dependencies.
  • Coach staff in troubleshooting, ticket documentation, knowledge use, security procedures, and customer service.
  • Analyze recurring issues, recommend problem investigations, and contribute improvements to procedures, self-service content, and training.
  • Report queue performance, coverage gaps, capacity risks, and unresolved incidents to service-desk and program leadership.
  • Validate support workflows and escalation arrangements before service activation and following changes. Maintain secure, accurate shift records and support documentation.

Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • At least five years of experience supporting or leading service-desk, network operations center, or system-operations functions.
  • Experience supervising or coordinating technical personnel in mission-critical environments, including 24-hour operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage incident, problem, and change-management activities within ITIL-aligned processes.
  • Familiarity with IT service-management platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or BMC Remedy.
  • Experience using monitoring and alerting tools such as SolarWinds, Splunk, or AWS CloudWatch, and knowledge of network, infrastructure, and application troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of incident escalation, root-cause analysis, the Risk Management Framework, Security Technical Implementation Guides, and DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Strong team coordination, reporting, and customer-service skills, with the ability to make timely decisions and communicate calmly during incidents.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification, or ability to obtain it within 90 days of employment.

Preferred certifications

  • CompTIA Security+ CE.
  • HDI Team Lead or an equivalent service-desk leadership certification.

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.

However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
