jobs.title: VP of Strategic Services
jobs.excerpt: Collegewise is looking for a VP of Strategic Services to join our Executive team.
jobs.description:
Collegewise is looking for a VP of Strategic Services to join our Executive team. This is a new role, and you'll report directly to our CEO and take full ownership of the services that sit alongside our core counseling business: including tutoring and testing. This is a remote position, and candidates must be located in the United States.

Who We Are

Collegewise is a college counseling company that helps high school students confidently navigate their journey to college. We believe the college admissions process has spun out of control, with too much confusion, too much anxiety, and too many students losing agency for what should be their path to higher education. We're out to change all that.

Since 1999, we've helped more than 35,000 students apply and get accepted to schools—sometimes famous, often not—that they're excited to attend. We do it all with just the right mix of advice, encouragement, and occasional cheerleading. All of our work is backed by data and experience to ensure that each student's college admissions process goes smoothly and thoughtfully. And our work doesn't stop with students who enroll in our program. We speak in public, write, and constantly look for ways to spread relevant college planning information to anyone who needs it, whether or not they work with us.

Ambition with heart. Strategy with soul.

You definitely wouldn't be crossing over to the for-profit "dark side" here. We have an excellent reputation with both high school counselors and admissions officers. We present at NACAC, local ACACs, and at high schools and community events. We partner with community-based organizations to directly support their students and increase college access. We tell the truth, we treat people right, we recycle, and we have at least five confirmed vegetarians on the team. We're biased, but really, this is a pretty great place to work.

What's the Job?

Collegewise has spent 27 years building the most trusted name in college counseling, and the services around that core have grown fast. This is a new role, and it's time to bring in our next Wiser to help the work already happening in these teams keep growing. The teams doing this work are strong. You'll help them build on it, with the judgment to lead without close supervision.

Tutoring & Testing. You'll give the division strategic direction and own its P&L. Working with division leadership, you'll drive utilization, manage capacity, find the next growth opportunities, and keep the team staffed and supported enough to scale.

Partnership Counseling. Families come to us through corporate, institutional, and organizational partners, and they should get the same quality as anyone who finds Collegewise on their own. You'll set the division's revenue and quality targets, manage its leadership team, and hold it to a bar that is indistinguishable from our core offering.

New Programs. You'll identify, design, and launch new offerings that extend our reach. For example, launching a writing course for high schoolers, developing an AI readiness program, or building a program to enhance our affiliate experience. You'll own each idea from concept to launch, working with Marketing, Sales, and Operations to bring it to market.

Teams. Each business line needs strong leadership and capable teams. You'll find the gaps, recruit ahead of need, and build organizations that can execute without you checking in on every decision.

Each of these departments partners closely with Counseling, Sales, Marketing, and Operations, so you'll spend real time building relationships with the leaders of those teams. These three lines operate differently, move at different speeds, and share almost no common playbook. The job is knowing how to prioritize across all of them at once.

Who We're Looking For (You)

  • You've owned P&L end to end, and you've hit revenue and margin targets. You know how to run a business line, not just manage one.
  • You've run businesses, led teams, and built things from scratch. You're comfortable being the person who makes the call.
  • You've led multiple teams at the same time, ideally a mix of big and small.
  • You've launched programs, hired teams, and created structures where none existed.
  • You gather the right information, make an thoughtful decision, and then make sure it happens. When you get it wrong, you own it and adjust.
  • You work well across functions. You build alignment, and you know when to stop planning and start executing.
  • You operate without close oversight and set your own priorities.
  • You’re high EQ. People enjoy working with you, and they come away better for it.

Most importantly, you believe in Collegewise's mission. You want to help students access higher education, and you see this role as a way to do that at scale.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $140,000+ base, plus a performance-based bonus
  • Employment Type: Full-time, salaried
  • Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid parental leave; 401(k) with matching; flexible PTO; and paid holidays.
  • Start Date: January 2027
  • Location: Remote, anywhere in the U.S. We are not able to sponsor work authorization for this role.

How to Apply

Instead of a traditional cover letter, please choose 3 of the following questions to answer (150–250 words is a helpful guideline, but use as much or as little space as you need).

Application questions (choose 3):

  1. Tell us about a time you had to make a call without all the information you wanted. How did you decide what you needed to know, when did you stop gathering information, and what happened next?
  2. Tell us about a time you built or scaled a team. How did you find the gaps, who did you hire first, and what did you do when a hire or a plan didn't work out?
  3. Describe a program or service you launched that didn't exist before. How did you test the idea before committing to it, and what did you change once it was live?
  4. Tell us about a time you had to get functions with different priorities, such as sales, marketing, and operations, moving toward the same goal. What did you do to bring people along when they disagreed with you, and how did the team experience it?
  5. Describe a time you held a team to a quality standard that was hard to measure. How did you define that standard, and how did you enforce it without managing every decision?

Please submit your resume and responses through ourCareers page. Every single applicant will receive a response from us, and we do our very best to reply within 10 days.

We Want to Hear from You

If you're excited about this opportunity but unsure if you're the right fit, we hope you'll take a shot. There is no such thing as a perfect applicant (or a perfect job, for that matter). And we promise to give a fair and thorough read to every applicant who takes the time to submit a thoughtful application to us.

Collegewise is stronger because of the different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences our team brings. We're committed to building a place where everyone can do their best work—and we actively work toward that through our Inclusion, Equity, and Access (IEA) Committee, our resources for students from all backgrounds, and our everyday practices. If that matters to you too, we'd love to meet you.

Questions? Feel free to email us at (please no phone calls). We promise to respond to you quickly.

Thanks for reading! We'd love to hear from you, but if we don't, we hope you find the perfect professional fit someplace else.

jobs.title: Technical Data Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Nemours is seeking a Technical Data Analyst. This position is responsible for performing advanced, investigative analysis of data at or near the source-system level to support Audit and Compliance for operational and strategic needs across the organization.
jobs.description:
Nemours is seeking a Technical Data Analyst.

This position is responsible for performing advanced, investigative analysis of data at or near the source-system level to support Audit and Compliance for operational and strategic needs across the organization. The Technical Data Analyst works directly with raw and low-level data, developing a deep understanding of source systems, data structures, table relationships, transformations, and business rules that govern how data is created and flows across systems. The role is accountable for converting complex or ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and producing accurate, defensible datasets and findings.

This role is distinguished by its emphasis on deep data interrogation and structural understanding. The Technical Data Analyst digs into low-level data and works beyond curated data marts or predefined reporting layers to investigate anomalies, exceptions, edge cases, and inconsistencies. This includes interpreting data lineage, understanding how upstream processes impact downstream outputs, and reconciling differences between systems, definitions, and reported results. The analyst frequently prepares single-use or purpose-built datasets to support investigations, audits, research efforts, and complex operational inquiries that cannot be resolved through standard reports or dashboards.

Unlike roles focused primarily on dashboard development, standardized reporting, or data visualization, this position is not centered on producing recurring reports or storytelling artifacts from curated datasets. The Technical Data Analyst operates as a bridge between raw/source data and business-facing analytics, ensuring that downstream reporting, analysis, and decision-making are grounded in accurate interpretation of source system behavior. This role is distinct from data science functions and does not primarily focus on statistical modeling, predictive analytics, or algorithm development. Instead, the Technical Data Analyst specializes in understanding how the data actually works, ensuring that analyses are grounded in accurate interpretation of source systems.

This is a remote position.Applicants must reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Colorado, Delaware, the District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia.

Essential Functions

  1. Query, extract, and analyze data from source systems, data warehouses, and complex relational databases, utilizing advanced SQL and analytical scripting tools, data structures, and data relationships to produce accurate analytical outputs.
  1. Investigate and interpret data lineage, transformations, and business rules across systems to ensure that analytical results accurately reflect operational and system behavior.
  1. Develop custom, one-time or iterative analytical datasets to support audits, compliance reviews, operational investigations, and other business inquiries that cannot be answered through standard dashboards or existing reporting solutions.
  1. Perform detailed validation and reconciliation of data, including identifying anomalies, inconsistencies, or control gaps, and ensuring that outputs are complete, accurate, and defensible.
  1. Translate ambiguous or complex business questions into structured analytical approaches, including identifying appropriate data sources, defining logic, and understanding assumptions and limitations.
  1. Document data sources, transformation logic, validation methods, and analytical processes to support transparency, repeatability, and auditability of results.
  1. Collaborate daily with other analysts, audit, compliance, operational, and technical teams to understand data needs, explain data behavior, and provide insight into how data should be interpreted and used.
  1. Identify data quality issues, inconsistencies in definitions, or gaps in data capture processes, and communicate findings to appropriate stakeholders to support data integrity improvements.
  1. Build and leverage use of reusable queries, scripts, and analytical approaches where appropriate, while recognizing that the role is primarily focused on investigative and exploratory analysis rather than standardized reporting.
  1. Clearly communicate analytical findings, including methodology, assumptions, and limitations, to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to support informed decision-making.
  1. Perform special projects as requested by the SVP, Audit Services.
  1. Develop relationships with Nemours Associates that creates favorable reception for, and good understanding of, the Audit Services and Compliance functions while remaining independent and objective.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree required degree related to sciences, coding, software engineering, business, preferred
  • Certificates in SQL, data analysis or related fieldspreferred
  • More than 5 years experience; May consider 3 to 5 years if experience and candidate knowledge and attributes align with position and team culture.

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for the execution of revenue management processes and strategies that meet the company’s mission, standards and focus on continuous improvement, supporting the RMS Senior Leadership team to drive growth and results across the multi-brand portfolio.

SCOPE

Responsible for coordinating the revenue management functions (pricing, forecasting, competitive assessments, etc. as identified in assigned Core Deliverables) and inventory strategy for hotels supported by the RMS Team. Ensure hotels are priced appropriately and that inventory is allocated and restricted properly to ensure that revenue and profit are maximized.

Takes the lead in deployment of key MI initiatives and system changes and works to execute market-wide strategies or promotions by specific deadlines.

Provides revenue management functional expertise to designated hotels.

Location requirements: Contracted from London Regional Office however is a field-based role and therefore supports 100% remote working within the UK.

Language Requirements: High proficiency (speaking, reading and writing) in English is required. Multi language capability would be

viewed as a bonus given the international nature of the business.

Travel Requirements: Up to 20% business travel may be required.

CORE ACTIVITIES

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Expected Contributions

  • Responsible for coordinating the revenue management functions and inventory strategy for hotels across all brands, in alignment with agreed core deliverables.
  • Perform a range of tasks pertaining to the RM strategy of the hotel: training, analysis, auditing, research, report generation and software integration, including the preparation and initial analysis of weekly sales strategy packs.
  • Respond to, solve and make decisions on standard/routine business requests with limited risk.
  • Responsible for own work, with limited supervision following onboarding period, and contributing to team, department and/or business results.
  • Assist more senior associates in achieving business results by:
    • Utilizing technical knowledge and skills to enhance business processes.
      • Establishing priorities for self, and where appropriate, others.
      • Allocating own time effectively to meet goals in a manner that does not disadvantage other associates or groups.
      • Producing reports in response to internal and external requests for data.
  • Demonstrate an awareness of personal strengths and areas for improvement and act independently to improve and increase skills and knowledge.
  • Perform other duties as appropriate to the business.
  • Understand and deliver against MI revenue management initiatives and philosophies at all times.

Specific Expected Contributions (including duties and responsibilities)

  • Communicates and educates hotels on rational pricing, competitive positioning and restrictions and the impact that they may have on the hotels’ revenue strategies, whilst managing room authorizations, rates and restrictions. Effectively communicates brand specific revenue management philosophies as they pertain to One Yield recommended strategies.
  • Utilizes Marriott’s revenue management systems and tools to maximize revenue and profit for both transient and group segments, as required by the agreed Core Deliverables.
  • Prepares sales strategy meeting agenda and supporting documentation.
  • Conducts Sales Strategy meetings with General Manager and key property staff to educate and evaluate pricing and inventory strategies. Develops and implements strategies with the General Manager that will maintain and/or increase the hotel’s RevPAR.
  • Analyzes competitive performance using market share tools and shares recommendations for improvement with hotel teams.
  • Conducts remote system diagnostics audits and provide consistent recommendations.
  • Delivers training to various team members at contracted properties, ensuring hotel responsibilities are clear and manageable.
  • Executes pricing through High Performance Pricing, to include promotions, programs, and packages. Ensures compliance and participation in company promotions and digital channels, completing set up in HPP and eFast.
  • Ensures retail rates are evaluated through One Yield’s Retail Pricing Optimizer and updated based on changes in demand, product, or competitive positioning.
  • Ensures retail price parity is executed across all booking channels and ensure that the Hotel(s) sales strategies are effectively implemented in the reservation system and the inventory systems in a timely manner.
  • Ensures that technical questions relating to reservations and property management systems are escalated to the correct support desk in a timely manner. Assists hotels with pricing and provides input on business evaluation recommendations, if required in the assigned core deliverables.
  • Perform ad-hoc revenue tasks and analysis as directed by RMS Senior Leadership team.
  • Leads efforts to coordinate strategies between group sales offices, if required in the assigned core deliverables.
  • Conducts any analysis required to maximize room revenue and profit, in line with agreed service deliverables.
  • Analyzes reports and available information to make long-term pricing recommendations with brand initiatives as a key focus.
  • Critiques property performance weekly/monthly for Transient & Group segments for assigned hotel(s).
  • Prepares, communicates, and critiques weekly and monthly rooms projections, in line with agreed service deliverables.
  • Responsible for accurate execution of inventory management tasks.
  • Uses demand forecast and relevant data points to determine, implement and control selling strategies.
  • Drives compliance and participation in company promotions and digital channels.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education & EXPERIENCE

2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Finance and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major. 3 years’ experience in the revenue management discipline.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

Building Successful Relationships – is able to develop constructive and cooperative working relationships with others and maintain them over time.Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships Understands the distinction between managed and franchise owners/operators and is able to seamlessly provide support to all levels of the business.

Demonstrating Knowledge - Demonstrating knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.

Executing on a Strategy - taking a predetermined strategy and supporting the execution of that strategy.

Communicating Information Timely - Informing and/or updating other team members on relevant information in a timely manner.

Generating and Delivering Accurate and Timely Results - Generating and providing accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.

Analytical/Critical Thinking - The ability to gather and organize information using a logical and systematic process.

Intermediate Computer Skills – Utilizing the internet for job related search and information. Intermediate or higher mastery level of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Job Specific Computer Skills – MS Office applications essential. Marriott systems (MARSHA, Opera PMS and Opera S&C, HPP, MarRFP, eFast, MRDW, One Yield) would be advantageous but not necessary.

Oral Comprehension - The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.

Writing - Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

Mathematics - Using mathematics to solve problems. The ability to add, subtract, multiply, or divide quickly and correctly.

COMPETENCIES

Leadership

  • Adaptability - Determines how change impacts self and others; displays flexibility in adjusting priorities; and communicates both the reasons for change and how it impacts the workplace.
  • Communication - Customizes approach to conveying complex information and ideas to others in a convincing and engaging manner; appropriately interprets verbal and non-verbal behavior; and models active listening to ensure understanding.
  • Problem Solving and Decision Making - Models and coaches others on breaking complex issues into manageable parts, identifying and evaluating alternatives and their implications before making decisions, and involving and gaining agreement from others when making key decisions.
  • Professional Demeanor - Exhibits behavioral styles that convey confidence and command respect from others; makes a good first impression and represents the company in alignment with its values.

Managing Execution

  • Building and Contributing to Teams - Leads and participates as a member of a team to move the team toward the completion of common goals while fostering cohesion and collaboration among team members.
  • Driving for Results - Sets high standards of performance for self and/or others; assumes responsibility for work objectives; initiates, focuses, and monitors the efforts of self and/or others toward the accomplishment goals; proactively takes action and goes beyond what is required.
  • Planning and Organizing - Gathers information and resources required to set a plan of action for self and/or others; prioritizes and arranges work requirements for self and/or others to accomplish goals and ensure work is completed.

Building Relationships

  • Coworker Relationships - Interacts with others in a way that builds openness, trust, and confidence in the pursuit of organizational goals and lasting relationships.
  • Customer Relationships - Develops and sustains relationships based on an understanding of customer needs and actions consistent with the company’s service standards.
  • Global Mindset - Supports employees and business partners with diverse styles, abilities, motivations, and/or cultural perspectives; utilizes differences to drive innovation, engagement and enhance business results; and ensures employees are given the opportunity to contribute to their full potential.

Generating Talent and Organizational Capability

  • Organizational Capability - Evaluates and adapts the structure of team assignments and work processes to best fit the needs and/or support the goals of an organizational unit.
  • Talent Management - Provides guidance and feedback to help individuals develop and strengthen skills and abilities needed to accomplish work objectives.

Learning and Applying Personal Expertise

  • Applied Learning - Seeks and makes the most of learning opportunities to improve performance of self and/or others.
  • Business Acumen - Understands and utilizes business information to manage everyday operations and generate innovative solutions to approach team, business, and administrative challenges.
  • Technical Acumen - Understands and utilizes professional skills and knowledge in a specific functional area to conduct and manage everyday business operations and generate innovative solutions to approach function-specific work challenges
    • Revenue Management - Knowledge of revenue management concepts, processes and strategies such as average daily rate, revenue per available room, sales cycles and trends, account management, pricing and inventory management. Skill in using a Yield Management system and interpreting pricing and inventory reports.
    • Analysis - The ability to analyze and summarize detailed data to make inferences and recommendations. Included is the creation and maintenance of spreadsheets for storing data.
    • Research - Skill in collecting information from a variety of sources relating to market data, historical cycles, travel and tourism trends, and real estate market dynamics. The ability to know when to seek additional information and where to look to find it.
    • Inventory Management - The ability to manage rooms and function space restrictions and thresholds using systems or manually in order to maximize revenue/profit across all segments.
    • Computer Skills - The willingness to learn and ability to use computer systems and software packages to input, access, modify, store, or output information or to execute programs and analyses. This includes the ability to enter and retrieve data from computer systems using a keyboard, mouse, or trackball.
    • Economics and Finance - Knowledge of economic principles and practices, P&L statements, operating budgets, forecasting and scheduling, and the reporting of financial data.
    • Sales and Marketing - Knowledge of sales and marketing concepts including principles and methods for showing, promoting and selling products or services as well as marketing strategies and tactics.
  • Basic Competencies - Fundamental competencies required for accomplishing basic work activities.
    • Basic Computer Skills - Uses basic computer hardware and software (e.g., personal computers, word processing software, Internet browsers, etc.).
    • Mathematical Reasoning - Demonstrates ability to add, subtract, multiply, or divide quickly, correctly, and in a way that allows one to solve work-related issues.
    • Oral Comprehension - Demonstrates ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
    • Reading Comprehension - Demonstrates understanding of written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.
    • Writing - Communicates effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

United Kingdom

At the time of application, applicants must have the legal right to work in the United Kingdom. Unfortunately, this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship or relocation assistance.

WHY JOIN MARRIOTT INTERNATIONAL?

Marriott International has been recognized as one of Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For™ in 2026 by Great Place to Work®. This is a reflection of our people-first culture, commitment to wellbeing, and collaborative workplace. This accolade joins a growing list of regional honors, reinforcing our dedication to creating an exceptional environment where associates thrive.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

About At-Bay

At-Bay is the world’s first InsurSec provider designed from the ground up to help businesses tackle cyber risk head on. By combining industry-leading insurance with world-class cybersecurity technology, At-Bay offers end-to-end prevention and protection for the digital age. With 98% of cyber insurance claims in the past five years coming from small and mid-size businesses with revenue under $2B, providing an integrated solution to help manage risk is more critical than ever.

At-Bay helps its 35,000+ customers close their security technology and skills gap — all through their cyber insurance policy — making them less likely to be hit with a ransomware attack. As a full-stack insurance company, At-Bay offers multiple lines of specialty insurance, including Cyber, Tech E&O, and Miscellaneous Professional Liability (MPL) policies.

Job Summary

As an Underwriting Leader at At-Bay, you will be a pivotal player in our mission to transform the landscape in specialty lines insurance. In this role, you’ll own and be responsible for regional production and profitability goals for your team via our wholesale channel, managing a team of underwriters ensuring they meet their performance metrics. In addition, you must identify, establish and cultivate strong relationships with national brokerages, ensuring the effective distribution of our specialized insurance products in these higher revenue areas. This role reports to the Head of Middle Market and will regularly collaborate cross functionally with core internal stakeholders in our Underwriting, Insurance Operations, Insurance Product, Distribution, and Partnerships on strategic initiatives. You will drive growth, foster collaboration, and enhance our brand presence in the market.

Key responsibilities:

  • Responsible for owning the strategy for profitable growth with new business and renewal business in your region for wholesale to achieve profitable premium and rate goals. You’ll partner with our Tech/Cyber product leader, President, Business Development and Retail teams to execute the annual regional business plan and successfully deliver results consistent with our portfolio strategy.
  • Responsible for delivering excellence in underwriting – at both an individual and regional leadership perspective.
  • Lead and execute the regional and local adaptation of national underwriting, product segment, broker engagement strategies.
  • Manage, coach, and create a talent pipeline for underwriters within the region.
  • Develop and strengthen institutional relationships with key regional broker partners to achieve revenue objectives and unlock significant growth opportunities in collaboration with regional Business Development leads.
  • Systematically gather and share market intelligence and pipeline insights to provide strategic analysis and identify priority targets for go-to-market engagement in collaboration with regional Business Development lead.
  • Regularly institutionalize market intelligence and pipeline opportunities to proactively identify key targets for further GTM engagement in collaboration with regional Business Development lead and regional security sales team
  • Manage and evaluate various KPIs to assess individual and team performance across regional, broker management, and underwriting performance.
  • Promote the company's unique InsurSec expertise by participating in industry conferences and events while regularly conducting and taking leadership roles in client and broker meetings to educate on evolving cyber risk.
  • Serve as a liaison to technology, security, marketing, and data teams to enhance the underwriting process and go-to-market strategy
  • Embody and promote At-Bay company values as a leader within your region.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field
  • 8-10 years of experience in Cyber and Tech E&O Underwriting including product development or portfolio management.
  • Previous management experience preferred. The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 3 years of prior management experience.
  • Previous experience in and qualified in handling large and complex risk segments.
  • A proven track record of successfully building and nurturing broker partnerships on a national and local level.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of commercial lines insurance products and risk management.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regionally as required, up to 50%.

Work Arrangement: Remote or Hybrid

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreFlosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

About the Role

We're looking for a Consulting/Principal Site Reliability Engineer to guide our observability and reliability initiative for Government Systems, running on Azure Government. This is an advanced individual-contributor role for someone with a proven track record leading an organization through a transition to SLO-based reliability engineering — you've done this before, and you know what it takes to get development teams bought in. This is a hands-on SRE role, not a software development role: you'll work alongside other SREs on the initiative, guiding development teams on telemetry and instrumentation strategy rather than writing that code yourself. You'll operate as the go-to expert on Datadog and observability practice, helping define meaningful SLOs and error budgets and making data-driven reliability decisions. You'll also help train and mentor junior SREs, working within priorities set by the SRE Manager.

Eligibility: This role requires U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

What You'll Do

  • Guide the observability and reliability initiative, working alongside other SREs to set the technical direction for how the organization measures and improves reliability
  • Lead the transition to SLO-based reliability engineering, building on prior experience doing this elsewhere
  • Guide development teams on telemetry and instrumentation strategy for their applications, without doing the application development work yourself
  • Serve as the primary technical authority on Datadog, from dashboarding to alerting to SLO tracking
  • Recommend service level objectives in partnership with Product and Development teams
  • Act as a senior escalation point during incidents
  • Help improve and evolve the broader SRE framework
  • Build disaster recovery plans, including advanced fault injection scenarios
  • Advise on SRE training curriculum and content, and help set and follow priorities established by the SRE Manager

Tech Stack You'll Work With

  • Cloud: Microsoft Azure Government
  • Server Environment: Linux and Windows
  • CI/CD: Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • Observability: Datadog (primary)
  • AI-assisted development: GitHub Copilot

What We're Looking For

Observability (core focus)

  • Significant, hands-on experience with Datadog — dashboards, alerting, SLO/error-budget tracking, and telemetry pipelines
  • Proven experience leading an organization's transition to SLO-based reliability engineering, not just supporting one
  • Track record guiding development teams on instrumentation and telemetry strategy (advisory, not hands-on application coding)
  • Deep technical understanding of observability techniques across the full stack; able to bring clarity to complex incidents or performance issues
  • Able to build templated observability dashboards and configuration as code so others can implement quickly
  • Able to set and influence appropriate SLOs and Error Budgets org-wide
  • Comfortable operating across both Linux and Windows server environments

Incident Management

Design for Reliability

  • Advanced understanding of systems design, including high availability, deployment, and recovery techniques, plus failure modes and system behaviors
  • Specialized depth in one or more areas such as denial-of-service protection or containerization, with the ability to consult others on it
  • Able to make resilience and recoverability decisions backed by load testing data and fault injection results
  • Experience documenting SRE design practices and contributing to a broader SRE framework

Disaster Recovery

  • Experience contributing to DR plans, including recovery priorities, procedures, and guiding others through runbooks
  • Able to design and lead DR practice scenarios and incident response exercises, identifying knowledge gaps and improvements
  • Experience planning chaos engineering scenarios to simulate faults across memory, network, I/O, or distributed systems

Platforms and Automation

  • Able to build engineering and architecture consensus for new standard components and services on the Paved Road, including platforms and CI/CD
  • Experience promoting adoption and standardization, with contributions back via inner sourcing
  • A champion for Paved Road adoption, driving efficiency by removing rework and silos

Reliability Culture

  • Creates and shares SRE best practices and training material
  • Comfortable coaching other SREs and identifying development gaps
  • Able to spot and eliminate large-scale toil

AI-Driven Development (desired)

  • Experience using GitHub Copilot to accelerate troubleshooting, automation, or reliability tooling
  • Interest in helping define best practices for AI-assisted development within an SRE context

Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!


THE TEAM

The Cyber Security Solutions Engineering team deploys and manages enterprise SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, vulnerability management, privileged access management, and related integrations. It partners with Security Operations and IT teams to maintain effective detection, response, resilience, and security-control coverage.


THE ROLE

The Cyber Security Solutions Engineer 3 is the highest non-lead individual contributor in the solutions engineering team. This role provides advanced technical ownership across one or more critical security-platform ecosystems, architects complex integrations and automation, leads high-severity technical response and major change, establishes engineering standards, and develops the capability of lower-level engineers.


The engineer must be able to become effective quickly in a complex environment and serve as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing response across critical platforms and ensuring timely escalation. The position operates with broad technical discretion.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Act as technical owner and subject-matter expert for one or more critical security-platform ecosystems, defining reference configurations, lifecycle standards, resilience patterns, capacity requirements, recovery objectives, and measurable service outcomes.
  • Serve as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing cross-platform triage and response, assigning technical actions, making time-sensitive decisions within delegated authority, and escalating material risk promptly.
  • Architect and deliver complex multi-platform integrations, telemetry and data pipelines, orchestration and automation frameworks, and connections to cloud, identity, endpoint, network, IT service-management, and enterprise data services.
  • Serve as the final internal escalation point before the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer or vendor product engineering for systemic failures, scale and performance issues, data-quality defects, high-availability problems, and cross-platform dependencies.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and problem remediation for recurring or high-impact failures, ensuring corrective actions address technical, process, monitoring, documentation, and resilience gaps
  • Lead the security engineering workstream during high-severity incidents and readiness exercises, coordinating specialized analysis, emergency tool changes, containment execution, telemetry validation, recovery, and after-action improvement.
  • Define tuning, query, content, detection-support, vulnerability-scan, and telemetry-quality strategies in partnership with Security Operations and control owners; establish measures that demonstrate improvement
  • Lead major upgrades, migrations, platform consolidations, architecture changes, and new capability implementations; own technical design, dependency analysis, risk assessment, test strategy, rollback, readiness, and operational handover.
  • Build and govern reusable automation frameworks and deployment tooling, including code standards, peer review, secrets handling, testing, observability, failure recovery, and maintainability expectations.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and lead proofs of concept, comparative testing, technical due diligence, and recommendation development; provide evidence for the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer's roadmap.
  • Establish engineering standards for configuration validation, documentation, change quality, disaster recovery, access control, auditability, and operational support across the role family.
  • Use service, risk, coverage, performance, and incident data to identify systemic gaps, develop technical and business cases, and present prioritized recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Lead design reviews, mentor Levels 1 and 2, delegate project tasks, assess technical quality, and provide development feedback without assuming formal performance-management authority.
  • Represent Cyber Security Solutions Engineering in architecture, governance, audit, major project, and vendor forums; translate business and control requirements into scalable technical designs.
  • Partner with the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer on roadmap planning, capacity, vendor performance, and operating-model improvement.

Level Scope and Accountability

  • Autonomy: Operates with broad technical discretion and without routine supervision within approved strategy, architecture principles, policy, and governance.
  • Technical scope: Critical platform ecosystems, complex cross-platform dependencies, enterprise integrations, and high-risk engineering change.
  • Decision authority: Sets technical methods and standards within delegated scope, approves complex designs and changes, and directs technical response. Escalates policy exceptions, risk acceptance, budget, resource conflicts, and final roadmap decisions.
  • Escalation: Final internal technical escalation before the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer, vendor product engineering, architecture governance, or executive risk channels.
  • Leadership: Leads major technical workstreams, design reviews, and capability development. No direct reports, compensation decisions, performance reviews, hiring authority, budget ownership, or final portfolio prioritization.
  • Core-hours accountability: Serves as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing complex response across critical platform ecosystems and ensuring timely escalation of material risk.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • At least 8 years of direct, hands-on professional or military cybersecurity engineering experience, including at least 3 years serving as a senior technical owner, subject-matter expert, or escalation point for enterprise security platforms in complex environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in multiple security technology domains such as SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, vulnerability management, privileged access management, security orchestration, or comparable platforms, with deep expertise in at least one domain.
  • Deep administration and troubleshooting capability across Linux/Unix, Windows, TCP/IP networking, DNS, PKI and certificates, authentication, APIs, virtualization, public cloud, load balancing, clustering, and high-availability design.
  • Advanced scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or comparable languages, including production coding practices, testing, version control, logging, error handling, and secure secrets management
  • Demonstrated success architecting complex integrations, leading major upgrades or migrations, and resolving systemic or high-impact platform failures
  • Experience leading technical response during significant security incidents, performing root-cause analysis, and driving sustained corrective action.
  • Working knowledge of security and control frameworks and statutory/regulatory mandates such as NIST and ISO 27001, GDPR and CCPA, including the ability to translate control requirements into technical standards and auditable evidence.
  • Strong technical leadership, design-review, mentoring, vendor-management, and stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Type A personality and work style: an exceptionally self-directed, decisive, and results-oriented technical leader who acts with disciplined urgency, maintains exacting standards, owns complex outcomes, and drives sustained resolution while remaining measured, collaborative, and risk-aware.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CISSP, CISM, GIAC GCIA or GCIH, advanced cloud security, architecture, or vendor-specific engineering certification.
  • Experience with large-scale data pipelines, orchestration platforms, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, configuration management, or security-content engineering.
  • Experience supporting globally distributed environments, high-volume event platforms, or services with strict availability and response requirements

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. HIRING PRACTICES

jobs.title: Video Producer
jobs.excerpt: USA TODAY Co.  is seeking a detail-oriented, platform-native video producer to expand video support for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms.
jobs.description:
USA TODAY Co. is seeking a detail-oriented, platform-native video producer to expand video support for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms. This full-time role will use strong editorial judgment and AI-assisted production workflows to turn local reporting, photos, data and graphics into timely, accurate and engaging short-form video. The producer will work directly with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories that can reach broader audiences through video. Coverage will span the range of local journalism, including breaking news, public safety, weather, government, education, business, consumer issues, community stories, major local events and other topics important to individual markets. This is a hands-on production and service role focused on helping local newsrooms publish more video efficiently across owned and social platforms.

What you’ll do:

Serve as a dedicated video production resource for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms, supporting market needs and network-wide local coverage priorities. Use AI-assisted platforms, including Stringr, along with templates, automation and editing tools to produce a high volume of accurate, on-brand video from local reporting, photos, data, graphics, user-generated content and newsroom briefs. Use Stringr AI UGC production capabilities to help local newsrooms identify and develop relevant user-generated content into publishable video while following verification, sourcing, rights and editorial standards. Use Stringr Clip Gen to create timely clips and short-form video from press conferences, public meetings, interviews, podcasts and other longer recordings. Use Stringr Show Stacker and other AI-assisted long-form production tools to assemble structured video from local programs, interviews, recurring shows and extended newsroom content. Partner with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories with strong visual, audience and distribution potential. Respond quickly to local breaking news and major developing stories while also supporting planned enterprise, service and community coverage. Create useful explainers that make complex local topics clear, accessible and relevant to the communities our newsrooms serve. Turn newsroom briefs and published stories into clear video treatments, selecting effective visuals, scripts, on-screen text, audio, pacing and formats. Adapt local journalism into platform-native vertical video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, YouTube Shorts and other platforms. Repurpose AI-assisted and automated content for owned-and-operated and social platforms, tailoring each version to the audience, market and platform. Optimize video length, aspect ratio, captions, headlines, thumbnails, metadata and calls to action using platform best practices and performance insights. Program videos on corresponding local articles and support distribution workflows that increase the reach and value of local journalism. Manage and prioritize requests from multiple newsrooms, communicate progress and blockers, and balance planned work with urgent coverage needs. Maintain editorial, legal, brand and visual standards, including accuracy, sourcing, attribution, captions, fonts, colors and overall presentation. Track core performance metrics, identify successful local formats and topics, and share repeatable lessons with newsroom and video partners. Test emerging AI and automation capabilities responsibly, helping improve templates, workflows and production standards for local newsroom use. Review videos produced by others for quality and accuracy and provide feedback

What success looks like:

Local newsrooms receive reliable, timely video support across a broad range of coverage needs. More high-priority local stories include relevant video on owned and social platforms. Story-to-video turnaround improves, particularly during breaking news and other time-sensitive coverage. Produced videos meet high standards for accuracy, clarity, audience value and brand consistency. Local newsroom partners have clear visibility into priorities, progress and production capacity. Strong formats and workflows are identified, documented and applied across additional USA TODAY Network markets. AI-assisted tools and automation improve production efficiency while preserving editorial judgment and quality.

Who you are:

A digital-first journalist or producer who understands the role video can play in extending the reach and impact of local journalism. A strong editor with sound news judgment, a sharp eye for visuals and the ability to identify the clearest audience takeaway from a story. Comfortable producing quick-turn, high-volume video without sacrificing accuracy, quality or brand standards. Able to move between breaking news, service journalism, enterprise reporting and community stories based on newsroom needs. Highly organized and able to manage requests from multiple markets, changing priorities and deadline pressure in a remote environment. A clear, responsive and collaborative partner who can work effectively with local reporters, editors, newsroom leaders and centralized video teams. Curious and adaptable, with a practical interest in AI, automation and new approaches to newsroom production. Committed to journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, transparency and responsible use of emerging technology.

Qualifications:

2-5 years Professional experience in digital journalism, video production, social video or a related field. Demonstrated video editing experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, mobile editing applications or comparable tools. Experience creating and publishing video for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube. Strong writing and editing skills, including the ability to create concise scripts, captions, headlines and on-screen text. Ability to work independently, make sound editorial decisions on deadline and collaborate across newsrooms and time zones. Experience working with local newsrooms or producing video from local reporting is preferred. Experience with AI-assisted production platforms, including Stringr or comparable tools, template-driven workflows, content-management systems or publishing tools is preferred.

How To Apply:

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job. Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration. #Newsgnt

Variable incentive compensation, including commissions, is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, education level, location, and union representation, if applicable

Supplier Outreach & Electronic Payment Conversion

  • Conduct proactive outbound phone and email outreach to suppliers assigned to payment conversion campaigns.

  • Experience in supporting supplier onboarding, business payments, commercial cards, ACH, Treasury Management, accounts payable, or payment conversion initiatives is preferred.
  • Experience working with a bank, payment provider, fintech organization, or large corporate payments program is a plus.
  • Experience in a regulated or compliance-driven environment is preferred.

Technical & Operational Skills

  • Moderate Microsoft Excel proficiency, including formulas, filtering, sorting, and formatting.
  • Experience using CRM systems, call-tracking platforms, workflow tools, or case-management systems.
  • Ability to review records, research questions, apply approved solutions, and maintain accurate documentation.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple cases, follow-ups, and competing priorities.
  • Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

Communication & Professional Skills

  • Strong verbal communication skills and a professional, confident telephone manner.
  • Clear and effective business email writing and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to explain processes and payment options in straightforward, easy-to-understand terms.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the judgment to distinguish routine questions from issues requiring escalation.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with suppliers, business customers, and internal teams.
  • Reliable follow-through, attention to detail, and a consistent focus on service quality and campaign goals.

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Owned Media Integration & Unified Workflows

Programmatic Monetization

Advance forecasting, pricing, packaging, decisioning, and campaign optimization.

Commercialization & Leadership

Lead across Sales, Client Success, Marketing, Data, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Privacy.

Guide roadmap, investment, dependency, and trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience in digital advertising, advertising technology, media platforms, data products, or related fields.

Experience translating customer and commercial problems into platform strategy, roadmaps, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical and commercial judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Technical & Domain Expertise

Deep working knowledge of Google Ad Manager or a comparable enterprise ad server, including orders, line items, targeting, pacing, creative trafficking, and reporting integrations.

MBA or equivalent experience leading product strategy and commercial transformation.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, Founders' Office
jobs.excerpt: About Ume IntelligenceUme Intelligence is a marketing science company solving complex commercial problems for multi-location restaurant brands.
jobs.description:
About Ume Intelligence

Ume Intelligence is a marketing science company solving complex commercial problems for multi-location restaurant brands. We build modern analytics and automation infrastructure, paired with hands-on digital operations that turn operational data into measurable revenue.

We operate as a lean, high-leverage team with no walls between engineering and operations. We look for people who run toward technology, automation, and data models rather than away from them, and who judge their work by business impact rather than activity.

The Role

We are looking for a Business Operations Manager to work directly with our two co-founders in the Founders’ Office.

This is a high-leverage generalist role. On a given day you might schedule five candidate interviews, reconcile last month’s expenses, file a state registration, pull an enriched list of 40 restaurant groups to prospect, and research a new vendor before lunch. You will take whole areas of work off the founders’ plates, run them reliably, and turn the repeatable parts into checklists, templates, and automations so they get easier every month.

You will see the whole company up close: hiring, finance, sales, marketing, and compliance. For the right person, the role grows with the company into building and leading business operations as an executive function.

Who This Role Is For (and Not For)

  • This role is for you if: You view no operational task as too small, but you never treat them as permanent manual chores—you treat them as systems to streamline, automate, and document. You take genuine pride in zero dropped balls, meticulous back-office execution, and returning hours of time to executive leadership.

  • This role is not for you if: You are looking for a purely advisory/strategy consulting seat, or conversely, a traditional executive assistant role centered around personal calendar coordination. This is hands-on operational infrastructure building across legal, finance, recruiting, and GTM.

What You’ll Own

  • Recruiting Coordination: Run our applicant pipeline end-to-end in our ATS: candidate communication, interview scheduling across time zones, scorecard hygiene, and follow-ups. Prepare offer paperwork and drive new hire onboarding and offboarding workflows.

  • Bookkeeping & Back-Office Finance: Categorize transactions, issue and chase customer invoices, coordinate bills and receipts, and prepare clean month-end closes for our external accounting firm.

  • Government & Compliance Paperwork: Track and prepare state and local filings, annual reports, registrations, business licenses, and tax notices. Coordinate directly with our registered agent, CPA, and payroll provider so nothing is ever late or non-compliant.

  • Remote Office & Vendor Management: Manage software subscriptions, seat provisioning, access permissions, hardware/equipment, and our virtual mailbox. Audit tools regularly, negotiate vendor contracts, and cut unused subscriptions.

  • GTM Research & Lead Enrichment: Research prospective multi-unit restaurant groups and regional enterprise brands. Build, enrich, and verify qualified lead directories, keep the CRM clean, and draft initial outreach templates for the founders.

  • Marketing Operations Support: Maintain campaign calendars, assemble client-facing and internal metrics reports from our data tools, schedule content, and keep digital brand assets organized.

  • Executive & Business Research: Investigate open-ended questions quickly and synthesize them into crisp 1-page briefs: a competitor’s product model, a market landscape, a regulatory filing nuance, or a vendor pricing benchmark.

  • Systematization & Automation: Document every workflow you touch into reusable runbooks, and proactively deploy modern AI and automation tools (Zapier/Make, prompt chains) to eliminate manual administration.

Your First 90 Days

  • Day 30: You fully own candidate scheduling and the month-end bookkeeping close. You maintain a living calendar of every recurring corporate filing, tax date, and subscription renewal, eliminating dropped balls across back-office operations.

  • Day 60: You own vendor and subscription management, and you have built our baseline restaurant prospecting directory (multi-unit operators across target regions) with verified decision-maker data.

  • Day 90: You have standardized an operational playbook: an end-to-end employee onboarding checklist, automated receipt-matching workflows, and routine operational reporting that runs without founder intervention. The founders spend measurably less time on administrative drag.

Our Operational Stack

  • Productivity & Workspace: Google Workspace, Notion / Markdown docs, Slack, Zoom

  • Finance & Compliance: QuickBooks Online / Xero, Gusto / Deel, Virtual Mailbox

  • Pipeline & Operations: Modern ATS (e.g., Ashby, Dover, Greenhouse), CRM / Prospecting tools (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator)

  • Automation & AI: ChatGPT / Claude (daily research, data extraction, drafting), Zapier / Make

What You Bring

Experience & Background

  • 3 to 6 years of experience in business operations, a founder’s/CEO’s office, a high-ownership executive operational role, or early-stage startup operations.

  • Hands-on bookkeeping fluency with tools such as QuickBooks or Xero. You understand the fundamentals of reconciliations, invoicing, expense categorization, and cash management.

  • Full-cycle recruiting operations experience, from managing applicant pipelines to scheduling panels and preparing offer packets.

  • A degree in business, finance, economics, communications, or equivalent practical track record.

Core Competencies & Must-Haves

  • Extreme Reliability: When an operational item is on your plate, it gets done accurately on schedule without reminders. You surface bottlenecks early.

  • Judgment & Discretion: Absolute discretion and integrity handling confidential legal, payroll, financial, and executive communications.

  • AI & Tool Fluency: You don’t just use AI to write emails—you actively use LLMs and workflow automations to parse unstructured data, research edge cases, draft documentation, and systematically eliminate manual steps.

  • Written Clarity: Impeccable, clear, and concise written English. You can turn fragmented founder thoughts into a structured checklist, a one-page briefing doc, or a polished external email.

  • Autonomous Resourcefulness: You run to ground unfamiliar questions—whether a complex state registration rule, a vendor contract clause, or a restaurant group’s VP of Marketing—without needing a predefined roadmap.

Nice to Have

  • Practical knowledge of US corporate compliance (Delaware filings, California state registrations, payroll/tax compliance).

  • Background or strong familiarity with the food & beverage, hospitality, or multi-location retail sector.

  • Prior experience working in a fully distributed, asynchronous startup team.

Working Schedule & Rhythm

  • Structure: Full-time, flexible schedule.

  • Core Overlap: A consistent daily window of at least 2 to 3 hours overlapping with the founders between 7:00 AM and 11:00 AM US Pacific for daily syncs, real-time unblocking, and candidate coordination, with asynchronous flexibility for the remainder of your day.

How Performance Is Measured

  • Reliability: 100% on-time execution for compliance filings, billing, vendor payments, candidate touchpoints, and month-end closes.

  • Founder Leverage: Concrete reduction in executive hours spent on administrative overhead and operational friction.

  • Work Quality: High accuracy across the general ledger, compliance docs, and prospect research; minimal rework required.

  • Compounding Efficiency: Number of recurring processes converted into documented playbooks, templates, or software automations.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Full-Time Compensation: Stable, competitive monthly base salary.

  • Meaningful Equity Participation: Stock option grant with real upside in a high-leverage US enterprise company.

  • Paid Time Off & Holidays: Generous paid annual leave and public holidays.

  • Total Executive Transparency: Direct visibility into the entire operational, strategic, and financial machinery of an early-stage company.

  • Clear Career Trajectory: Opportunity to define and lead business operations as Ume expands.

Our Interview Process

  1. Introductory Screen (30 mins): High-level conversation covering your background, communication style, working rhythm, and scope alignment.

  2. Practical Work Trial (Take-home, ~60–90 mins): A realistic exercise mirroring a typical morning in the Founders’ Office (e.g., reconciling a messy expense ledger, answering an ambiguous vendor research prompt, and drafting a candidate coordination brief).

  3. Founders Deep Dive (45 mins): In-depth discussion on problem-solving, operational judgment, automation philosophy, and mutual team fit.

jobs.description:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Web Experimentation and Operations Associate

Location: Remote – Colombia
Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Independent Contractor (fixed term, full-time)
Industry: Technology & IT / Digital Marketing
Compensation: $2,167–$2,667 USD/month
Schedule: Full-time | Business hours (time zone to be confirmed with the client)
English Proficiency: C1 (Excellent spoken and written English)
Start Date: December 15, 2026

About the Role

Our client is a global financial technology company that serves consumers, small businesses, and mid-market companies worldwide. The team this role supports works on web experiences for mid-market offerings that help growing businesses manage financial operations, payroll, payments, and marketing in one place.
This is a full-time, fixed-term contract role through December 14, 2027, supporting the repeatable parts of mid-market web work, including hub pages, CMS-related work, and related web operations.
This is a support role. The engagement lead sets priorities, writes hypotheses, and makes decisions. You will build, check, update, and draft from templates and clear instructions, and flag anything that is unclear. Work is reviewed before it ships. The role does not include deciding test results, signing off on launches or tests, making budget or vendor decisions, managing employees, or publishing without approval.
This opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who is comfortable with experimentation setups, web QA, status tracking, and light automation, and who writes clear, short, accurate updates on time.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Clear, defined work with templates, instructions, and review before anything ships.
  • A mix of experimentation support, web operations, launch support, and light automation.
  • Hands-on experience with mid-market web work at a global financial technology company.
  • A support structure in which the engagement lead sets priorities and decisions, so you can focus on precise execution.

What You'll Do

Test and Offer Support (~45%)

  • Set up experiments and offers in the company's internal experimentation and campaign platforms, following approved specs.
  • QA each build in preview, across browsers and mobile, and log issues.
  • Fill in the readout template with results from the analytics team and the test tool. The engagement lead writes the conclusion.
  • Target one light test setup per month from month 3, growing over time.

Web Operations Hygiene and Launch Support (~40%)

  • Keep status and dates current each week in Quickbase, Jira, and Airtable, and keep the web project register updated.
  • Run UAT checklists on new and re-themed pages, log issues, and confirm fixes.
  • Draft launch announcements and change notes from templates for approval.

Light Automation (~15%)

  • Run and monitor existing scheduled reports, and flag failures.
  • Build small reports and automations on request using Claude and approved tools, with review.
  • Write a short note for each automation (what it does, what it reads, and who to ask).
Tools you will use include internal experimentation and campaign platforms, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and Edge Delivery Services, Contentstack, Quickbase, Jira, Airtable, Slack, Google Workspace, and Claude.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience in marketing, web operations, or analytics.
  • Strong attention to detail, and comfort following specs, templates, and checklists.
  • Experience with spreadsheets and ticketing or work-management tools (Jira, Airtable, or similar).
  • Clear, short, accurate, and on-time written updates.
  • Asks for help early when something is unclear, rather than waiting.
  • C1 English (excellent spoken and written English).
  • Based in Colombia, Mexico, or Chile, and able to work fully remotely in a full-time capacity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with A/B testing or personalization tools (Optimizely, Adobe Target, VWO, or similar).
  • Day-to-day use of Claude or another AI assistant.
  • Basic SQL or scripting.
  • Familiarity with Quickbase, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), or Contentstack.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:
  • Attention to detail and comfort following specs, templates, and checklists.
  • Clear, short, accurate, and on-time written communication.
  • Asking for help early when something is unclear, rather than waiting.
  • Hands-on experience with spreadsheets and ticketing or work-management tools.
  • Ability to work effectively in a support role, with work reviewed before it ships.
  • Relevant experience in marketing, web operations, or analytics (1-3 years).
  • C1 spoken and written English.
  • Availability to work full-time and remotely from Colombia, Mexico, or Chile.

How Success Is Measured

  • Experiments and offers go live accurately and on schedule, with QA issues caught before they reach production.
  • Test readouts are complete on time, so the engagement lead can draw conclusions without missing inputs.
  • From month 3, light test setups are delivered at the agreed monthly pace and increase over time.
  • The team can rely on a current weekly view of status, dates, and the web project register.
  • New and re-themed pages complete UAT with issues resolved before launch.
  • Launch communications are ready for approval when needed, so releases are not delayed.
  • Scheduled reports stay reliable, failures are flagged quickly, and new automations are documented for handover.
  • The engagement lead can trust your written updates and early flags, with minimal rework.

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote opportunity from Colombia, Mexico, or Chile.
  • Competitive compensation: $2,167–$2,667 USD/month, depending on experience.
  • A defined, full-time contract through December 14, 2027, with clear scope and review before work ships.
  • A culture built on integrity, customer focus, inclusive collaboration, and continuous learning.

Important Notes

Applications may not be considered if candidates:
  • Are not based in Colombia, Mexico, or Chile.
  • Cannot work full-time in a fully remote arrangement.
  • Do not have 1-3 years of experience in marketing, web operations, or analytics.
  • Do not have C1 spoken and written English, or cannot deliver clear, short, accurate, on-time written updates.
  • Are not detail-oriented, or are not comfortable working from specs, templates, and checklists.

Job Title: Brand Launch & Optimization Manager (E-Commerce)

Job Overview

You will take ownership of brands during their critical launch phase, implementing strategies that position them for long-term success before transitioning them to the ongoing management team.

Brand Launch & Optimization

  • Manage newly acquired brands from onboarding through their initial growth phase

  • Identify opportunities to optimize existing brands and enhance overall performance

Qualifications

  • Proven experience managing Amazon and Walmart marketplace accounts

  • Google Sheets
