Second, we expect AI to be how the work gets done as we scale, not a side project — we're a lean finance org and we intend to stay one. Reporting to our CFO, you'll lead our accounting function in supporting a growth business with subscription and usage-based revenue, an established audit, and an engaged private equity sponsor & management team that expects strong partnership and timely, accurate, & defensible reporting.

  • CPA (or equivalent), with a strong command of US GAAP

  • Comfortable partnering closely with senior cross-functional leaders and operating as a trusted, solution-oriented thought partner

Responsibilities

jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

Join a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader at the forefront of innovation. We protect the unseen — the infrastructure that powers our way of life. OPSWAT protects the world’s critical infrastructure across IT, OT, and ICS environments, trusted by more than 2,000 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide.

We are seeking a Vice President, Products to own OPSWAT’s diode business end to end. You will operate much like a general manager would — accountable for the full business — strategy, portfolio, hardware and software product management, partnerships, go-to-market, and commercial results. You lead the product management function for diodes as a player-coach, with product managers reporting to you, while personally owning every decision that moves the business forward.

The Product & Portfolio

OPSWAT’s diode portfolio — the MetaDefender Optical Diode and MetaDefender NetWall families, expanded through the acquisition of Fend — delivers hardware-enforced, one-way and controlled data transfer that protects OT, ICS, and segregated networks while keeping operational data flowing to where it is needed.

  • Hardware-enforced data diodes: optical diodes across a range of form factors and performance tiers, from rack-mount to DIN-rail and compact industrial models, built for demanding operational environments.
  • Unidirectional and bilateral security gateways: gateways that pair one-way enforcement with protocol handling and replication for OT systems, with connectivity spanning Ethernet, serial, and cellular for modern and legacy networks.
  • The software layer: management, configuration, protocol connectors, monitoring, and integration with the broader MetaDefender platform — the experience customers live with every day.
  • Certifications and assurance: the security, safety, and regulatory certifications that customers in critical infrastructure, government, and defense depend on.

Customers span energy and utilities, manufacturing, transportation, government, and defense — environments where reliability, assurance, and long product lifecycles matter as much as features.

About This Role

This is a hands-on, business-ownership role — not a pure strategy seat. You are the single owner of the diode business: you set its direction, run it with a general manager’s breadth and accountability, and are accountable for growth, margin, and customer success. At the same time, you lead the product management function as a player-coach, building and developing a team of product managers while staying in the details yourself.

You are equally at home in hardware and software product management. You work closely with hardware engineering and supply chain on everything from evaluating and validating hardware vendors and components to final selection, sourcing, and lifecycle — and with software engineering on the experience that runs on top. You build the partnerships and go-to-market motion that carry the entire business, grounded in a thorough understanding of the diode market, its customers, and the comparable vendors within it.

You will work alongside OPSWAT’s Diode CTO, who brings deep technical insight and strategic perspective and helps shape critical decisions, as you continue to drive OPSWAT’s success in this space. You bring an AI-first mindset, embracing AI-transformed product management processes across the team — from research and requirements to the user experience and the packaging experience.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the business end to end:take end-to-end ownership of the diode business, with the breadth a general manager would bring — owning strategy, revenue, margin, forecasting, and investment decisions, and accountable for commercial outcomes across the portfolio.
  • Set portfolio strategy and roadmap: define the vision and multi-year roadmap across hardware and software, balancing new products, platform evolution, and lifecycle management for long-lived installed bases.
  • Lead hardware product management: own the hardware lifecycle — requirements, new product introduction, BOM cost and margin targets, certifications, product transitions, and end-of-life planning.
  • Lead software product management: own the software experience — management, configuration, protocol connectors, monitoring, and integration with the MetaDefender platform — so the product is as easy to deploy and operate as it is secure.
  • Manage hardware vendors with engineering and supply chain: partner with the hardware engineering and supply chain groups to evaluate, validate, qualify, and select hardware vendors, contract manufacturers, and key components — managing cost, quality, lead times, and supply risk.
  • Build business and partnerships: develop OEM, technology, system-integrator, and channel partnerships that extend the portfolio’s reach, and identify business development opportunities that strengthen OPSWAT’s position.
  • Own go-to-market: lead positioning, pricing, packaging, and launches; arm sales and channel teams with the story and the proof; and engage directly with key customers, partners, and field events.
  • Know the market: maintain a rigorous, current view of the diode and cross-domain market — customer needs, buying criteria, competitive offerings, and the strengths and weaknesses of comparable vendors — and use it to guide portfolio decisions.
  • Partner with the Diode CTO: work alongside the Diode CTO on technical direction, strategy, and critical decisions, combining business ownership with deep technical insight.
  • Drive AI-transformed product management: embed AI across the team’s daily work to raise speed and quality, and apply it to how the team shapes the user experience and the packaging experience — from commercial packaging and licensing to the out-of-box and deployment experience.
  • Lead the team as a player-coach: hire, develop, and lead the diode product managers while personally owning the most important work.
  • Communicate with stakeholders: clearly articulate strategy, performance, and results to executive leadership, customers, and partners, fostering alignment and confidence.

What We Need From You

  • End-to-end business management: extensive end-to-end business management experience — comparable in scope to running a business unit or a product line as a general manager — with accountability for revenue, margin, and strategy. 12+ years in product and business leadership is typical.
  • Hardware and software product management: a well-rounded product management background spanning both hardware and software, including taking hardware products from requirements through manufacturing, certification, and lifecycle.
  • Hardware vendor and supply chain experience: a strong track record working with hardware vendors and contract manufacturers — from validation to selection — alongside hardware engineering and supply chain teams.
  • BD, partnership, and GTM leadership: demonstrated success building partnerships and leading go-to-market — pricing, packaging, channel, and launches — for a business you owned.
  • Diode market knowledge: full knowledge of the data diode and cross-domain market space, including customers, competitive offerings, and the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats of comparable vendors.
  • Player-coach leadership: experience leading product managers while staying hands-on and owning outcomes directly.
  • AI-first ways of working: you fully embrace AI-transformed product management processes and apply AI to your own and your team’s daily work.
  • Critical infrastructure customers: experience serving customers in OT/ICS, energy, utilities, manufacturing, government, or defense, and an understanding of their assurance and lifecycle expectations.
  • Exceptional communicator: outstanding executive presence and communication skills, with credibility across engineering, sales, partners, and customers.
  • Travel: willingness to travel regularly to customers, partners, hardware vendors, and R&D sites.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA is a plus.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

  • Certification experience: hands-on experience bringing products through security and industry certifications such as Common Criteria or IEC 62443.
  • OT protocol depth: familiarity with industrial protocols and the systems diodes connect to, such as historians and SCADA.
  • Government and defense: experience working with government and defense customers; eligibility for a security clearance is a plus.
  • Integration experience: experience integrating an acquired product line or bringing hardware and software teams onto a common platform.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Run a complete business — hardware, software, and go-to-market — with real ownership at a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader.
  • Work alongside a seasoned Diode CTO and dedicated hardware, software, and supply chain teams.
  • Protect the networks that power energy, manufacturing, transportation, and national security.
  • Shape how AI transforms product management in a hardware-and-software business.
  • Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

jobs.excerpt: At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We're assembling a small team to take over a set of backend services that power a direct-to-consumer commerce platform of a global beverage/consumer goods company. The platform is being separated from the B2B ecosystem it was born in. As part of that separation, a group of critical services (orders, pricing, payments, and promotions/combos) is being forked as-is into the new environment, and they need a team that owns them.
The mission for this phase is clear: keep the lights on. Absorb these services fast, keep them stable through the highest-demand period of the year, and leave them better documented and tested than we found them. The client's architecture team is designing the target architecture in parallel. That work is not in this team's scope today, but it is the natural next step.
This is not greenfield. You'll inherit real services with real history, learn them from the people who built them.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own a portfolio of forked backend services (mostly Java/Spring Boot): bug fixes, small changes, and day-to-day stability.
  • Drive knowledge transfer with the original team through shadowing sessions. Ask the right questions, map dependencies, and turn tacit knowledge into something written.
  • Build service context documentation in three layers (business rules, application behavior, operations) following the client's template. This feeds both the human team and the AI-assisted development model the client already runs in production.
  • Support incidents in a production environment that runs 24/7 across global markets, including critical flows like orders and payments.
  • Work within an Azure-based infrastructure (Azure DevOps, pipelines, and subscriptions), contributing to the duplication and adaptation of CI/CD pipelines for the new environment
  • Participate in the team's shift toward better engineering practices: adopting GitFlow, strengthening test coverage, and gradually incorporating quality gates — without breaking what already works
  • Help classify services by technical criticality and flag systemic risks early, such as hidden dependencies, shared databases/queues, and fragile integrations.

Requirements (Must Have):

  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (coding agents, assistants) in real work, with judgment about when to trust and when to verify.
  • Java (backend, production experience) — this is non-negotiable
  • Spring Boot — the core framework across the service landscape
  • REST API design and integration
  • Azure DevOps — familiarity with pipelines, repos, and environments
  • Non relational (CosmosDB for MongoDB) and relational databases (PostgreSQL)
  • Testing — JUnit for unit tests; familiarity with E2E or integration testing
  • Incident response mindset — ability to diagnose, triage, and resolve issues in complex distributed systems under pressure
  • English — for reading documentation, participating in cross-team calls, and written communication
  • Hands-on experience operating and debugging distributed microservices in production: logs, tracing, triage under pressure.
  • Clear, proactive communication. You'll extract knowledge from a team that is moving on, so you must be able to drive conversations, write things down, and escalate early.
  • Comfort working on inherited/legacy code with a "understand first, change carefully" mindset.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with microservices at scale — especially the operational realities of running and debugging many services in production
  • Azure cloud services beyond DevOps (Service Bus, Blob Storage, Functions, etc.)
  • Familiarity with DDD (Domain-Driven Design) concepts and service boundary thinking
  • Go — a secondary language used in some newer services
  • Understanding of internationalization and global commerce (multi-currency, multi-region systems)
  • Performance optimization experience in high-throughput environments

What Makes This Role Different:

You'll be joining at a moment that requires adaptability over idealism — the goal isn't to redesign what's working, it's to understand it deeply, keep it running, and incrementally move it toward a cleaner state. The team values engineers who can hold two things at once: operational discipline today and architectural vision for tomorrow.
If you've ever had to inherit complex legacy systems, win trust through reliability, and earn the space to improve things over time — this will feel familiar in the best way.

Seniority Levels:

We're open to Mid-Level and Senior profiles. Both levels are hands-on: everyone on this team writes code, fixes bugs, and takes on-call shifts. The difference is scope and autonomy.
  • Mid-Level: Delivers fixes and changes independently on well-understood services, with guidance on the more complex ones. Strong Java/Spring Boot fundamentals and solid microservices concepts. Takes part in incident response alongside senior engineers. Learns a complex domain fast through shadowing and documentation, and writes down what they learn.
  • Senior: Delivers the hardest changes and fixes, especially on critical flows such as orders, pricing and payments. Leads incident resolution end to end, from diagnosis to fix in production. Drives knowledge transfer sessions with the outgoing team and turns what comes out of them into documentation and service context. Spots systemic risks such as hidden dependencies, shared resources and fragile integrations. Sets the quality bar for the team through code reviews, tests and standards, mostly by example.

  • Contribute to the implementation of the Data Catalog and Data Quality Framework and it’s lineage across the platform.

  • Drive observability: pipelines that are observable, debuggable and alert-driven, with clear ownership of failures.

  • Operate the Databricks platform: Unity Catalog structure, cluster and job policies, Auto Loader ingestion patterns, and performance and cost optimization of workloads.

    • Technical Leadership

  • Participate in architecture reviews and technical decision-making, stating trade-offs (performance, cost, reliability, complexity) with data.

You’ll join the Security team, reporting to the Head of Cybersecurity and working closely with Engineering and DevOps. You’ll lead technical security projects, build controls and automation, and mentor junior team members. Success in your first year means a stronger AWS security posture, faster and more consistent incident response, and security findings addressed proactively.

What You’ll Do

  • Strengthen security across our AWS accounts, including account baselines, AWS Organizations, SCPs and Control Tower guardrails.
  • Design and implement least privilege access, including IAM Identity Center, access based on roles and temporary privileged access to production.
  • Build and tune detection and monitoring using CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, VPC Flow Logs and our SIEM.
  • Lead the technical response to AWS incidents, including investigation, containment, evidence collection, root cause analysis and post incident reviews.
  • Improve vulnerability and misconfiguration management, working with Engineering and DevOps to prioritize findings, resolve risks and verify fixes.
  • Secure data, secrets and credentials using KMS, Secrets Manager, encryption controls and appropriate key management.
  • Build security into infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines through automated checks and policy enforcement.
  • Develop and maintain technical security standards, runbooks and incident response playbooks.
  • Share your knowledge and mentor junior engineers as the team grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • At least 5 years of experience in security engineering or a related technical role, including at least 2 years securing production AWS environments.
  • Strong practical knowledge of AWS security, including IAM policies, SCPs, network security, KMS and native detection services.
  • Practical understanding of container and Kubernetes security, particularly EKS.
  • Experience investigating cloud security incidents and making sound decisions under pressure.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform, and automation using Python or a similar language.
  • Experience building SIEM detections and alerting, investigating events and reducing unnecessary noise.
  • The judgment to prioritize meaningful risks and work with engineering teams to deliver practical fixes.
  • Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical findings to engineers, leadership and other stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, digital assets or another regulated financial services environment.
  • Experience with wallet infrastructure, smart contract security or key management using HSMs.

Additional Benefits for US employees

  • Comprehensive Insurance Coverage – Employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Secure your financial future with employer-sponsored savings.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We’re building a new B2B business for Firefox— bringing a privacy-first, data-safe browser and productivity bundle to European organizations. As we grow our EU-based demand generation team ahead of our Q1 2027 bundle launch, we’re looking for an experienced Field Marketing Manager for DACH based in Germany. You will independently own the regional field plan, budget and senior Sales partnership for the DACH region and broader EU enterprise market. You will turn named-account priorities into a focused portfolio of high-value executive and technical experiences, with particular attention to German-language delivery, local enterprise buying dynamics and works council-sensitive programs and assets. You’ll work closely with Sales, Channel, Product Marketing, and Content teams to bring our go-to-market strategy to life on the ground, and you’ll help build the processes and playbooks this team relies on as it scales from a small pilot into a full regional function. This is a hands-on senior role for a marketer who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: selecting the few moments that matter, orchestrating cross-functional and agency support, and ensuring each program creates a clear next step for a priority account

What you'll do:
  • Co-create the quarterly DACH and EU market field plan with Sales, translating selected accounts, account stage and stakeholder priorities into a sequenced engagement plan.
  • Design and run a small portfolio of high-touch programs, including executive roundtables, private briefings, technical workshops, pilot-readiness sessions and a deliberately selected set of industry events.
  • Define the intended account outcome for every program: the target stakeholders, the desired meeting or next step, the pre-event engagement plan, the seller handoff and the follow-up assets required.
  • Own the DACH and EU market field budget, agency and vendor relationships, timelines, risk and execution quality; use shared Mozilla teams and the European agency for production, localization, PR, web and media operations.

  • Build repeatable field operating rhythms and reporting, contribute to the 2027 launch and customer-proof plan, and create learning that supports 2028 European expansion.
  • Track and report on program performance, using pipeline and engagement data to refine regional tactics.
How Success will be measured:
  • Priority accounts progress to an agreed commercial, executive or technical next step.
  • The right stakeholders attend and engage; success is based on account quality and coverage, not attendee volume.
  • Sales accepts the handoff, completes follow-up and can see how each program contributed to account movement.
  • Executive meetings, technical workshops, pilot activity and procurement support increase in the selected account set.
  • Reusable German-language proof, playbooks and market insight are created on time and used by the team.
  • Programs meet quality, budget and operational commitments.
What you’ll bring:
  • 5+ years of experience in field marketing, account-based marketing, enterprise events or regional go-to-market for B2B software, security or IT-managed products.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own a country or regional plan, budget, vendors and senior Sales relationships.
  • German native, fluent in English; French language skills preferred. Experience across the German market. Familiarity with Austrian and Swiss enterprise is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of complex enterprise buying groups, including IT, security, privacy, procurement and works council stakeholders.
  • Experience designing high-touch programs for named accounts and translating event activity into specific seller next steps.
  • Excellent project, agency and vendor management skills, with strong judgment about where to invest and what not to do.
  • A data-informed approach that combines program signals with account-level feedback and commercial context.
  • Comfort operating in an early-stage environment with ambiguity, high ownership and regular regional travel.
  • Excellent collaboration skills across marketing, sales, and cross-functional partners.

What you’ll get:

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Position Type: Remote

Industry: Hospitality / Hotel Operations
Department: Human Resources / People Operations
Language Requirements: Bilingual English & Spanish

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients in the hospitality industry is hiring an experienced HR Director to lead people operations, talent acquisition, payroll, compliance, and employee engagement across multiple hotel locations.

This is a hands-on HR leadership role for someone who can balance strategic people management with day-to-day operational execution. You’ll work closely with executive leadership and hotel managers to build scalable HR systems, improve hiring outcomes, strengthen employee retention, and maintain consistent standards across locations.

The ideal candidate brings experience supporting multi-site operations, understands the staffing and compliance challenges of hospitality, and can confidently communicate with both executive leadership and frontline employees in English and Spanish.

You’ll take ownership of the entire employee lifecycle, from recruiting and onboarding through performance management, payroll, employee development, and separation.

What You’ll Own

Talent Acquisition & Recruiting Operations

  • Develop and maintain a multi-channel recruiting pipeline for hourly hospitality employees and leadership positions.
  • Build an effective Employer Value Proposition (EVP) that attracts qualified candidates.
  • Manage recruiting processes across multiple hotel locations.
  • Develop practical skills assessments to evaluate candidates and reduce mis-hires.
  • Coordinate candidate screening, interviews, assessments, and hiring decisions.
  • Partner with hotel managers to understand staffing requirements and hiring priorities.
  • Maintain organized candidate pipelines and recruiting documentation.
  • Improve hiring efficiency, candidate quality, and workforce readiness.

Employee Onboarding & Knowledge Management

  • Design and manage centralized digital pre-boarding and onboarding workflows.
  • Ensure new hires arrive on their first day prepared to perform their responsibilities.
  • Develop and maintain standardized onboarding checklists.
  • Build and organize Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) libraries.
  • Maintain HR documentation and knowledge-management resources using tools such as Notion.
  • Ensure consistent onboarding experiences across hotel locations.
  • Work with hotel leadership to reinforce company expectations and brand standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding efficiency and employee readiness.

Performance Management & Leadership Coaching

  • Manage the company’s structured performance management and accountability framework.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and growth pathways for employees.
  • Coach hotel managers on delivering timely, constructive feedback.
  • Support performance evaluations and employee development conversations.
  • Maintain accurate performance documentation.
  • Guide managers through corrective action and employee relations matters.
  • Support compliant employee separation processes.
  • Promote accountability while maintaining a supportive and respectful workplace culture.

Payroll, HRIS & Compliance

  • Own end-to-end payroll processing across multiple hotel locations.
  • Review timecards, payroll records, and employee information for accuracy.
  • Identify and resolve payroll discrepancies.
  • Monitor overtime, labor costs, and timekeeping accuracy.
  • Evaluate labor cost efficiency across locations.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation.
  • Ensure payroll practices and employee benefits comply with applicable employment regulations.
  • Support compliance requirements across relevant jurisdictions.
  • Use HRIS and payroll platforms such as Paylocity to maintain accurate records and workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to improve payroll accuracy and operational efficiency.

Employee Engagement & Retention

  • Develop initiatives that strengthen employee engagement and retention.
  • Build recognition programs that reinforce positive performance.
  • Establish clear career development and advancement pathways.
  • Partner with hotel managers to address employee concerns proactively.
  • Identify factors contributing to employee turnover.
  • Promote a welcoming, professional, and accountable hospitality culture.
  • Encourage consistent communication between employees and leadership.
  • Support a positive employee experience across all hotel locations.

Executive Partnership & Workforce Planning

  • Partner directly with executive leadership on people strategy and workforce planning.
  • Provide insights into staffing needs, retention challenges, and operational priorities.
  • Support organizational growth through scalable HR processes.
  • Collaborate with hotel leadership on employee performance and workforce issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve HR systems and operational consistency.
  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives supporting hotel operations.
  • Provide clear updates on workforce priorities, risks, and ongoing HR initiatives.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in People Operations, Human Resources, HR Generalist, Talent Acquisition, or a related role.
  • Experience supporting multi-site or multi-location operations.
  • Background in hospitality, retail, customer service, or similarly fast-paced operational environments.
  • Strong understanding of hospitality staffing requirements, frontline employee management, and HR compliance.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end payroll processing.
  • Experience reviewing timecards, overtime, and payroll discrepancies.
  • Familiarity with HRIS and payroll platforms.
  • Ability to manage recruiting, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to develop and maintain HR processes, SOPs, and onboarding systems.
  • Strong understanding of employee performance documentation and compliant separation procedures.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish proficiency — essential.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with executive leadership and effectively with Spanish-speaking frontline employees.
  • Availability to work consistently during U.S. Central Time operational hours.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Remote Work Requirements

  • Backup connectivity solution to maintain availability during internet disruptions.
  • Ability to remain accessible during U.S. Central Time operational hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing HR operations across multiple hotel properties.
  • Experience supporting hourly hospitality workforces.
  • Hands-on experience with Paylocity.
  • Experience using Notion for SOPs, documentation, and knowledge management.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace.
  • Experience developing structured recruiting and onboarding processes.
  • Experience implementing performance management frameworks.
  • Experience building employee engagement and retention programs.
  • Experience supporting executive leadership in a growing hospitality organization.
  • Demonstrated success improving HR processes and operational efficiency.

Tools & Platforms

  • HR reporting

  • Workflow organization
  • Process standardization

  • Collaborative reporting and documentation

Additional Tools: Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) | HRIS Platforms | Payroll Systems | Employee Performance Management Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Take ownership of HR challenges and proactively solve problems.
  • Understand the realities of managing hourly hospitality employees.
  • Can manage both strategic HR initiatives and daily operational responsibilities.
  • Are comfortable communicating with executives and frontline hotel employees.
  • Can confidently switch between professional English and conversational Spanish.
  • Believe accountability and employee support should work together.
  • Provide timely, constructive feedback and document important conversations.
  • Understand that payroll accuracy and labor compliance require exceptional attention to detail.
  • Build systems and processes before operational problems become urgent.
  • Can independently manage multiple priorities across hotel locations.
  • Approach employee relations matters with professionalism, fairness, and discretion.
  • Enjoy improving recruiting, onboarding, and employee retention.
  • Are comfortable working remotely while remaining responsive to operational needs.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing overnight payroll flags, timecard discrepancies, or compliance matters requiring immediate attention.

You might then review recruiting pipelines, coordinate candidate assessments, prepare offer letters, or follow up with hotel managers about open positions.

Throughout the afternoon, you’ll connect with hotel leadership to discuss employee performance, coach managers through corrective conversations, or review employee documentation.

You may also update onboarding checklists or SOPs in Notion, evaluate labor cost trends, and identify opportunities to improve HR processes.

Before wrapping up, you’ll coordinate with executive leadership on workforce priorities, employee relations matters, and upcoming operational needs.

In short: You’ll ensure the right people are hired, properly onboarded, accurately paid, effectively managed, and supported throughout their employment.

Key Metrics for Success

Talent Acquisition

Provider portfolio

  • Contracted rates and projected allowed costs compared with approved benchmarks, with post-launch utilization and allowed costs reviewed alongside Analytics
  • Implementation quality measured by roster accuracy, rate validation, and timely resolution of contract-related claims issues
  • Completion of market specific network adequacy standards

  • Monitor regulatory changes across EMEA and assess their impact on business operations.
  • Conduct compliance reviews and audits of customs and export documentation.
  • Identify potential compliance risks and red flags and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Develop and maintain corporate trade compliance procedures, work instructions and documentation.
  • Work closely with the global trade compliance team and regional operations to strengthen compliance controls and processes.

What We’re Looking For

Essential experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR).
  • Practical knowledge of EAR de minimis and Foreign Direct Product (FDP) rules.
  • Experience with ECCN classification and U.S. export authorizations/licensing.
  • Strong knowledge of EU Dual-Use regulations and relevant European/national export controls.
  • Experience working with trade compliance/export controls across multiple EMEA countries.
  • Ability to independently assess export control requirements and provide practical guidance to internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Experience with high-tech products, equipment or technology.
  • Experience with repairs, returns, RMAs, spare parts or comparable after-sales/service logistics is highly relevant.

• Strong English communication skills.

Preferred experience

  • Background in industries such as telecommunications, networking, semiconductors, advanced computing or other high-tech sectors.
  • Experience working with a Trade Compliance Management System.
  • Experience with global customs and trade restrictions.
  • Knowledge of FCPA, anti-boycott regulations and Incoterms 2020.
  • Experience developing corporate trade compliance procedures and work instructions.
  • Customer-facing or advisory experience in trade compliance.

Purpose of the role:

Job title:

Integration Solution Architect

Job Description:

*CANDIDATES MUST BE ELIGIBLE FOR SC CLEARANCE*

This role is critical to the success of complex, high-volume integration programmes, where external platform constraints (e.g. Oracle) must not only be designed and assured but strategically aligned and operationalised within enterprise-owned integration environments.

The Integration Solution Architect is responsible for defining and shaping the integration architecture strategy, while ensuring the design, delivery, and assurance of robust, scalable integration solutions across complex enterprise landscapes. The role plays a pivotal part in enabling seamless data and process flows between core platforms (e.g. ERP, ServiceNow, Amazon Connect, and integration hubs), ensuring alignment with business objectives, security requirements, and operational outcomes.

Operating at both a strategic and hands-on delivery level, the architect will work closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and third-party partners to define integration direction, make and assure technical design decisions, and provide active guidance through build, test, deployment readiness, and transition to BAU. The role ensures that integration approaches not only meet immediate programme needs but are sustainable, reusable, implementable, and aligned to long-term enterprise architecture principles, while maintaining compliance with relevant standards and best practices.


What you’ll be doing:


  • Strategy & Direction:
    • Define, own, and continuously evolve the enterprise integration strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment to organisational objectives and long-term transformation goals. Ensure all integrations are routed via the Customer Integration Hub and comply with enterprise architecture and GDS standards
    • Establish and govern integration principles, standards, and patterns (e.g. API-led, event-driven, reusable services) across the enterprise landscape
    • Provide architectural leadership to ensure integration design decisions are scalable, resilient, and aligned to future business needs
  • Business Alignment:
    • Work with senior business stakeholders to understand strategic goals, operational priorities, and performance outcomes, translating these into clear integration architecture direction
    • Ensure integration solutions enable end-to-end business processes, improve data flow, and support measurable business value (e.g. efficiency, automation, service improvement)
    • Facilitate and lead solution integration workshops with internal and external stakeholders to confirm requirements, design adherence, and technical feasibility
    • Identify opportunities to rationalise and reuse integration capabilities, reducing complexity and improving time-to-market
  • Architecture Governance & Landscape Ownership:
    • Maintain a holistic view of the system landscape, including platforms, data flows, and integration dependencies
    • Assess and optimise the availability, reuse, and lifecycle of APIs and services across systems
    • Define how systems should interact within the integration ecosystem, ensuring clear ownership, accountability, and governance
  • Platform & Technology Leadership:
    • Provide strategic direction and oversight for integration platforms, including:
      • Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
      • MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (desirable)
  • Where both platforms are used, define how they work together, ensuring consistent patterns, interoperability, and optimal use of capabilities
  • Governance, Assurance & Risk Management
  • Establish and enforce integration governance frameworks, ensuring consistency and compliance with enterprise standards
  • Provide design authority and assurance across integration solutions, ensuring quality, security, and operational resilience
  • Identify, manage, and mitigate integration risks, dependencies, and technical constraints
  • Work with security teams to ensure all integrations meet protective monitoring and incident notification requirements, following GDS security and privacy standards
  • Leadership & Delivery:
  • Lead interface-level integration design activities, including requirements analysis, pattern selection, interface definition, data mapping, message structure definition, error handling, retry and reconciliation design, and preparation of high-level and detailed integration designs for delivery
  • Take ownership of the production and assurance of high-level and detailed integration designs, ensuring designs are sufficiently detailed for build teams to implement with minimal ambiguity.
  • Lead technical design reviews, challenge assumptions, resolve design issues, and coach delivery teams to ensure integration solutions meet enterprise standards, security requirements, and operational support needs.
  • Support build, test, defect resolution, deployment readiness, and transition to BAU by providing hands-on technical guidance on integration behaviour, data flows, error scenarios, monitoring, and operational controls.
  • Provide hands-on leadership across delivery, ensuring teams produce high-quality, build-ready integration designs and technically sound implementation outcomes.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for integration challenges across programmes and workstreams
  • Typical Deliverables
  • Integration Strategy and Approach documents mapped to GDS Service Standard points.
  • Integration solutions and artefacts supporting automated deployment and monitoring
  • Aligned with DevOps practices.
  • High-Level and Detailed Solution Integration Designs.
  • Integration Catalogue and Interface Specifications.
  • Interface-level design artefacts covering source-to-target mappings, message structures, orchestration flows, exception handling, retry logic, reconciliation approach, and non-functional considerations.
  • API specifications, payload and message schemas, source-to-target mapping documents, sequence flows, error handling matrices, retry/replay logic, reconciliation controls, and operational runbooks.
  • Data Flow and Security Models.
  • Test Assurance and Transition-to-BAU artefacts.
  • Evidence packs for GDS service assessments.

What We're Looking For:


  • Experience:
    • Proven experience operating as a Lead or Principal Integration Architect within large, complex enterprise environments
    • Demonstrated ability to define integration strategy and influence architectural direction at programme or organisational level
    • Ability to produce high-quality technical documentation and present complex integration concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
    • Direct experience producing detailed integration designs for complex enterprise programmes, including interface specifications, data mappings, message structures, error handling, retry/replay logic, and reconciliation approaches.

    • Understanding of enterprise system landscapes and integration hubs

    • Desirable: hands-on experience designing integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including API-led patterns, RAML/OpenAPI specifications, connectors, transformations, policies, error handling, monitoring, and deployment considerations
  • Leadership & Behaviour:

    • Strong leadership capability, with experience guiding teams and shaping delivery outcomes
    • Able to operate as a hands-on technical design lead, balancing architectural authority with practical delivery support and coaching of engineers, analysts, and partner teams.
    • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts in a clear, business-focused way

Preferred Qualifications:

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

As the Lead Solution Architect for Sarah Cannon Research Institute, you will play a pivotal role in driving our database strategy across all products. This role demands a profound expertise in data architecture to analyze, design, and implement complex systems ensuring robust, scalable solutions that support our business goals. Your expertise will ensure that our data infrastructure is robust, scalable, and aligned with our mission, enabling us to harness the power of data to improve healthcare delivery and support our ongoing commitment to clinical research and our patients.


This position is remote based in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Data Architecture: Create and maintain the overall data architecture framework, including databases, data warehouses, data lakes, and other data systems.
  • Data Mapping: Develop and implement data mapping rules to transform data from source systems to target systems, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
  • Data Integration: Design and implement processes for integrating data from various sources, ensuring data consistency and accuracy.
  • Data Governance: Establish data governance policies and procedures to ensure data quality, security, and HIPPA compliance across all data systems and platforms.
  • Technology Evaluation: Evaluate and recommend data management technologies and tools to support the organization's data needs.
  • Problem Solving: Identify and resolve data-related issues, ensuring data integrity and reliability.
  • AI Solutions: Design and implement architectures that seamlessly integrate AI models and algorithms with existing data infrastructures, including cloud-native and legacy systems.

Influence projects to make decisions related to data strategies including data quality, data architecture and data management best practices

Minimum Job Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in enterprise data architecture, including data requirements collection, data architecture analysis, evaluation, documentation, data modeling, design, development, model validation, and data integration in modern data platforms (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Snowflake).

  • Proficiency in infrastructure-as-code and automation tools (Terraform) for database deployment and management.

jobs.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The SHI Services Manager, AI Security & Governance leads a team of Engineers and Developers focused on helping customers secure and govern Microsoft AI, agents, data, agent identity, and cloud solutions. The Manager is responsible for a defined portfolio of AI security and governance services while providing specialized security and governance expertise in support of solutions led by other Microsoft Services practice groups.

This role provides leadership across team development, solution delivery, engineering and automation, customer advisory, and capability development. The Manager helps customers establish practical security, identity, data protection, compliance, monitoring, and governance controls needed to responsibly adopt AI and agent technologies.

The Manager serves as both a people leader and capability leader, ensuring the team delivers secure, scalable, and business outcome-focused solutions within its areas of responsibility. This role works closely with Data and AI, Digital Workplace, Enterprise Security, Azure Cloud Services, sales, solution architects, delivery leaders, Microsoft, and customer stakeholders to bring AI security and governance expertise into broader customer solutions.

Role Description


Team Leadership and Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Engineers and Developers focused on AI security, data security, identity, governance, automation, and related Microsoft technologies.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, career development plans, and technical growth pathways.
  • Build a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous learning.
  • Support recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and retention efforts to develop a strong AI security and governance capability.
  • Foster knowledge sharing and community building across Microsoft Services practices.

AI Security & Governance Capability Development

  • Define and evolve the roadmap for the AI security and governance services assigned to the team, including advisory, assessment, implementation, engineering, automation, and operational enablement offerings.
  • Develop repeatable capabilities for AI security architecture, agent security controls, AI identity and access, data protection, compliance integration, security monitoring, threat protection, and security-focused governance.
  • Partner with Microsoft and internal stakeholders to align the team’s services with evolving Microsoft AI, security, compliance, identity, and data capabilities.
  • Develop reusable intellectual property for the team’s portfolio, including reference architectures, implementation methodologies, security patterns, governance controls, accelerators, automation, code, templates, and best practices.
  • Identify emerging AI security and governance trends and recommend focused investments that strengthen SHI’s ability to help customers adopt AI securely.

Delivery Excellence


  • Provide delivery oversight and guidance for customer engagements owned by the AI Security & Governance team.
  • Ensure consistent delivery quality through architecture reviews, engineering standards, testing, governance controls, documentation, and operational best practices.
  • Guide the application of Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Security Copilot, Agent 365, and related technologies within the team’s areas of responsibility.
  • Support escalation management and risk mitigation for complex customer engagements involving the team’s services and expertise.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise architecture, privacy, compliance, and security standards.
  • Manage team capacity, utilization, workload, project health, and skills alignment to support reliable delivery and sustainable growth.

Engineering and Service Delivery Automation


  • Make automation a core component of how the AI Security & Governance team designs, develops, and delivers its services.
  • Identify repeatable activities within the team’s delivery portfolio that can be standardized, automated, and converted into reusable intellectual property.
  • Guide development of scripts, tools, integrations, accelerators, and automation that improve the speed, quality, consistency, and efficiency of the team’s delivery work.
  • Promote modern engineering practices using GitHub, CI/CD, PowerShell, Bicep, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, testing, and reusable components where appropriate to the team’s services.
  • Establish practices for source control, code review, testing, documentation, release management, support, and lifecycle management for assets developed by the team.
  • Collaborate with adjacent practice groups to align reusable engineering assets and avoid unnecessary duplication.

Cross-Practice Collaboration and Solution Support

  • Partner with Data and AI, Digital Workplace, Enterprise Security, Azure Cloud Services, and other Microsoft Services teams to incorporate appropriate security and governance capabilities into broader customer solutions.
  • Provide AI security, identity, data protection, compliance, monitoring, and governance expertise in support of services and engagements led by other practice groups.
  • Collaborate with agentic solution teams on security and governance requirements for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Agent 365, custom agents, and related technologies.
  • Work with Enterprise Security leadership to align AI-specific security capabilities with SHI’s broader Microsoft security portfolio and delivery standards.
  • Contribute to shared customer governance models, production-readiness approaches, reference architectures, and solution patterns without duplicating ownership held by adjacent teams.
  • Establish clear engagement models, responsibilities, and handoffs that allow teams to combine expertise and deliver an integrated customer experience.

Solution Advisory and Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a technical advisor for strategic customer opportunities that require the team’s AI security and governance expertise.
  • Guide solution decisions within the team’s areas of responsibility, including AI and agent identity, access, data protection, monitoring, threat detection, compliance, and security controls.
  • Collaborate with solution architects, engineering leaders, developers, and delivery teams to ensure technical consistency and alignment.
  • Promote security by design and governance by design approaches that connect business outcomes to technical implementation.
  • Contribute thought leadership on AI security, agent security, secure development, delivery automation, responsible AI, and enterprise governance practices.

Business Growth and Customer Success

  • Partner with sales, presales, and adjacent practice teams to support pipeline development, opportunity strategy, and solution positioning involving AI security and governance.
  • Participate in customer workshops, executive briefings, architecture discussions, and strategic planning sessions where the team’s expertise is required.
  • Support revenue growth, customer retention, and expansion opportunities within the team’s assigned portfolio and through cross-practice solutions.
  • Ensure customer engagements deliver measurable business outcomes and strong customer satisfaction.
  • Contribute to success stories, case studies, sales enablement, and market-facing thought leadership.

Behaviors and Competencies


  • Adaptability: Can lead others through change, help teams adapt to new directions, and create a culture open to change.
  • Business Acumen: Can develop and execute business plans to drive growth and profitability.
  • Change Management: Can manage major changes in organizational processes or policies, can facilitate change management processes among others, can mentor others in effective change management, and can adapt change management style based on the situation and the organization’s needs.
  • Collaboration: Can take ownership of team initiatives, foster a collaborative environment, and ensure that all team members feel valued and heard.
  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences, facilitate effective communication between others, and mentor others in effective communication.
  • Continuous Improvement: Can identify major areas for improvement, implement major changes, and support others in their continuous improvement efforts.
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can take ownership of customer-centric initiatives, ensuring products and services align with customer needs. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate customer feedback into product development.
  • Leadership: Can take ownership of complex team initiatives, collaborate with others in decision-making processes, and drive team performance.
  • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify and take ownership of complex problem-solving initiatives, initiate preventative measures, collaborate with others to find solutions, and drive successful outcomes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, anticipate future trends, and align and integrate strategies across departments or functions.

Skill Level Requirements


This role requires strength across the following areas. Deep expertise in every platform is not required, but broad experience across these capabilities is important for success. Candidates should not self-select out if they do not meet every preferred qualification.


  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Seven or more years of experience delivering solutions across cybersecurity, cloud engineering, software development, automation, identity, data protection, AI governance, or related technologies.
  • Three or more years of experience leading technical teams, practices, or consulting organizations.
  • Experience leading Engineers, Developers, Architects, Consultants, or similarly technical professionals.
  • Strong understanding of AI security, agent security, identity, data protection, information governance, compliance, monitoring, threat detection, and incident response.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Security Copilot, or related Microsoft security technologies.
  • Understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Foundry, Agent 365, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI, or related AI and data platforms.
  • Experience using automation to improve service delivery, engineering, or operational processes.
  • Understanding of GitHub, CI/CD, PowerShell, Bicep, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, source control, testing, and reusable engineering components.
  • Proven success working across multiple technical practices or delivery teams to support integrated customer solutions.
  • Experience building service offerings, accelerators, automation, methodologies, technical communities, or reusable intellectual property.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership skills.

Relevant certifications may include Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate, Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, or equivalent experience.

Other Requirements


  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with sales, delivery, engineering, development, and leadership stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel to support client engagements, workshops, and internal enablement activities, up to 20%.
  • Commitment to continuous learning across Microsoft AI, security, identity, data, governance, development, and automation technologies.
  • Strong ethical standards with disciplined adherence to data privacy, governance, compliance, secure development, and security policies.

This role sits at the intersection of AI innovation, security, governance, engineering, and service delivery automation. It offers the opportunity to lead talented Engineers and Developers, own a focused portfolio of AI security and governance services, and collaborate across SHI to help organizations move AI and agent solutions into secure, governed, enterprise-scale production environments.


Your Success at SHI

People who are successful in this role tend to demonstrate:

  • High employee engagement, retention, and skill development across a growing AI security and governance team.
  • Consistent delivery quality, strong customer satisfaction, and practical judgment across the services owned by the team.
  • The ability to balance AI innovation with security, governance, data privacy, compliance, and operational readiness.
  • Measurable improvements in delivery speed, consistency, scalability, and quality through automation and reusable intellectual property within the team’s portfolio.
  • Growth of the team’s AI security and governance services, pipeline, reusable assets, and capability maturity.
  • Strong collaboration across Data and AI, Digital Workplace, Enterprise Security, Azure Cloud Services, sales, presales, delivery, engineering, leadership, and Microsoft partner teams.
  • Clear ownership of assigned services combined with a collaborative approach to solutions led by other practice groups.
  • A genuine passion for developing technical talent and helping customers adopt AI securely and responsibly.

Skyhigh Security is more than a company; here, when you invest your career with us, we commit to investing in you. Job Description

We are seeking a curious and technically sharp FinOps & Product Analytics Engineer to join our DevOps & Cloud Platform team. In this role, you will build the data foundation and AI-powered tooling that turns operational data into clear, actionable insight for engineering, product, and finance stakeholders across Intapp.


We are starting with FinOps — cloud cost, cost allocation, anomaly detection, and usage visibility — but this role is designed to grow. As we expand into product usage analytics and additional data domains, you will help shape how we ingest, model, and surface that data through both AI-powered chat and dashboards. Subject matter experts guide the requirements; your job is to build the “how”: reliable data models, AI-powered reporting tools, and analytics layers that teams actually rely on.


About Intapp:

Intapp, based in Silicon Valley, is a leader in Vertical AI SaaS company, collaborating with over 2,550 professional and financial services firms globally. With 20+ years of industry expertise, Intapp's "Intelligence Applied" approach is transforming how businesses operate and leverages a strategic partner with Microsoft in delivering industry cloud solutions. The company culture promotes accountability, responsibility, and growth in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment. Since going public in 2021, Intapp has expanded to over 1,600 employees globally with development centers in Palo Alto, Charlotte, Belfast, Berlin, and Lisbon.


What You Will Do:

  • Design and maintain analytical data models — schemas, views, and aggregations — that correctly represent FinOps data including cloud cost, cost allocation, anomaly signals, infrastructure usage, and unit economics, with additional domains to follow.
  • Build ingestion and normalization pipelines that clean and unify data from heterogeneous sources — AWS and Azure billing, SaaS platforms, product telemetry, and internal systems — into a consistent, queryable analytical layer.
  • Develop AI-powered reporting skills in Python using MCP (Model Context Protocol) that return structured, reliable answers to stakeholder questions — covering cost anomalies, team-level spend breakdowns, usage trends, and more as new domains come online.
  • Implement prompt engineering and output validation layers that make AI-generated answers trustworthy — handling empty results, ambiguous time ranges, and conflicting data gracefully.
  • Build and maintain dashboards in Metabase covering FinOps metrics (showback, chargeback, anomaly signals, unit costs) and expanding to additional domains as the platform grows.
  • Collaborate with FinOps experts, product managers, and other domain leads to translate requirements into accurate data models and query patterns that reflect how the underlying data actually behaves.
  • Help evaluate and contribute to architecture decisions as new data domains and source systems are brought into the platform.
  • Document data models, AI skill patterns, and pipeline logic so the broader team can understand, extend, and trust what you build.
  • Continuously improve data quality, query performance, and AI output reliability as the platform scales in volume, variety, and scope.

What You Will Need:

  • Strong SQL skills — complex aggregations, window functions, joins across large datasets, and the instinct to investigate when a number looks wrong before shipping.
  • Python proficiency — clean, maintainable scripts for data transformation, normalization, and tooling (not just notebooks).
  • Experience with analytical or columnar databases — such as ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redshift, DuckDB, or similar.
  • Demonstrated experience building with an LLM API (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) — you understand tool use, structured outputs, and what it takes to make AI responses consistent and reliable.
  • Ability to work from well-defined requirements: translating a subject matter expert’s question into a data model and query that accurately answers it.
  • Comfort in a greenfield environment — able to make sound architectural decisions when patterns are still being established.
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar function-calling / tool-use patterns for LLMs (preferred).

What you will gain at Intapp:

Our culture at Intapp emphasizes accountability, responsibility, and growth. We support each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, approachability, and teamwork. We’re committed to creating a modern work environment that’s connected yet flexible, supporting both professional success and work-life balance. In return for your passion, commitment, and collaborative approach, we offer:

- Attractive compensation – including competitive base pay and performance-based variable pay.

- Equity/Stock in Intapp.Opportunity to travel to other development centers for product training and cross-site collaboration.

- One-time home office stipend.

- Generous paid parental leave (including adoptive leave), marriage leave, bereavement leave, carer's leave, and paid sick days.

- Reimbursement for training towards continuing education.

Intapp provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and will make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please note: Intapp will not hire through text message, social media, or email alone. We will never extend a job offer unless you have been contacted directly by an Intapp recruiter and have participated in the interview process which will generally consist of 3 or more virtual or in person meetings. Please note that Intapp only uses company email addresses, which contain “@intapp.com” or “@dealcloud.com” to communicate with candidates via email. Intapp will never ask for financial information of any kind or for any payment during the job application process. We post all legitimate job openings on the Intapp Career Site at . If you believe you were a victim of such a scam, you may contact your local authorities. Intapp is not responsible for any claims, losses, damages, or expenses resulting from scammers.
