jobs.excerpt: Company Overviewhermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm and hedge fund.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm and hedge fund. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are seeking experienced full-stack engineers to build the user interfaces and services for mission-critical financial applications: visual analytics platforms and data-driven tools used by traders, researchers, and analysts.

You will work on the TypeScript front-ends and the Go services that serve them. We are evolving our front-end applications into a modular, plugin-based platform that other engineers and teams build on—so you will build reusable UI modules, component libraries, and SDKs as much as end-user features, and also the Go services that ingest, process, and serve market and on-chain data to these applications. You will own your work from structured product requirements through to production.

This is a highly collaborative role in a fast-paced environment where clean design, high performance, and responsive UIs are critical to the business.

You don't need a background in trading or finance. We care most about engineering craft and will teach you the domain.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with traders, researchers, and product managers to translate complex workflows into elegant UI solutions.
  • Design and implement high-performance, responsive front-end applications using a current-generation TypeScript framework (Svelte, React, or Vue).
  • Design, build and operate Go back-end services with security and performance considerations baked into their design.
  • Own service boundaries and data contracts end-to-end, from Go services to typed front-end SDKs.
  • Build reusable UI modules, component libraries, and SDKs for a modular, plugin-based UI platform.
  • Build real-time UIs that ingest and render high-frequency market and on-chain data from multiple streaming sources.
  • Develop high-performance data visualizations for large, fast-updating datasets, using canvas-based charting (e.g. uPlot, TradingView Lightweight Charts) and D3.js for bespoke views.
  • Integrate the front-end with back-end services through typed SDKs and MCP-based interfaces, including real-time market and on-chain data.
  • Drive architecture and performance decisions for modular, extensible systems, with scalability and maintainability in mind.
  • Deploy and maintain applications, keeping them reliable and performant under heavy load.
  • Write and maintain automated tests and take part in code review to keep the codebase reliable and maintainable.
  • Support system maintenance and feature evolution with a high delivery cadence and short iteration cycles.
  • Mentor other engineers and promote engineering best practices across the team.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 7+ years of hands-on full-stack development, with production ownership on both back-end and front-end.
  • Strong, current TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and one or more modern front-end frameworks (Svelte, React, or Vue), with the adaptability to work primarily in the framework a team has chosen rather than staying tied to one.
  • Strong, current Go experience, able to design, build and operate production Go services independently.
  • Experience building reusable, well-structured UI components and shared abstractions.
  • Proven experience handling large datasets and real-time updates from back-end sources (WebSockets, Server-Sent Events).
  • Strong understanding of performance optimization and rendering strategies in data-heavy applications, including a solid grasp of the JavaScript runtime.
  • Solid testing discipline, with unit and integration tests as a normal part of delivery.
  • Genuine UI/UX sensibility—you can tell a polished interface from a rough one, and care about the difference.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and version control.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration in a cross-functional team.

Nice to Have

  • Background or strong interest in trading systems or financial platforms.
  • Exceptional design taste / portfolio-grade UI work.
  • Experience with relational databases, data warehouses, and caching strategies.
  • Experience with real-time or on-chain / crypto market data.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or other AI-native / agent integration.
  • Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, or shared component libraries used by other engineers.
  • Understanding of microservice architectures, continuous delivery, and zero-downtime deployment.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or ELK.
  • Prior work in hedge funds, proprietary trading, or similar finance environments.

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Phone Screening – A screening session with a few on-the-spot technical questions to assess your fundamental knowledge and problem-solving approach.
  3. Assignment – A take-home assignment to demonstrate your approach, critical thinking, and relevant skills.
  4. Assignment Review – A discussion of your assignment, focusing on your approach, reasoning, and solutions.
  5. CTO Interview – Interview with the CTO to discuss your experience, technical expertise, problem-solving approach, and overall fit for the role.
  6. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm’s values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

jobs.description:
About Us

Zepto is building the beating heart of Australia's real-time, account-to-account payments revolution.

It's a good moment to be doing this work. Card surcharging rules have changed, Payday Super is live, and many businesses are taking a serious look at account-to-account payments for the first time. A lot of that shift lands on our platform, and we're looking for action-oriented engineers to help build category-defining infrastructure.

Payments is a domain where the details matter. When someone's wages or a business's cash flow moves through our platform, it has to arrive correctly, every time, in seconds. Meeting that bar in a regulated industry makes for interesting engineering problems. As a Software Engineer you'll own real pieces of how we solve them, working alongside senior engineers who'll help you grow your scope quickly.

We're a remote-first team that works closely together. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, encouraged to share their thinking, and supported to grow. That culture is part of why we've been named FinTech Organisation of the Year at the Finnies twice.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain features on our high-volume, real-time payment APIs, shipping clean, tested, observable code into a mission-critical, regulated environment.
  • Work in a cross-functional team, contributing to technical designs and RFCs and turning them into well-scoped, shippable work.
  • Review your peers' code and pair regularly, learning from senior engineers and sharing what you know.
  • Collaborate with Platform, Security and Incident Management teams, and join our shared on-call rotation once you're up to speed.

What You'll Bring

  • Solid backend foundations: Commercial experience in a backend language and API development. We work in Ruby and Go. Ruby experience is a plus, but strong fundamentals and a willingness to learn matter more to us than your current language.
  • Good engineering practices: Experience with test-driven development, code review and continuous delivery. Exposure to public cloud (preferably AWS) or event-driven systems is a plus.
  • Ownership: You take a piece of work from inception to production and make sure it works once it's there.
  • AI adoption: AI is changing how engineering works, and you're evolving with it. You use tools like Claude Code or Cursor in your day-to-day delivery and stay curious as capabilities improve, while reviewing generated code as carefully as your own and respecting data security boundaries.
  • Clear, open communication: You share work in progress early, ask good questions, and raise risks when you see them. You ask for help early when you're stuck.
  • Front-end experience (React, TypeScript) is a bonus: Plenty of our work spans the stack, from the APIs that move money to the merchant-facing UIs built on them, so engineers who can follow their work through to the UI add real value.

Your First 6 Months

  • Week 1: You'll be paired with an onboarding buddy to get familiar with our domains, understand the business context across teams, and ship your first changes to production.
  • Month 1: You're delivering stories within your team's domain and reviewing code with growing context. You understand how merchants and internal staff use the Zepto platform, and you're building relationships across product, engineering and the wider business. You've probably spotted something we could do better, whether that's a clunky endpoint, a confusing error message or a gap in our docs, and either fixed it or raised it with the team.
  • Month 6: You're delivering features end to end with growing independence: working through requirements with product, contributing to the design, and seeing your work land in production. You've contributed to an RFC, you're part of the on-call rotation, and you're confident supporting the systems your team owns.

Why Zepto?

Headquartered in beautiful Byron Bay, Zepto has an inspiring founder story and is a customer-focused, culture-first organisation. You'll be joining a team that champions curiosity and a pioneering perspective, and thrives in a fast-moving sector.

Just some of Zepto's commitments to our people include:

  • Join a Talented Team: Work with world-class talent and leaders who support career growth
  • Flexible Work: A remote-first work culture, with the opportunity to work anywhere in Australia. You'll also get access to premium co-working spaces and a Byron, Sydney & Melbourne Hub
  • Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks Paid Parental Leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers
  • Wellbeing Focus: Access to Zepto's Wellbeing Menu, which includes 3 x paid Wellbeing Days per year and access to an Employee Assistance Program
  • Annual Learning Budget: An individual learning budget, and 4 x paid Growth & Impact Days annually to focus on professional development
  • Remote-Work Support: A $500 Remote Work Budget to set up your home office upon commencement, and $300 annually from your 2nd Zeptoversary

Please note:As an organisation in the financial services industry, we conduct background checks as part of our recruitment process.

jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

  • Developing and/or editing R code, Python code for model builds, scoring and delivery.
  • Provide direction and manage the work processes and output of database marketing analysts;
  • Participate in creating relevant solutions for clients by evaluating client needs for quantitative analysis and in developing methods or processes for implementation;
  • Leverage knowledge, and hands on work, of data and statistical modeling techniques to provide suggestions or guidance to teams using tools like Snowflake/SQL/Python/R
  • Provide hands on building and optimization of clients’ multi-channel campaigns through model building, campaign scoring, and production using tools like Snowflake/SQL/Python/R.
  • Perform 3rd party data vendor evaluations for the data product leveraging qualitative and quantitative methods.
  • Manage project tasks, timelines and deliverables inclusive of model builds, deployment, campaign production activities, like scoring.
  • Act as an advisor in the following techniques: Predictive statistical models, Customer profiling, Segmentation Analysis, Campaign Analysis & Scoring, Data Analysis and Mining,
  • Co-presenting modeling findings and campaign results to clients,
  • Work independently with minimum supervision, and provide guidance to junior team members;
  • undefined

Experience:

  • Possess core database marketing knowledge such as understanding of company and client data, relational database concepts, and direct marketing concepts;
  • 5+ years in quantitative marketing/analytics/data science
  • Advanced Experience with Snowflake, SQL, R, Python, AI tools (Claude) logistic regression, linear regression, XGboost machine learning, clustering;
  • Advanced experience using 3rd party data in combination with 1st party data for modeling, scoring, and campaign analytics;
  • Ability to explain/present complicated/advanced analytical methodology and results to non-technical audiences;
  • Ability to execute advanced analytic tasks (including but not limited to developing/editing modeling code, modeling, segmentation, DOE, forecasting, etc.) and create meaningful analytical outputs;
  • Ability to translate analysis insights into actionable recommendations and strategies for marketers; Experience with applying statistical techniques such as regression, cluster analysis, factor analysis, to solve business problems;
  • Possess core analytical competencies such as ability to formulate an analytical problem, QC data and results, summarize key findings/insights, make actionable recommendations, and develop new and innovative analytical solutions to solve challenging business problems;
  • Requires a Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Statistics, Math, Economics or related scientific/quantitative field and at least five (5+) years of experience as a Data Analyst or related occupation. Masters+ preferred.

Work Location:Remote Canada


About the Role:

The Analytics Data Engineer is a highly organized and collaborative professional who partners with business analytics and data architecture teams to ensure data alignment and availability. Working directly with the Accounting and Finance teams, this role involves locating, translating, and consolidating financial data into well-structured, sustainable fact tables to enable core accounting and financial reporting functions. The engineer translates business needs into scalable data architecture, manages and optimizes Microsoft Fabric infrastructure, and ensures reporting consistency across financial business units. Success in this role means delivering trusted, well-modeled data products to support financial reporting, reconciliations, and enterprise data growth.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Communicate complex financial data structures and nuances to business stakeholders to drive informed decision-making.
  • Translate accounting and finance business requirements into actionable technical solutions.
  • Implement and monitor efficient data ingestion and transformation from multiple source systems (e.g., financial modules, ERPs) for Microsoft Fabric reporting.
  • Maintain enterprise-level Fabric lakehouses, warehouses, and Power BI semantic models tailored to financial analytics.
  • Map the data and logic of different ERP systems (such as general ledgers, accounts payable/receivable, and asset management) into central sources within a database.
  • Deliver on accounting business needs on schedule while supporting the ongoing development of a modern, scalable financial data warehouse and reporting platform.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Accounting, or an equivalent field.
  • 6 years of experience in data engineering or data analytics.
  • High level of expertise in SQL.
  • High familiarity with the Microsoft Fabric platform, infrastructure, and Power BI data modeling/reporting.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, data governance frameworks, and data quality management.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather and consolidate different streams of financial data into centralized locations.
  • Experience translating complex business needs into actionable technical solutions.
  • Demonstrated success in communication across business domains.

Other Qualifications:
  • Proficiency in Python is a plus.
  • Technical familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., D365, Microsoft Navision) is a plus.
  • Background in Accounting/Finance business processes is highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication (written, verbal, and presentation) and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships by engaging business process owners to establish credibility, solve problems, and build consensus.
  • Excellent time management, facilitation, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to estimate technical work and build out a task plan and timeline with a project manager.
  • Flexible with a proven ability to conform to shifting priorities, demands, and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Technically competent with various software programs, including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Project, SharePoint), Planview, and ServiceNow.
  • Comfortable in a standard office environment with prolonged sitting in front of a computer.
What’s in it for YOU at Quantiphi:
  • Make an impact at one of the world’s fastest-growing AI-first digital engineering companies.
  • Upskill and discover your potential as you solve complex challenges in cutting-edge areas of technology alongside passionate, talented colleagues.
  • Work where innovation happens - work with disruptive innovators in a research-focused organization with 60+ patents filed across various disciplines.
  • Stay ahead of the curve—immerse yourself in breakthrough AI, ML, data, and cloud technologies and gain exposure working with Fortune 500 companies.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
